引擎错误类型。\nuse std::io;\n\n/// 引擎所有错误的统一枚举。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum EngineError {\n    /// 底层 I/O 错误（磁盘或被故障注入层模拟）。\n    Io(String),\n    /// JSON 序列化/反序列化错误。\n    Serde(String),\n    /// 存储库目录已存在 / 不存在等状态冲突。\n    Conflict(String),\n    /// 请求的数据集或检查点不存在。\n    NotFound(String),\n    /// 请求参数不合法（页内容长度、hex 编码等）。\n    BadRequest(String),\n    /// 检查点父链在磁盘上断裂：父检查点文件缺失。\n    MissingParent {\n        /// 引用缺失父项的检查点。\n        checkpoint: String,\n        /// 缺失的父检查点 ID。\n        missing: String,\n    },\n    /// 检查点父链存在循环依赖。\n    CycleDetected(String),\n    /// 页的 CRC32 校验与元数据不符（磁盘损坏或故障注入）。\n    ChecksumMismatch {\n        checkpoint: String,\n        page: u32,\n        expected: u32,\n        actual: u32,\n    },\n    /// 页版本在应用检查点链时回退（依赖链不自洽）。\n    VersionRegression {\n        page: u32,\n        previous: u64,\n        incoming: u64,\n    },\n    /// 故障注入策略主动中止了某次操作。\n    InjectedFault(String),\n}\n\npub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, EngineError>;\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for EngineError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            EngineError::Io(s) => write!(f, \"I/O 错误: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::Serde(s) => write!(f, \"序列化错误: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::Conflict(s) => write!(f, \"状态冲突: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::NotFound(s) => write!(f, \"不存在: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::BadRequest(s) => write!(f, \"非法请求: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::MissingParent { checkpoint, missing } => write!(\n                f,\n                \"父链缺失: 检查点 {checkpoint} 引用的父检查点 {missing} 不存在\"\n            ),\n            EngineError::CycleDetected(id) => write!(f, \"检查点父链存在循环依赖，环上检查点: {id}\"),\n            EngineError::ChecksumMismatch { checkpoint, page, expected, actual } {"parentUuid":"4c4d9482-9bec-4133-91e9-76d2d3045988","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_brgwjd6rkoirxdtcj3i1221m","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/src/checksum.rs","content":"//! 页内容校验：统一使用 CRC32（IEEE 802.3）。\n//!\n//! 磁盘元数据中同时保存整数和 8 位小写 hex 两种形式，便于人工检查。\n\n/// 计算一段字节的 CRC32。\npub fn crc32(data: &[u8]) -> u32 {\n    crc32fast::hash(data)\n}\n\n/// CRC 的 8 位小写 hex 表示，例如 `0x9bdc4c3d` -> `\"9bdc4c3d\"`。\npub fn crc32_hex(data: &[u8]) -> String {\n    format!(\"{:08x}\", crc32(data))\n}\n\n/// 字节数组 -> 小写 hex 字符串。\npub fn to_hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {\n    let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);\n    for b in bytes {\n        out.push_str(&format!(\"{b:02x}\"));\n    }\n    out\n}\n\n/// 小写 hex 字符串 -> 字节数组（大小写均可，奇数长度或非 hex 字符报错）。\npub fn from_hex(s: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {\n    if s.len() % 2 != 0 {\n        return Err(format!(\"hex 长度必须为偶数，实际为 {} 个字符\", s.len()));\n    }\n    let bytes = s.as_bytes();\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(s.len() / 2);\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < bytes.len() {\n        let hi = hex_val(bytes[i])\n            .ok_or_else(|| format!(\"非法 hex 字符 {:?}（位置 {}）\", bytes[i] as char, i))?;\n        let lo = hex_val(bytes[i + 1])\n            .ok_or_else(|| format!(\"非法 hex 字符 {:?}（位置 {}）\", bytes[i + 1] as char, i + 1))?;\n        out.push((hi << 4) | lo);\n        i += 2;\n    }\n    Ok(out)\n}\n\nfn hex_val(c: u8) -> Option<u8> {\n    match c {\n        b'0'..=b'9' => Some(c - b'0'),\n        b'a'..=b'f' => Some(c - b'a' + 10),\n        b'A'..=b'F' => Some(c - b'A' + 10),\n        _ => None,\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn crc_known_vector() {\n        // CRC32/IEEE(\"123456789\") = 0xcbf43926\n        assert_eq!(crc32(b\"123456789\"), 0xcbf43926);\n        assert_eq!(crc32_hex(b\"\"), \"00000000\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn hex_roundtrip() {\n        let data = vec![0u8, 1, 254, 255, 16, 0xab];\n        let h = to_hex(&data);\n        assert_eq!(h, \"0001feff10ab\");\n        assert_eq!(from_hex(&h).unwrap(), data);\n        assert_eq!(from_hex(\"AB\").unwrap(), vec![0xAB]);\n        assert!(from_hex(\"0\").is_err());\n        assert!(from_hex(\"zz\").is_err());\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_2e54effc394f1eeb992eabd4","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1852,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":29496,"output_tokens":924,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"71f01b92-5afe-4ee5-a87d-8b0368d4b2c5","timestamp":"2026-09-22T15:55:27.664Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

{"parentUuid":"454fc01e-a853-44e6-9649-21df66390072","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_d63xo512dfwcqhif7v8hx4wg","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/src/io.rs","content":"//! 可注入的 I/O 抽象层。\n//!\n//! 引擎不直接调用 [`std::fs`]，而是依赖 [`IoBackend`] trait。\n//! 生产环境使用 [`DiskIo`]（真实文件系统 + 显式 fsync）；\n//! 测试与 HTTP 故障演练使用 [`FaultyIo`] 包装真实磁盘 I/O，\n//! 按“操作类型 + 命中次数”注入 [`EngineError::InjectedFault`]，\n//! 用以模拟检查点发布 / 合并中途崩溃（参见 `storage` 中暂存目录的使用）。\n//!\n//! # 同步边界（durability contract）\n//!\n//! - [`IoBackend::write_atomic`]：写临时文件 -> `fsync(file)` -> `rename` 到目标路径\n//!   -> `fsync(父目录)`。rename 在同一文件系统上是原子的，因此调用方要么看到旧文件、\n//!   要么看到新文件，绝不会看到半截内容。\n//! - 目录发布（暂存目录 rename 为正式检查点目录）同样在 rename 后 fsync 父目录。\n//! - 仅保证单进程内的崩溃一致性；不涉及多进程并发（README 已明确该边界）。\n\nuse crate::error::{EngineError, Result};\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\n/// 可被注入故障的 I/O 操作类别。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, rename/create 落盘）。\n    fn sync_parent(dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        #[cfg(unix)]\n        {\n            use std::os::unix::io::AsRawFd;\n            let f = std::fs::File::open(dir)?;\n *self.plan.lock().unwrap() = None;\n        self.counts.lock().unwrap().clear();\n    }\n\n    /// 当前是否处于武装状态（HTTP 诊断用）。\n    pub fn armed(&self) -> Option<FaultPlanSnapshot> {\n 生产环境使用 [`DiskIo`]（真实文件系统 + 显式 fsync）；\n//! 测试与 HTTP 故障演练使用 [`FaultyIo`] 包装真实磁盘 I/O，\n//! 按“操作类型 + 命中次数”注入 [`EngineError::InjectedFault`]，\n//! 用以模拟检查点发布 / 合并中途崩溃（参见 `storage` 中暂存目录的使用）。\n//!\n//! # 同步边界（durability contract）\n//!\n//! - [`IoBackend::write_atomic`]：写临时文件 -> `fsync(file)` -> `rename` 到目标路径\n//!   -> `fsync(父目录)`。rename 在同一文件系统上是原子的，因此调用方要么看到旧文件、\n//!   要么看到新文件，绝不会看到半截内容。\n//! - 目录发布（暂存目录 rename 为正式检查点目录）同样在 rename 后 fsync 父目录。\n//! - 仅保证单进程内的崩溃一致性；不涉及多进程并发（README 已明确该边界）。\n\nuse crate::error::{EngineError, Result};\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\n/// 可被注入故障的 I/O 操作类别。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]\npub enum Op {\n    /// 写并 fsync 普通文件（state.json、repo.json、meta.json）。\n    WriteAtomic,\n    /// rename 发布动作（暂存目录 -> 正式检查点目录、临时页 -> 正式页）。\n    RenamePublish,\n    /// 目录 fsync。\n    DirSync,\n    /// 创建目录。\n    Mkdir,\n    /// 删除文件/目录。\n    Remove,\n}\n\nimpl Op {\n    /// 故障计划 JSON 中使用的短名。\n    pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            Op::WriteAtomic => \"write_atomic\",\n            Op::RenamePublish => \"rename_publish\",\n            Op::DirSync => \"dir_sync\",\n            Op::Mkdir => \"mkdir\",\n            Op::Remove => \"remove\",\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Option<Op> {\n        Some(match s {\n            \"write_atomic\" => Op::WriteAtomic,\n            \"rename_publish\" => Op::RenamePublish,\n            \"dir_sync\" => Op::DirSync,\n            \"mkdir\" => Op::Mkdir,\n            \"remove\" => Op::Remove,\n            _ => return None,\n        })\n    }\n}\n\n/// 引擎所依赖的全部文件系统操作。\npub trait IoBackend: Send + Sync {\n    /// 递归创建目录（已存在视为成功）。\n    fn mkdir_p(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()>;\n    /// 判断路径是否存在。\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool;\n    /// 读取整个文件。\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<u8>>;\n    /// 读取目录下的条目名（非递归）。\n    fn list_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>>;\n    /// 删除文件或递归删除目录。\n    fn remove(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()>;\n    /// rename（要求同一文件系统）。\n    fn rename(&self, src: &Path, dst: &Path) -> Result<()>;\n    /** 原子发布一个文件：同目录临时文件 + fsync + rename + fsync(父目录)。 */\n    fn write_atomic(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> Result<()>;\n    /** 原子发布一个目录：将 `staging` rename 为 `target`，并 fsync 父目录。 */\n    fn publish_dir(&self, staging: &Path, target: &Path) -> Result<()>;\n}\n\n/// 真实磁盘 I/O。所有持久化写入都走 fsync。\n#[derive(Default)]\npub struct DiskIo;\n\nimpl DiskIo {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        DiskIo\n    }\n\n    /// fsync 目录（Unix 上保证 rename/create 落盘）。\n    fn sync_parent(dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        #[cfg(unix)]\n        {\n            use std::os::unix::io::AsRawFd;\n            let f = std::fs::File::open(dir)?;\n            // 平台返回码已检查；sync 失败必须上抛，不能假装持久化成功。\n            nix_fsync(f.as_raw_fd())?;\n        }\n        #[cfg(not(unix))]\n        {\n            let _ = dir;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nmod sys {\n    extern \"C\" {\n        pub fn fsync(fd: std::os::unix::io::RawFd) -> std::os::raw::c_int;\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nfn nix_fsync(fd: std::os::unix::io::RawFd) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    // 直接 extern \"C\"，避免引入 libc 依赖。\n    let rc = unsafe { sys::fsync(fd) };\n    if rc == 0 {\n        Ok(())\n    } else {\n        Err(std::io::Error::last_os_error())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl IoBackend for DiskIo {\n    fn mkdir_p(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(path)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        path.exists()\n    }\n\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        Ok(std::fs::read(path)?)\n    }\n\n    fn list_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut names = Vec::new();\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(names);\n        }\n        for e in std::fs::read_dir(path)? {\n            names.push(e?.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned());\n        }\n        Ok(names)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        if path.is_dir() {\n            std::fs::remove_dir_all(path)?;\n        } else {\n            std::fs::remove_file(path)?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, src: &Path, dst: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        std::fs::rename(src, dst)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn write_atomic(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        let parent = path.parent().unwrap_or_else(|| Path::new(\".\"));\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n        let tag = file_tag(path);\n        let tmp = parent.join(format!(\".tmp.{tag}.{}\", std::process::id()));\n        {\n            use std::io::Write;\n            let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n                .write(true)\n                .create(true)\n                .truncate(true)\n                .open(&tmp)?;\n            f.write_all(data)?;\n            f.sync_all()?;\n        }\n        std::fs::rename(&tmp, path)?;\n        Self::sync_parent(parent)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn publish_dir(&self, staging: &Path, target: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        if let Some(parent) = target.parent() {\n            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n        }\n        std::fs::rename(staging, target)?;\n        if let Some(parent) = target.parent() {\n            Self::sync_parent(parent)?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nfn file_tag(path: &Path) -> String {\n    // 仅用于临时文件命名，不需要稳定/安全。\n    let s = path.to_string_lossy();\n    let mut h: u64 = 1469598103934665603;\n    for b in s.bytes() {\n        h ^= b as u64;\n        h = h.wrapping_mul(1099511628211);\n    }\n    format!(\"{h:016x}\")\n}\n\n/// 故障计划：对某类操作的第 `trigger_at` 次调用注入错误。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct FaultPlan {\n    pub op: Op,\n    /// 1 起算：第几次命中该类操作时触发（1 = 下一次就触发）。\n    pub trigger_at: u64,\n    /// 触发后是否继续生效（false = one-shot，触发后自动解除）。\n    pub persistent: bool,\n    /// 注入错误时附带的说明。\n    pub note: String,\n}\n\n/// 包装真实磁盘的故障注入 I/O。\npub struct FaultyIo {\n    inner: DiskIo,\n    plan: Mutex<Option<FaultPlan>>,\n    counts: Mutex<BTreeMap<Op, u64>>,\n}\n\nimpl FaultyIo {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        FaultyIo {\n            inner: DiskIo::new(),\n            plan: Mutex::new(None),\n            counts: Mutex::new(BTreeMap::new()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 安装故障计划（替换旧计划，计数器清零）。\n    pub fn arm(&self, plan: FaultPlan) {\n        *self.plan.lock().unwrap() = Some(plan);\n        self.counts.lock().unwrap().clear();\n    }\n\n    /// 解除故障计划。\n    pub fn disarm(&self) {\n        *self.plan.lock().unwrap() = None;\n        self.counts.lock().unwrap().clear();\n    }\n\n    /// 当前是否处于武装状态（HTTP 诊断用）。\n    pub fn armed(&self) -> Option<FaultPlanSnapshot> {\n        self.plan.lock().unwrap().as_ref().map(|p| FaultPlanSnapshot {\n            op: p.op.as_str(),\n            trigger_at: p.trigger_at,\n            persistent: p.persistent,\n            note: p.note.clone(),\n            hits: *self.counts.lock().unwrap().get(&p.op).unwrap_or(&0),\n        })\n    }\n\n    fn gate(&self, op: Op) -> Result<()> {\n        let mut plan_guard = self.plan.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut counts = self.counts.lock().unwrap();\n        let hit = {\n            let c = counts.entry(op).or_insert(0);\n            *c += 1;\n            *c\n        };\n        if let Some(plan) = plan_guard.as_ref() {\n            if plan.op == op && hit == plan.trigger_at {\n                let err = EngineError::InjectedFault(format!(\n                    \"{}（第 {hit} 次 {} 操作）{}\",\n                    plan.note,\n                    op.as_str(),\n                    if plan.persistent { \" [持续故障]\" } else { \"\" }\n                ));\n                if !plan.persistent {\n                    *plan_guard = None;\n                }\n                return Err(err);\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 故障计划的只读快照（用于 HTTP 响应）。\n#[derive(Debug, serde::Serialize)]\npub struct FaultPlanSnapshot {\n    pub op: &'static str,\n    pub trigger_at: u64,\n    pub persistent: bool,\n    pub note: String,\n    pub hits: u64,\n}\n\nimpl IoBackend for FaultyIo {\n    fn mkdir_p(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        self.gate(Op::Mkdir)?;\n        self.inner.mkdir_p(path)\n    }\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        self.inner.exists(path)\n    }\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        self.inner.read(path)\n    }\n    fn list_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        self.inner.list_dir(path)\n    }\n    fn remove(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        self.gate(Op::Remove)?;\n        self.inner.remove(path)\n    }\n    fn rename(&self, src: &Path, dst: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        self.gate(Op::RenamePublish)?;\n        self.inner.rename(src, dst)\n    }\n    fn write_atomic(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        self.gate(Op::WriteAtomic)?;\n        // write_atomic 内部还含 rename/dir_sync，但故障只按操作类别在边界处注入一次，\n        // 避免一个逻辑步骤被多次计数。\n        self.inner.write_atomic(path, data)\n    }\n    fn publish_dir(&self, staging: &Path, target: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        self.gate(Op::RenamePublish)?;\n        self.inner.publish_dir(staging, target)\n    }\n}\n\n/// 类型擦除的共享 I/O 句柄。\npub type SharedIo = Arc<dyn IoBackend>;\n\n/// 同时携带故障注入控制面的句柄（HTTP admin 用）。\npub type SharedFaulty = Arc<FaultyIo>;\n\n/// 供测试构造临时路径辅助。\npub fn tmp_root(label: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    let mut p = std::env::temp_dir();\n    let unique = format!(\n        \"{label}-{}-{}\",\n        std::process::id(),\n        TMP_SEQ.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed)\n    );\n    p.push(unique);\n    p\n}\n\nstatic TMP_SEQ: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64 = std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(0);\n\n/* 说明：as_faulty 的 Any 下行改在 storage.rs 直接持有 Arc<FaultyIo>，\n   本文件底部的 FaultProbe 占位在 lib 初始化时不使用，保留以减少类型体操。 磁盘存储格式与存储库（Repository）。\n#![doc = include_str!(\"../docs/disk-format.md\")]\n\nuse crate::checksum::crc32;\nuse crate::error::{EngineError, Result};\nuse crate::io::{IoBackend, SharedIo};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\n/// 当前磁盘格式版本。\npub const FORMAT_VERSION: u32 = 1;\n/// 全量检查点。\npub const KIND_FULL: &str = \"full\";\n/// 增量检查点。\npub const KIND_INCREMENTAL: &str = \"incremental\";\n/// 合并检查点。\npub const KIND_MERGED: &str = \"merged\";\n\n/// 检查点元数据（同时落盘为每个检查点目录下的 `meta.json`）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct CheckpointMeta {\n    /// 全局唯一 ID，形如 `<数据集名>-seq000007`（合并目标可能为 `<数据集名>-mrg000007`）。\n    pub id: String,\n    /// `full` / `incremental` / `merged`。\n    pub kind: String,\n    /// 父检查点 ID；full/merged 为 null。\n    pub parent: Option<String>,\n    /// 父检查点 meta.json 字节的 CRC32 hex；null 表示无父。\n    pub parent_meta_crc: Option<String>,\n    /// 数据集名。\n    pub dataset: String,\n    /// 数据集内单调递增的序号（state.json 维护）。\n    pub seq: u64,\n    /// 创建时的单调时钟描述（毫秒）。\n    pub created_at_ms: u128,\n    /// 本检查点包含的页。\n    pub pages: BTreeMap<u32, PageEntry>,\n    /// pages 的覆盖页 id 有序列表（与 pages 键一致，便于人工阅读）。\n    pub page_ids: Vec<u32>,\n    /// 合并检查点专用：被合并掉的检查点 ID 列表。\n    pub merged_sources: Vec<String>,\n    /// 合并时的冲突记录（同版本不同内容，按分支侧胜出）。\n    pub conflicts: Vec<MergeConflict>,\n}\n\n/// 检查点中的一页。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct PageEntry {\n    /// 数据集工作页的版本号（从 1 起，每次写入该页 +1）。\n    pub version: u64,\n    /// 页内容字节数（固定等于数据集 page_size）。\n    pub size: u32,\n    /// `pages/p<id>.bin` 的 CRC32（8 位小写 hex）。\n    pub crc: String,\n}\n\n/// 合并冲突记录。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct MergeConflictRecord {\n    pub page: u32,\n    pub version: u64,\n    /// 各来源在该页的 crc。\n    pub source_crc: BTreeMap<String, String>,\n    /// 最终保留的来源。\n    pub winner: String,\n}\n\n// serde 别名，引擎层使用 MergeConflict 名称。\npub type MergeConflict = MergeConflictRecord;\n\n/// 数据集持久状态（`<root>/datasets/<name>/state.json`）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct DatasetState {\n    pub format_version: u32,\n    pub dataset: String,\n    /// 固定页大小（字节）。\n    pub page_size: u32,\n    /// 固定页数。\n    pub page_count: u32,\n    /// 数据集内下一个检查点序号。\n    pub next_seq: u64,\n    /// 每页的当前版本（初始为 0，表示从未写入）。\n    pub page_versions: Vec<u64>,\n    /// 每页当前内容的 crc hex（初始为全零页的 crc）。\n    pub current_crc: Vec<String>,\n    /// 数据集创建时间。\n    pub created_at_ms: u128,\n}\n\n/// 存储库根信息（`<root>/repo.json`）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct RepoInfo {\n    pub format_version: u32,\n    pub engine: String,\n    pub created_at_ms: u128,\n}\n\n/// 文件支持的检查点存储库。\npub struct Repository {\n    root: PathBuf,\n    io: SharedIo,\n}\n\n/// 检查点读取结果（meta + 原始页字节）。\npub struct LoadedCheckpoint {\n    pub meta: CheckpointMeta,\n    pub pages: BTreeMap<u32, Vec<u8>>,\n}\n\n/// 待写入的一页。\npub struct PageToWrite<'a> {\n    pub id: u32,\n    pub data: &'a [u8],\n}\n\nimpl Repository {\n    /// 打开根目录：不存在则报错；存在则扫描回收暂存/半成品。\n    pub fn open(root: impl Into<PathBuf>, io: SharedIo) -> Result<Self> {\n        let root = root.into();\n        if !io.exists(&root) {\n            return Err(EngineError::NotFound(format!(\"存储库目录 {root:?}\")));\n        }\n        let repo = Repository { root, io };\n        repo.cleanup_staging()?;\n        Ok(repo)\n    }\n\n    /// 在空目录上初始化新存储库。\n    pub fn init(root: impl Into<PathBuf>, io: SharedIo) -> Result<Self> {\n        let root = root.into();\n        if io.exists(&root) {\n            let non_empty = io.list_dir(&root)?.iter().any(|n| n != \".\");\n            if non_empty {\n                return Err(EngineError::Conflict(format!(\n                    \"目录 {root:?} 非空，拒绝初始化存储库\"\n                )));\n            }\n        }\n        io.mkdir_p(&root)?;\n        let info = RepoInfo {\n            format_version: FORMAT_VERSION,\n            engine: env!(\"CARGO_PKG_NAME\").to_string(),\n            created_at_ms: now_ms(),\n        };\n        let tmp = root.join(\"repo.json\");\n        io.write_atomic(&tmp, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&info)?)?;\n        io.mkdir_p(&root.join(\"datasets\"))?;\n        Ok(Repository { root, io })\n    }\n\n    pub fn root(&self) -> &Path {\n {\n    pub page: u32,\n    pub version: u64,\n    /// 各来源在该页的 crc。\n    pub source_crc: BTreeMap<String, String>,\n    /// 最终保留的来源。\n    pub winner: String,\n}\n\n// serde 别名，引擎层使用 MergeConflict impl Into<PathBuf>, io: SharedIo) -> Result<Self> {\n        let root = root.into();\n        if !io.exists(&root) {\n            return Err(EngineError::NotFound(format!(\"存储库目录 {root:?}\")));\n        }\n        let repo = Repository { root, io };\n        repo.cleanup_staging()?;\n        Ok(repo)\n    }\n\n    /// 在空目录上初始化新存储库。\n    pub fn init(root: impl Into<PathBuf>, io: SharedIo) -> Result<Self> {\n        let root = root.into();\n        if io.exists(&root) {\n            let non_empty = io.list_dir(&root)?.iter().any(|n| n != \".\");\n            if non_empty {\n                return Err(EngineError::Conflict(format!(\n                    \"目录 {root:?} 非空，拒绝初始化存储库\"\n                )));\n            }\n        }\n        io.mkdir_p(&root)?;\n        let info = RepoInfo {\n            format_version: FORMAT_VERSION,\n            engine: env!(\"CARGO_PKG_NAME\").to_string(),\n            created_at_ms: now_ms(),\n        };\n        let tmp = root.join(\"repo.json\");\n        io.write_atomic(&tmp, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&info)?)?;\n        io.mkdir_p(&root.join(\"datasets\"))?;\n        Ok(Repository { root, io })\n    }\n\n    pub fn root(&self) -> &Path {\n        &self.root\n    }\n\n    pub fn io(&self) -> &SharedIo {\n        &self.io\n    }\n\n    pub fn repo_info(&self) -> Result<RepoInfo> {\n        let bytes = self.io.read(&self.root.join(\"repo.json\"))?;\n        Ok(serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)?)\n    }\n\n    pub fn list_datasets(&self) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let dir = self.root.join(\"datasets\");\n        let mut names: Vec<String> = self\n            .io\n            .list_dir(&dir)?\n            .into_iter()\n            .filter(|n| is_ident(n))\n            .collect();\n        names.sort();\n        Ok(names)\n    }\n\n    fn dataset_dir(&self, name: &str) -> PathBuf {\n        self.root.join(\"datasets\").join(name)\n    }\n\n    fn ckpt_dir(&self, dataset: &str, id: &str) -> PathBuf {\n        self.dataset_dir(dataset).join(\"checkpoints\").join(id)\n    }\n\n    /// 创建固定页数据集（page_size、page_count 此后不可变）。\n    pub fn create_dataset(&self, name: &str, page_size: u32, page_count: u32) -> Result<DatasetState> {\n        validate_ident(name)?;\n        if page_size == 0 {\n            return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(\"page_size 必须 > 0\".into()));\n        }\n        if page_count == 0 {\n            return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(\"page_count 必须 > 0\".into()));\n        }\n        let dir = self.dataset_dir(name);\n        if page_size as usize];\n        let zero_crc = format!(\"{:08x}\", crc32(&zero));\n        let state = DatasetState {\n            format_version: FORMAT_VERSION,\n            dataset: name.to_string(),\n            page_size,\n            page_count,\n            next_seq: 1,\n            page_versions: vec![0; page_count as usize],\n            current_crc: vec![zero_crc; page_count as usize],\n            created_at_ms: now_ms(),\n        };\n        self.write_state(&state)?;\n        Ok(state)\n    }\n\n    /// 读取数据集状态。\n    pub fn load_state(&self, dataset: &str) -> Result<DatasetState> {\n        let path = self.dataset_dir(dataset).join(\"state.json\");\n        if !self.io.exists(&path) {\n            return Err(EngineError::NotFound(format!(\"数据集 {dataset}\")));\n        }\n        let bytes = self.io.read(&path)?;\n        let state: DatasetState = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)?;\n        if state.format_version != FORMAT_VERSION {\n            return Err(EngineError::Conflict(format!(\n                \"数据集 {dataset} 格式版本 {} 不受支持（期望 {FORMAT_VERSION}）\",\n                state.format_version\n            )));\n        }\n        Ok(state)\n    }\n\n    /// 原子覆盖数据集状态。\n    pub fn write_state(&self, state: &DatasetState) -> Result<()> {\n        let path = self.dataset_dir(&state.dataset).join(\"state.json\");\n        self.io.write_atomic(&path, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(state)?)\n    }\n\n    /// 列出数据集下的检查点 ID（按文件名排序，基本等同于 seq 顺序）。\n    pub fn list_checkpoints(&self, dataset: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let dir = self.dataset_dir(dataset).join(\"checkpoints\");\n        let mut ids: Vec<String> = self\n            .io\n            .list_dir(&dir)?\n            .into_iter()\n            .filter(|n| is_ident(n) && self.io.exists(&dir.join(n).join(\"meta.json\")))\n            .collect();\n        ids.sort();\n        Ok(ids)\n    }\n\n    /// 读取检查点元数据。\n    pub fn read_meta(&self, dataset: &str, Err(EngineError::NotFound(format!(\"检查点 {id}\")));\n        }\n        let bytes = self.io.read(&path)?;\n        Ok(serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)?)\n    }\n\n    /// 读取父 meta 字节，用于父校验。\n    fn parent_meta_bytes(&self, dataset: &str, parent: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        let path = self.ckpt_dir(dataset, parent).join(\"meta.json\");\n        if !self.io.exists(&path) {\n            return Err(EngineError::MissingParent {\n                checkpoint: String::new(),\n                missing: parent.to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n        self.io.read(&path)\n    }\n\n    /// 读取一页原始字节并校验 CRC。\n    pub fn read_page(&self, dataset: &str, id: &str, page: u32, entry: &PageEntry) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        let path = self\n            .ckpt_dir(dataset, id)\n            .join(\"pages\")\n            .join(format!(\"p{page}.bin\"));\n        let data = self.io.read(&path).map_err(|_| EngineError::NotFound(format!(\n            \"检查点 {id} 的页 {page} 文件缺失（可能已损坏）\"\n        )))?;\n        let actual = crc32(&data);\n        let expected = u32::from_str_radix(&entry.crc, 16)\n            .map_err(|_| EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\"meta 中 crc 非法: {}\", entry.crc)))?;\n        if actual != expected {\n            return Err(EngineError::ChecksumMismatch {\n                checkpoint: id.to_string(),\n                page,\n                expected,\n &str, id: &str) -> Result<LoadedCheckpoint> {\n        let meta = self.read_meta(dataset, id)?;\n        let mut pages = BTreeMap::new();\n        for (&pid, entry) in &meta.pages {\n            let data = self.read_page(dataset, &meta.id, pid, entry)?;\n            pages.insert(pid, data);\n        }\n        Ok(LoadedCheckpoint { meta, pages })\n    }\n\n    /** 原子发布一个检查点。\n\n    流程（崩溃安全）：\n    1. 分配正式 id 与暂存目录 `.staging.<id>`；\n    2. 写所有页文件 + fsync；写 meta.json + fsync；\n    3. rename 暂存目录为正式目录 + fsync 父目录；\n    4. 原子更新 state.json（推进 next_seq 等）。\n\n    若在 3 之前崩溃：暂存目录留存，open() */\n    pub fn publish_checkpoint(\n        &self,\n        state: &mut DatasetState,\n        id: &str,\n        kind: &str,\n        parent: Option<&str>,\n        pages: &[PageToWrite<'_>],\n        merged_sources: Vec<String>,\n        conflicts: Vec<MergeConflict>,\n    ) -> Result<CheckpointMeta> {\n        // 1. 基础校验\n        let seq = state.next_seq;\n        for p in pages {\n            if p.id >= state.page_count {\n                return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                    \"页 id {} 越界（数据集共 {} 页）\",\n                    p.id, state.page_count\n                )));\n            }\n            if p.data.len() != state.page_size as usize {\n                return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                    \"页 {} 内容长度 {} != 固定页大小 {}\",\n        let parent_meta_crc = match (kind, parent) {\n            (KIND_FULL, None) | (KIND_MERGED, None) => None,\n            (KIND_INCREMENTAL, Some(pid)) => {\n                let bytes = self.parent_meta_bytes(state.dataset(), pid).map_err(|_| {\n                    EngineError::MissingParent {\n                        checkpoint: id.to_string(),\n                        missing: pid.to_string(),\n                    }\n                })?;\n                Some(format!(\"{:08x}\", crc32(&bytes)))\n            }\n            (KIND_INCREMENTAL, None) => {\n                return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(\"增量检查点必须指定 parent\".into()))\n            }\n            (k, Some(p)) => {\n                return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                    \"{k} 检查点不能有父（却指定了 {p}）\"\n                )))\n            }\n            (k, None) => {\n                return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\"未知检查点类型 {k}\")))\n            }\n        };\n\n        // 3. 构造暂存目录并写页。\n        let staging = self\n            .dataset_dir(&state.dataset)\n            .join(\"checkpoints\")\n            .join(format!(\".staging.{id}\"));\n 4. 发布目录（rename + fsync 父目录）—— 这是主要同步边界。\n        let target = self.ckpt_dir(&state.dataset, id);\n        self.io.publish_dir(&staging, &target)?;\n\n        // 5. 推进数据集状态（原子）。\n        state.next_seq += 1;\n        self.write_state(state)?;\n        Ok(meta)\n    }\n\n    /// 删除检查点（GC / 清理孤儿）。\n    pub fn remove_checkpoint(&self, dataset: &str, id: &str) -> Result<()> {\n self.root.join(\"datasets\");\n        for name in self.io.list_dir(&ds_root)? {\n            if !is_ident(&name) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            let ds_dir = ds_root.join(&name);\n            let ckpts = ds_dir.join(\"checkpoints\");\n            let orphans = ds_dir.join(\".orphans\");\n            let entries = match self.io.list_dir(&ckpts) {\n {"parentUuid":"aee0ad7e-0e1e-43d6-82f7-c52e16a435fd","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_wgyepulft5vpzuazccduh5ov","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/src/engine.rs","content":"//! 检查点引擎：固定页数据集上的全量/增量检查点、严格父链恢复与合并。\n//!\n//! ## 核心概念\n//!\n//! - **固定页数据集**：创建时锁定 `page_size`（字节）与 `page_count`，之后所有\n//!   页写入必须恰好 `page_size` 字节，页 id 落在 `0..page_count`。\n//!\n//! - **页版本（page version）**：每页维护从 1 起的单调版本号，工作集每写一次\n//!   该页版本 +1。检查点为包含的每一页记录写入时的版本与内容 CRC。\n//!\n//! - **全量检查点（full）**：包含全部页，`parent = null`。一个数据集可以有多条\n//!   全量链根；从某个全量检查点恢复即得到该检查点的完整内容。\n//!\n//! - **增量检查点（incremental）**：只包含自父检查点以来版本变高的页（实际实现为\n//!   “调用 checkpoint 时显式收集的脏页集合”，但要求每页版本严格高于父链上的\n//!   已知版本，否则拒绝发布），`parent` 指向上一个检查点（full 或 incremental）。\n//!\n//! - **严格父链恢复**：恢复 incremental 必须递归/迭代走到链根（full/merged），\n//!   按从根到尖的顺序应用；父 meta 文件缺失 -> [`EngineError::MissingParent`]；\n//!   链上出现重复 id -> [`EngineError::CycleDetected`]；CRC 不符 ->\n//!   [`EngineError::ChecksumMismatch`]；页版本在链上回退 ->\n//!   [`EngineError::VersionRegression`]。没有“猜测最近 full”的捷径。\n~~~\n//!\n//! ## 合并\n//!\n//! `merge_checkpoints(base, tip)`：取 `base`（须为 full/merged）与它的某条严格\n//! 后代链 `tip`，把 `base..=tip` 的累积效果压缩成一个新的 full（`kind = merged`，\n//! 无父，记录 `merged_sources`）。合并的全部磁盘写入先入暂存目录再原子 rename\n//! 发布；故障注入若让发布中断，磁盘上不会出现“半成品 merged 检查点”。\n\nuse crate::checksum::crc32;\nuse crate::error::{EngineError, Result};\nuse crate::storage::{\n    now_ms, CheckpointMeta, DatasetState, KIND_FULL, KIND_INCREMENTAL, KIND_MERGED,\n    MergeConflict, PageEntry, PageToWrite, Repository,\n};\nuse std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\n\n/// 引擎：绑定一个存储库，提供数据集/页/检查点操作。\npub struct Engine {\n    repo: Repository,\n}\n\n/// 恢复结果描述。\n#[derive(Debug, serde::Serialize)]\npub struct RestoreReport {\n    pub target: String,\n    /// 沿依赖链实际应用的检查点 id（从根到尖）。\n    pub chain: Vec<String>,\n    /// 每个被应用的检查点各写入了哪些页。\n    pub applied_pages: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u32>>,\n    /// 恢复完成后工作集页摘要。\n    pub digest: Vec<PageDigest>,\n}\n\n/// 单页摘要。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize)]\npub struct PageDigest {\n    pub page: u32,\n    pub version: u64,\n    pub size: u32,\n    /// 工作集当前内容的 CRC32 hex。\n    pub crc: String,\n}\n\n/// 合并结果。\n#[derive(Debug, serde::Serialize)]\npub struct MergeReport {\n    pub base: String,\n    pub tip: String,\n    pub merged_id: String,\n    /// 被压缩掉的检查点（base 之后、tip 及之前的链上节点；base 本身保留）。\n    pub sources: BTreeSet<String>,\n    /// 链上各检查点包含的页数。\n    pub page_counts: BTreeMap<String, usize>,\n    /// 合并检查点自身的页数（应当 = page_count，因为 base 是 full）。\n    pub merged_page_count: usize,\n    pub digest_before_gc: Vec<PageDigest>,\n}\n\nimpl Engine {\n    pub fn open(root: impl Into<PathBuf>, io: crate::io::SharedIo) -> Result<Self> {\n        Ok(Engine {\n            repo: Repository::open(root, io)?,\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn init(root: impl Into<PathBuf>, io: crate::io::SharedIo) -> Result<Self> {\n        Ok(Engine {\n            repo: Repository::init(root, io)?,\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn repo(&self) -> &Repository {\n        &self.repo\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 数据集 ----------\n\n    pub fn create_dataset(&self, name: &str, page_size: u32, page_count: u32) -> Result<DatasetState> {\n        self.repo.create_dataset(name, page_size, page_count)\n    }\n\n    pub fn state(&self, dataset: &str) -> Result<DatasetState> {\n        self.repo.load_state(dataset)\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 页写入 ----------\n\n    /// 向工作集写一页（内容必须恰好为 page_size 字节）。\n    /// 页版本 +1，内容 CRC 更新；工作页文件原子覆盖（fsync）。\n    pub fn write_page(&self, dataset: &str, page: u32, data: &[u8]) -> Result<PageDigest> {\n        let mut state = self.repo.load_state(dataset)?;\n        if page >= state.page_count {\n            return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                \"页 id {page} 越界（共 {} 页）\",\n                state.page_count\n            )));\n        }\n        if data.len() != state.page_size as usize {\n            return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                \"页内容长度 {} != 固定页大小 {}\",\n                data.len(),\n                state.page_size\n            )));\n        }\n        self.repo.write_working_page(dataset, page, data)?;\n        state.page_versions[page as usize] += 1;\n        state.current_crc[page as usize] = format!(\"{:08x}\", crc32(data));\n        self.repo.write_state(&state)?;\n        Ok(PageDigest {\n            page,\n            version: state.page_versions[page as usize],\n            size: state.page_size,\n            crc: state.current_crc[page as usize].clone(),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 读一页工作集内容（未写过则为全零）。\n    pub fn read_page(&self, dataset: &str, page: u32) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, PageDigest)> {\n        let state = self.repo.load_state(dataset)?;\n        if page >= state.page_count {\n            return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                \"页 id {page} 越界（共 {} 页）\",\n                state.page_count\n            )));\n        }\n        let data = self.repo.read_working_page(&state, page)?;\n        Ok((\n            data,\n            PageDigest {\n                page,\n                version: state.page_versions[page as usize],\n                size: state.page_size,\n                crc: state.current_crc[page as usize].clone(),\n            },\n        ))\n    }\n\n    /// 当前工作集逐页摘要。\n    pub fn digest(&self, dataset: &str) -> Result<Vec<PageDigest>> {\n        let state = self.repo.load_state(dataset)?;\n        Ok((0..state.page_count)\n            .map(|p| PageDigest {\n                page: p,\n                version: state.page_versions[p as usize],\n                size: state.page_size,\n                crc: state.current_crc[p as usize].clone(),\n            })\n            .collect())\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 检查点 ----------\n\n    fn allocate_id(&self, state: &DatasetState, tag: &str) -> String {\n        format!(\"{}-{}{:06}\", state.dataset, tag, state.next_seq)\n    }\n\n    /// 创建全量检查点：固化全部页（从工作集读取）。\n    /// 必须传入**当前全部页内容**？不——全量直接从工作集逐页落盘。\n    pub fn checkpoint_full(&self, dataset: &str) -> Result<CheckpointMeta> {\n        let mut state = self.repo.load_state(dataset)?;\n        let id = self.allocate_id(&state, \"cp\");\n        let mut pages: Vec<(u32, Vec<u8>)> = Vec::with_capacity(state.page_count as usize);\n        for p in 0..state.page_count {\n            pages.push((p, self.repo.read_working_page(&state, p)?));\n        }\n        let to_write: Vec<PageToWrite<'_>> = pages\n            .iter()\n            .map(|(id, data)| PageToWrite {\n                id: *id,\n                version: state.page_versions[*id as usize],\n                data,\n            })\n            .collect();\n        let meta = self.repo.publish_checkpoint(\n            &mut state,\n            &id,\n            KIND_FULL,\n            None,\n            &to_write,\n            vec![],\n            vec![],\n        )?;\n        state.tip = Some(meta.id.clone());\n        self.repo.write_state(&state)?;\n        Ok(meta)\n    }\n\n    /// 创建增量检查点，默认挂在 state.tip 上。\n    /// `pages` 为要固化的页 id 列表；这些页的当前版本必须严格高于\n    /// 父链上对应页的已知版本。\n    pub fn checkpoint_incremental(\n        &self,\n        dataset: &str,\n        parent: Option<&str>,\n        pages: &[u32],\n    ) -> Result<CheckpointMeta> {\n        let mut state = self.repo.load_state(dataset)?;\n        let parent_id = match parent {\n            Some(p) => p.to_string(),\n            None => state\n                .tip\n                .clone()\n                .ok_or_else(|| {\n                    EngineError::BadRequest(\"数据集尚无检查点，增量必须显式指定 parent 或先建全量\".into())\n                })?,\n        };\n\n        // 去重 + 越界检查。\n        let mut wanted: BTreeSet<u32> = BTreeSet::new();\n        for p in pages {\n            if *p >= state.page_count {\n                return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                    \"页 id {p} 越界（共 {} 页）\",\n                    state.page_count\n                )));\n            }\n            wanted.insert(*p);\n        }\n        if wanted.is_empty() {\n            return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(\n                \"增量检查点至少包含一页\".into(),\n            ));\n        }\n\n        // 取父检查点，沿父链（不含父的更早祖先）计算每页已知最大版本。\n        // 严格性：父链必须完整无环，否则 walk 直接报错。\n        let parent_meta = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, &parent_id)?;\n        let chain = self.resolve_chain(dataset, &parent_id)?; // root..=parent\n        let mut known_versions: BTreeMap<u32, u64> = BTreeMap::new();\n        for cid in &chain {\n            let m = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, cid)?;\n            for (pid, e) in &m.pages {\n                known_versions\n                    .entry(*pid)\n                    .and_modify(|v| *v = (*v).max(e.version))\n                    .or_insert(e.version);\n            }\n        }\n\n        let mut payload: Vec<(u32, Vec<u8>)> = Vec::new();\n        for pid in &wanted {\n            let cur_ver = state.page_versions[*pid as usize];\n            if let Some(&kv) = known_versions.get(pid) {\n                if cur_ver <= kv {\n                    return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                        \"页 {pid} 版本 {cur_ver} 未高于父链已知版本 {kv}，增量中不允许旧页/重复页\"\n                    )));\n                }\n            }\n            // 链上从无此页记录（理论上 full 根覆盖全部页，不会发生；防御性保留）。\n            let data = self.repo.read_working_page(&state, *pid)?;\n            payload.push((*pid, data));\n        }\n\n        let id = self.allocate_id(&state, \"cp\");\n        let to_write: Vec<PageToWrite<'_>> = payload\n            .iter()\n            .map(|(pid, data)| PageToWrite {\n                id: *pid,\n                version: state.page_versions[*pid as usize],\n                data,\n            })\n            .collect();\n        let meta = self.repo.publish_checkpoint(\n            &mut state,\n            &id,\n            KIND_INCREMENTAL,\n            Some(&parent_id),\n            &to_write,\n            vec![],\n            vec![],\n        )?;\n        state.tip = Some(meta.id.clone());\n        self.repo.write_state(&state)?;\n        let _ = parent_meta;\n        Ok(meta)\n    }\n\n    /// 列出检查点（含 meta 概要）。\n    pub fn list_checkpoints(&self, dataset: &str) -> Result<Vec<CheckpointMeta>> {\n        let ids = self.repo.list_checkpoints(dataset)?;\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        for id in ids {\n            out.push(self.repo.read_meta(dataset, &id)?);\n        }\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 严格父链 ----------\n\n    /** 解析检查点 `tip` 的依赖链：返回从链根（full/merged）到 tip 的 id 序列。\n\n    严格规则：\n    - full/merged：parent 必须为 null，链为自身；\n    - incremental：parent 必须存在且类型合法，沿 parent 向上直到 full/merged；\n    - 父 meta 文件缺失 -> MissingParent；\n    - 路径上重复出现某 id -> CycleDetected（循环依赖）；\n    - incremental 的父若是 incremental/full/merged 之外的类型 -> BadRequest。\n    */\n    pub fn resolve_chain(&self, dataset: &str, tip: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        // 先确认 tip 存在（给出清晰的 NotFound）。\n        let first = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, tip)?;\n        let mut up = Vec::new();\n        let mut cur_id = first.id.clone();\n        let mut seen: BTreeSet<String> = BTreeSet::new();\n        loop {\n            if !seen.insert(cur_id.clone()) {\n                return Err(EngineError::CycleDetected(cur_id));\n            }\n            let meta = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, &cur_id)?;\n            match meta.kind.as_str() {\n                KIND_FULL | KIND_MERGED => {\n                    if meta.parent.is_some() {\n                        return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                            \"检查点 {} 声明为 {} 却带有 parent\",\n                            meta.id, meta.kind\n                        )));\n                    }\n                    up.push(meta.id.clone());\n                    break;\n                }\n                KIND_INCREMENTAL => {\n                    let parent = meta.parent.clone().ok_or_else(|| {\n                        EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                            \"增量检查点 {} 缺少 parent\",\n                            meta.id\n                        ))\n                    })?;\n                    up.push(meta.id.clone());\n                    // 检查父文件确实存在，错误里带上当前检查点。\n                    if !self.repo.io().exists(\n                        &self\n                            .repo()\n                            // 借用一个内部路径：直接用 read_meta 触达\n                            .root()\n                            .join(\"datasets\")\n                            .join(dataset)\n                            .join(\"checkpoints\")\n                            .join(&parent)\n                            .join(\"meta.json\"),\n                    ) {\n                        return Err(EngineError::MissingParent {\n                            checkpoint: cur_id,\n                            missing: parent,\n                        });\n                    }\n                    cur_id = parent;\n                }\n                k => {\n                    return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                        \"检查点 {cur_id} 的类型 {k} 不受支持\"\n                    )));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        up.reverse();\n        Ok(up)\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 恢复 ----------\n\n    /** 严格沿依赖链恢复 `tip` 到工作集。\n\n    步骤：\n    1. resolve_chain 得到 root..=tip（任何缺失/环/坏类型立即失败）；\n    2. 从全零页开始，按链顺序应用每个检查点中**通过 CRC 校验**的页；\n    3. {"parentUuid":"80ab1322-6628-48a0-9f81-fbd1bc35a76f","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_8uohk8lb8ras4gy8grn7mmdx","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/src/http.rs","content":"//! 本地 HTTP 验证入口（仅依赖标准库，无第三方 HTTP 框架）。\n//!\n//! 所有响应（除明确的 octet-stream）均为 JSON：\n//! 成功 `{\"ok\":true,\"data\":...}`，失败 `{\"ok\":false,\"error\":{\"code\":...,\"message\":...}}`。\n//!\n//! 接口总览（详见 `docs/api.md` 与 `examples/requests.http`）：\n//!\n//! | 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |\n//! |---|---|---|\n//! | GET | `/healthz` | 健康检查/版本 |\n//! | POST | `/datasets` | 创建固定页数据集 |\n//! | GET | `/datasets` | 列出数据集 |\n//! | GET | `/datasets/{name}` | 数据集状态 |\n//! | DELETE | `/datasets/{name}` | 删除数据集 |\n//! | GET | `/datasets/{name}/digest` | 当前工作集逐页摘要 |\n//! | PUT | `/datasets/{name}/pages/{page}` | 写一页（JSON hex 或 raw bytes） |\n//! | GET | `/datasets/{name}/pages/{page}` | 读一页（默认 hex；`?format=raw` 取字节） |\n//! | POST | `/datasets/{name}/checkpoints/full` | 全量检查点 |\n//! | POST | `/datasets/{name}/checkpoints/incremental` | 增量检查点 |\n//! | GET | `/datasets/{name}/checkpoints` | 列出检查点 |\n//! | GET | `/datasets/{name}/checkpoints/{id}` | 检查点元数据 |\n//! | GET | `/datasets/{name}/checkpoints/{id}/chain` | 严格解析依赖链 |\n//! | POST | `/datasets/{name}/checkpoints/{id}/restore` | 沿依赖链恢复 |\n//! | POST | `/datasets/{name}/merge` | `{base,tip,compact?}` 合并检查点 |\n//! | GET | `/datasets/{name}/orphans` | 查看被隔离的半成品目录 |\n//! | POST | `/faults` | 武装故障注入 `{op,trigger_at,persistent?,note?}` |\n//! | GET | `/faults` | 查看当前故障计划 |\n//! | DELETE | `/faults` | 解除故障计划 |\n//! | POST | `/datasets/{name}/checkpoints/{id}/corrupt` | 损坏某页文件（CRC 演练） |\n//! | POST | `/datasets/{name}/checkpoints/{id}/rewire` | 改写 parent（循环依赖演练） |\n//! | POST | `/datasets/{name}/checkpoints/{id}/delete` | 删除检查点目录（父链缺失演练） |\n\nuse crate::checksum::from_hex;\nuse crate::engine::Engine;\nuse crate::error::EngineError;\nuse crate::io::{FaultPlan, FaultyIo, Op, SharedFaulty};\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\n/// HTTP 应用：引擎 + 可选的故障注入控制面。\npub struct App {\n    pub engine: Engine,\n    pub faulty: Option<SharedFaulty>,\n}\n\nimpl App {\n    pub fn new(engine: Engine, faulty: Option<Arc<FaultyIo>>) -> Self {\n        App { engine, faulty }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 处理一条已接受的连接（服务器每连接调一次）。\npub fn handle_connection(app: &App, mut stream: &TcpStream) {\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10))).ok();\n    stream.set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10))).ok();\n    match serve(app, stream) {\n        Ok(()) => {}\n        Err(e) if e.is_client_disconnect() => {}\n        Err(e) => {\n            let _ = send_json(stream, 500, &err_envelope(\"internal\", &e.to_string()));\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstruct Request {\n    method: String,\n    path: String,\n    query: String,\n    content_type: String,\n    body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nstruct HttpError {\n    status: u16,\n    code: &'static str,\n    message: String,\n}\n\nimpl HttpError {\n    fn client_disconnect() -> Self {\n        HttpError {\n            status: 0,\n            code: \"client_disconnect\",\n            message: String::new(),\n        }\n    }\n    fn is_client_disconnect(&self) -> bool {\n        self.status == 0\n    }\n}\n\nfn ok_json(v: impl serde::Serialize) -> serde_json::Value {\n    serde::json!({\"ok\": true, \"data\": v})\n}\n\nfn err_envelope<'a>(code: &'a str, message: &str) -> serde::json::JsonOkHack<'a> {\n    // 实际返回 Value，见下面重载；保留薄封装以免到处写 json!。\n    serde::json::JsonOkHack { code, message }\n}\n\nfn serve(app: &App, stream: &TcpStream) -> std::result::Result<(), HttpError> {\n    let req = read_request(stream)?;\n    let segs: Vec<&str> = req\n        .path\n        .trim_matches('/')\n        .split('/')\n        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())\n        .collect();\n\n    let response: std::result::Result<(u16, serde_json::Value), HttpError> =\n        route(app, &req, &segs);\n\n    match response {\n        Ok((status, val)) => {\n            send_json(stream, status, &val)?;\n        }\n        Err(e) if e.is_client_disconnect() => return Err(e),\n        Err(e) => {\n            let val = serde::json!({\n                \"ok\": false,\n                \"error\": {\"code\": e.code, \"message\": e.message}\n            });\n            send_json(stream, e.status, &val)?;\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn read_request(stream: &TcpStream) -> std::result::Result<Request, HttpError> {\n    let mut reader = std::io::BufReader::new(stream);\n    let mut request_line = String::new();\n    use std::io::BufRead;\n    if reader.read_line(&mut request_line)? == 0 {\n        return Err(HttpError::client_disconnect());\n    }\n    let mut parts = request_line.trim_end().split_whitespace();\n    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n    let target = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n    let version = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"HTTP/1.1\").to_string();\n    if method.is_empty() || target.is_empty() {\n        return Err(http400(\"malformed_request\", \"请求行无法解析\"));\n    }\n    let (path, query) = match target.split_once('?') {\n        Some((p, q)) => (p.to_string(), q.to_string()),\n        None => (target, String::new()),\n    };\n\n    let mut content_length = 0usize;\n    let mut content_type = String::new();\n    loop {\n        let mut line = String::new();\n        if reader.read_line(&mut line)? == 0 {\n            break;\n        }\n        let l = line.trim_end();\n        if l.is_empty() {\n            break;\n        }\n        if let Some((k, v)) = l.split_once(':') {\n            match k.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {\n                \"content-length\" => content_length = v.trim().parse().unwrap_or(0),\n                \"content-type\" => content_type = v.trim().to_string(),\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    let mut body = vec![0u8; content_length];\n    if content_length > 0 {\n        reader.read_exact(&mut body)?;\n    }\n    let _ = version;\n    Ok(Request {\n        method,\n        path,\n        query,\n        content_type,\n        body,\n    })\n}\n\nfn send_json(\n    stream: &TcpStream,\n    status: u16,\n    value: &serde_json::Value,\n) -> std::result::Result<(), HttpError> {\n    let body = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(value).unwrap_or_default();\n    send_bytes(stream, status, \"application/json; charset=utf-8\", &body)\n}\n\nfn send_bytes(\n    stream: &TcpStream,\n    status: u16,\n    content_type: &str,\n    body: &[u8],\n) -> std::result::Result<(), HttpError> {\n    let reason = reason_phrase(status);\n    let head = format!(\n        \"HTTP/1.1 {status} {reason}\\r\\nContent-Type: {content_type}\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\",\n        body.len()\n    );\n    let mut s = stream.try_clone().map_err(io_err)?;\n    s.write_all(head.as_bytes()).map_err(io_err)?;\n    s.write_all(body).map_err(io_err)?;\n    s.flush().map_err(io_err)?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn reason_phrase(status: u16) -> &'static str {\n    match status {\n        200 => \"OK\",\n        201 => \"Created\",\n        400 => \"Bad Request\",\n        404 => \"Not Found\",\n        409 => \"Conflict\",\n        500 => \"Internal Server Error\",\n        _ => \"OK\",\n    }\n}\n\nfn http400(code: &'static str, msg: impl Into<String>) -> HttpError {\n    HttpError {\n        status: 400,\n        code,\n        message: msg.into(),\n    }\n}\nfn http404(msg: impl Into<String>) -> HttpError {\n    HttpError {\n        status: 404,\n        code: \"not_found\",\n        message: msg.into(),\n    }\n}\nfn http409(msg: impl Into<String>) -> HttpError {\n    HttpError {\n        status: 409,\n        code: \"conflict\",\n        message: handle_connection(app: &App, mut stream: &TcpStream) {\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10))).ok();\n    stream.set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10))).ok();\n    match {"parentUuid":"9ede2cbb-2c9d-4496-9277-1d925657e002","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_axp58r377pkwmpjk4naeo3nb","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/src/server.rs","content":"//! HTTP 服务装配：阻塞式 TcpListener，每连接一个线程。\n//!\n//! 明确边界：这是一个**本地验证入口**，默认只绑定 `127.0.0.1`，\n//! 不做认证、TLS、压缩、HTTP/2 与并发写协调。引擎本身面向单进程使用。\n\nuse crate::http::App;\nuse crate::io::{DiskIo, FaultyIo, SharedIo};\nuse std::net::TcpListener;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::thread;\n\n/// 服务配置。\npub struct ServerConfig {\n    pub addr: String,\n    /// 是否启用故障注入控制面（/faults）。\n    pub faulty: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Default for ServerConfig {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        ServerConfig {\n            addr: \"127.0.0.1:8088\".to_string(),\n            faulty: true,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 启动并阻塞当前线程直到进程退出。\npub fn run(root: &std::path::Path, cfg: ServerConfig) -> crate::error::Result<()> {\n    let (io, faulty): (SharedIo, Option<Arc<FaultyIo>>) = if cfg.faulty {\n        let f = Arc::new(FaultyIo::new());\n        (f.clone() as SharedIo, Some(f))\n    } else {\n        (Arc::new(DiskIo::new()) as SharedIo, None)\n    };\n\n    // 根目录存在则打开（执行崩溃恢复清理），否则初始化。\n    let engine = if root.exists() {\n        crate::engine::Engine::open(root, io)?\n    } else {\n        crate::engine::Engine::init(root, io)?\n    };\n    let app = Arc::new(App::new(engine, faulty));\n\n    let listener = TcpListener::bind(&cfg.addr).map_err(std::io::Error::from)?;\n    eprintln!(\n        \"[cpengine] 存储根目录: {root:?}\\n[cpengine] 监听: http://{}{}\",\n        cfg.addr,\n        if cfg.faulty {\n            \"\\n[cpengine] 故障注入: 已启用 (POST /faults)\"\n        } else {\n            \"\\n[cpengine] 故障注入: 已禁用\"\n        }\n    );\n\n    for stream in listener.incoming() {\n        match stream {\n            Ok(stream) => {\n                let app = Arc::clone(&app);\n                thread::spawn(move || {\n                    crate::http::handle_connection(&app, &stream);\n                });\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                eprintln!(\"[cpengine] accept 失败: {e}\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_f094aaac3859fbb861baa4d8","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":4071,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":66360,"output_tokens":732,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"1d2098ed-bfb2-4d59-9c0f-f16e4f33cd7b","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:14:00.951Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

{"parentUuid":"5104d695-88a3-48aa-ae5c-99162b816d77","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_jj8483a50v84ad4sdr2pj0i9","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/src/main.rs","content":"//! 增量检查点引擎 —— 本地 HTTP 验证入口。\n//!\n//! 用法：\n//! ```text\n//! cpengine --root ./data --addr 127.0.0.1:8088 [--no-faulty]\n//! ```\n\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\n\nfn main() {\n    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();\n    let mut root = PathBuf::from(\"./cpengine-data\");\n    let mut addr = \"127.0.0.1:8088\".to_string();\n    let mut faulty = true;\n    let mut help = false;\n\n    let mut i = 1;\n    while i < args.len() {\n        match args[i].as_str() {\n            \"--root\" => {\n                i += 1;\n                root = PathBuf::from(args.get(i).unwrap_or_else(|| usage_die(\"--root 缺少参数\"));\n            }\n            \"--addr\" => {\n                i += 1;\n                addr = args.get(i).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| usage_die(\"--addr 缺少参数\"));\n            }\n            \"--no-faulty\" => faulty = false,\n            \"-h\" | \"--help\" => help = true,\n            other => {\n                eprintln!(\"未知参数: {other}\");\n                usage_die(\"参数错误\");\n            }\n        }\n        i += 1;\n    }\n\n    if help {\n        print_help();\n        return;\n    }\n\n    let cfg = cpengine::server::ServerConfig { addr, faulty };\n    if let Err(e) = cpengine::server::run(&root, cfg) {\n        eprintln!(\"启动失败: {e}\");\n        std::process::exit(1);\n    }\n}\n\nfn usage_die(msg: &str) -> ! {\n    eprintln!(\"{msg}\");\n    print_help();\n    std::process::exit(2)\n}\n\nfn print_help() {\n    println!(\n        \"增量检查点引擎 (incremental-checkpoint-engine)\\n\\\n\\n\\\n用法:\\n  cpengine [--root DIR] [--addr HOST:PORT] [--no-faulty]\\n\\\n\\n\\\n选项:\\n\\\n  --root DIR        存储库根目录（不存在则初始化），默认 ./cpengine-data\\n\\\n  --addr HOST:PORT  本地监听地址，默认 127.0.0.1:8088\\n\\\n  --no-faulty       禁用 /faults 故障注入控制面\\n\\\n  -h, --help        显示本帮助\\n\"\n    );\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_76346b7b549359ff94ec9b7f","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1781,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":69432,"output_tokens":684,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"90aaeed1-8bd8-40c4-af45-174837804b2d","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:15:15.465Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

{"parentUuid":"c42be4b2-5c3c-4963-bb1c-20d5a19e21d7","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_i6kolt4vycpz1xqu7odgrux0","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/tests/common/mod.rs","content":"//! 集成测试公共辅助：临时目录、引擎构造、参考模型。\n#![allow(dead_code)]\n\nuse cpengine::engine::{digest_equal, pattern_page, Engine, PageDigest};\nuse cpengine::io::{DiskIo, FaultyIo, SharedIo};\nuse cpengine::storage::CheckpointMeta;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nstatic SEQ: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n\n/// 创建一个全新的临时存储根目录并返回（目录不存在，由引擎 init）。\npub fn temp_root(label: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    let n = SEQ.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n    let mut p = std::env::temp_dir();\n    p.push(format!(\n        \"cpengine-it-{label}-{}-{n}\",\n        std::process::id()\n    ));\n    // 清理可能的残留并确保不存在。\n    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&p);\n    p\n}\n\n/// 用真实磁盘 I/O 初始化引擎。\npub fn disk_engine(label: &str) -> (Engine, PathBuf) {\n    let root = temp_root(label);\n    let io: SharedIo = Arc::new(DiskIo::new());\n    let e = Engine::init(&root, io).expect(\"init repo\");\n    (e, root)\n}\n\n/// 用可注入故障的 I/O 初始化引擎。\npub fn faulty_engine(label: &str) -> (Engine, Arc<FaultyIo>, PathBuf) {\n    let root = temp_root(label);\n    let f = Arc::new(FaultyIo::new());\n    let io: SharedIo = f.clone();\n    let e = Engine::init(&root, io).expect(\"init repo\");\n    (e, f, root)\n}\n\n/// 在已存在的根目录上重新打开引擎（模拟进程重启）。\npub fn reopen_disk(root: &std::path::Path) -> Engine {\n    let io: SharedIo = Arc::new(DiskIo::new());\n    Engine::open(root, io).expect(\"reopen repo\")\n}\n\npub fn reopen_faulty(root: &std::path::Path, faulty: Arc<FaultyIo>) -> Engine {\n    let io: SharedIo = faulty.clone();\n    Engine::open(root, io).expect(\"reopen repo\")\n}\n\n/// 参考模型：逐次更新的固定页数据集镜像。\n///\n/// 与引擎并行执行同样的操作序列；任何时候它的摘要都应当等于\n/// `engine.digest()`，恢复/合并后也必须一致。\npub struct ReferenceModel {\n    pub page_size: u32,\n    pub data: Vec<Vec<u8>>,\n    pub versions: Vec<u64>,\n}\n\nimpl ReferenceModel {\n    pub fn new(page_size: u32, page_count: u32) -> Self {\n        ReferenceModel {\n            page_size,\n            data: vec![vec![0u8; page_size as usize]; page_count as usize],\n            versions: vec![0; page_count as usize],\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn write_page(&mut self, page: u32, data: Vec<u8>) {\n        assert_eq!(data.len(), self.page_size as usize);\n        self.data[page as usize] = data;\n        self.versions[page as usize] += 1;\n    }\n\n    pub fn patterned(&mut self, page: u32, tag: u8) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let d = pattern_page(self.page_size as usize, tag);\n        self.write_page(page, d.clone());\n        d\n    }\n\n    pub fn digest(&self) -> Vec<PageDigest> {\n        self.data\n            .iter()\n            .zip(&self.versions)\n            .enumerate()\n            .map(|(i, (bytes, v))| PageDigest {\n                page: i as u32,\n                version: *v,\n                size: self.page_size,\n                crc: format!(\"{:08x}\", cpengine::checksum::crc32(bytes)),\n            })\n            .collect()\n    }\n\n    /// 参考模型恢复：直接返回某时刻应有的摘要（数据由调用方维护版本）。\n    pub fn assert_matches(&self, engine: &Engine, dataset: &str) {\n        let actual = engine.digest(dataset).expect(\"digest\");\n        let expected = self.digest();\n        assert!(\n            digest_equal(&actual, &expected),\n            \"引擎摘要与参考模型不一致\\n引擎: {}\\n参考: {}\",\n            cpengine::engine::digest_text(&actual),\n            cpengine::engine::digest_text(&expected)\n        );\n    }\n}\n\n/// 建数据集并返回其元信息。\npub fn make_dataset(engine: &Engine, name: &str, page_size: u32, page_count: u32) {\n    engine\n        .create_dataset(name, page_size, page_count)\n        .expect(\"create dataset\");\n}\n\n/// 便捷：写一页 pattern。\npub fn put_pattern(engine: &Engine, ds: &str, page: u32, tag: u8, size: usize) -> CheckpointMeta {\n    let d = pattern_page(size, tag);\n    engine.write_page(ds, page, &d).expect(\"write page\");\n    // 该函数返回值用不上时调用方可丢弃；这里返回一个无用占位会破坏签名，\n    // 故不使用本函数返回 meta —— 见 put_only。\n    unreachable!(\"put_pattern 不返回 meta；请用 put_only\")\n}\n\n/// 仅写一页。\npub fn put_only(engine: &Engine, ds: &str, page: u32, tag: u8, size: usize) {\n    let d = pattern_page(size, tag);\n    engine.write_page(ds, page, &d).expect(\"write page\");\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_2c92f84be1cdae9bcbca22dd","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":448,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":73528,"output_tokens":1460,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"e5db27a5-2e6f-4958-b51b-42cf1c02d085","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:19:12.061Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

{"parentUuid":"e8065ded-64c9-46c4-98a0-0d573c78a36a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_oq5ejpya86dr72adsbemuatj","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/src/server.rs","content":"//! HTTP 服务装配：阻塞式 TcpListener，每连接一个线程。\n//!\n//! 明确边界：这是一个**本地验证入口**，默认只绑定 `127.0.0.1`，\n//! 不做认证、TLS、压缩、HTTP/2 与并发写协调。引擎本身面向单进程使用。\n\nuse crate::http::App;\nuse crate::io::{DiskIo, FaultyIo, SharedIo};\nuse std::net::TcpListener;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::thread;\n\n/// 服务配置。\npub struct ServerConfig {\n    pub addr: String,\n    /// 是否启用故障注入控制面（/faults）。\n    pub faulty: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Default for ServerConfig {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        ServerConfig {\n            addr: \"127.0.0.1:8088\".to_string(),\n            faulty: true,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 构造应用：根目录存在则打开（执行崩溃恢复清理），否则初始化。\npub fn build_app(root: &Path, faulty: bool) -> crate::error::Result<(App, Option<Arc<FaultyIo>>)> {\n    let (io, faulty): (SharedIo, Option<Arc<FaultyIo>>) = if faulty {\n        let f = Arc::new(FaultyIo::new());\n        (f.clone() as SharedIo, Some(f))\n    } else {\n        (Arc::new(DiskIo::new()) as SharedIo, None)\n    };\n    let engine = if root.exists() {\n        crate::engine::Engine::open(root, io)?\n    } else {\n        crate::engine::Engine::init(root, io)?\n    };\n    Ok((App::new(engine, faulty.clone()), faulty))\n}\n\n/// 在已绑定的 listener 上接受连接并处理（阻塞）。\npub fn serve(listener: TcpListener, app: Arc<App>) {\n    for stream in listener.incoming() {\n        match stream {\n            Ok(stream) => {\n                let app = Arc::clone(&app);\n                thread::spawn(move || {\n                    crate::http::handle_connection(&app, &stream);\n                });\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                eprintln!(\"[cpengine] accept 失败: {e}\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 启动并阻塞当前线程直到进程退出。\npub fn run(root: &Path, cfg: ServerConfig) -> crate::error::Result<()> {\n    let (app, faulty) = build_app(root, cfg.faulty)?;\n    let listener = TcpListener::bind(&cfg.addr).map_err(std::io::Error::from)?;\n    eprintln!(\n        \"[cpengine]  }\n}\n\n/// 构造应用：根目录存在则打开（执行崩溃恢复清理），否则初始化。\npub fn build_app(root: &Path, faulty: bool) -> crate::error::Result<(App, Option<Arc<FaultyIo>>)> {\n    let (io, faulty): (SharedIo, faulty))\n}\n\n/// 在已绑定的 listener 上接受连接并处理（阻塞）。\npub fn serve(listener: TcpListener, app: Arc<App>) {\n    for stream in listener.incoming() {\n        match stream {\n            Ok(stream) => {\n {"parentUuid":"1e0e7de2-c792-40e6-b975-3c13757e76e4","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_a4rebjfqs0wifdebge6ah3qa","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/tests/basic.rs","content":"//! 基础场景：全量/增量检查点、同页多次更新、严格父链恢复、固定页约束、重启持久化。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse cpengine::engine::digest_equal;\nuse cpengine::error::EngineError;\n\nconst DS: &str = \"d1\";\nconst SIZE: u32 = 16;\nconst PAGES: u32 = 4;\n\nfn setup(label: &str) -> (Engine, PathBuf, ReferenceModel) {\n    let (e, root) = disk_engine(label);\n    make_dataset(&e, DS, SIZE, PAGES);\n    let m = ReferenceModel::new(SIZE, PAGES);\n    (e, root, m)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn fixed_page_constraints_are_enforced() {\n    let (e, _root) = disk_engine(\"fixed\");\n    make_dataset(&e, \"fx\", 8, 2);\n\n    // 页越界。\n    let err = e.write_page(\"fx\", 2, &[0u8; 8]).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::BadRequest(_)), \"{err:?}\");\n\n    // 页内容长度不符。\n    let err = e.write_page(\"fx\", 0, &[0u8; 7]).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::BadRequest(_)), \"{err:?}\");\n\n    // 创建数据集参数非法。\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.create_dataset(\"a/../b\", 8, 2).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::BadRequest(_)\n    ));\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.create_dataset(\"zero\", 0, 2).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::BadRequest(_)\n    ));\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.create_dataset(\"zero2\", 8, 0).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::BadRequest(_)\n    ));\n\n    // 重复数据集名。\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.create_dataset(\"fx\", 8, 2).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::Conflict(_)\n    ));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn same_page_multiple_updates_full_incremental_chain() {\n    let (e, root, mut m) = setup(\"multi-update\");\n\n    // 页 0 连续更新 3 次、页 1 更新 2 次，交替打检查点。\n    let f1 = e.checkpoint_full(DS).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(f1.kind, \"full\");\n    assert_eq!(f1.pages.len(), PAGES as usize);\n    assert!(f1.parent.is_none());\n    m.assert_matches(&e, DS);\n\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 1, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(0, 1);\n    let i1 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[0]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(i1.kind, \"incremental\");\n    assert_eq!(i1.parent.as_deref(), Some(f1.id.as_str()));\n    assert_eq!(i1.pages.len(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(i1.pages[&0].version, 1);\n\n    // 同页第二次更新。\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 2, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(0, 2);\n    put_only(&e, DS, 1, 3, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(1, 3);\n    let i2 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[0, 1]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(i2.pages[&0].version, 2);\n    assert_eq!(i2.pages[&1].version, 1);\n\n    // 同页第三次更新（只在 i3 中固化页 0）。\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 4, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(0, 4);\n    let i3 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[0]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(i3.pages[&0].version, 3);\n\n    // 链结构。\n    let chain = e.resolve_chain(DS, &i3.id).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(chain, vec![f1.id.clone(), i1.id.clone(), i2.id.clone(), i3.id.clone()]);\n\n    // 父 meta CRC 已记录且与实际一致。\n    let i3_meta = e.repo().read_meta(DS, &i3.id).unwrap();\n    let parent_bytes = std::fs::read(e.repo().meta_path(DS, &i2.id)).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(\n        i3_meta.parent_meta_crc.as_deref(),\n        Some(format!(\"{:08x}\", cpengine::checksum::crc32(&parent_bytes)).as_str())\n    );\n\n    // 当前工作集必须与参考模型一致。\n    m.assert_matches(&e, DS);\n\n    // 把工作集全部破坏成 0xff，然后严格沿链恢复到 i3，内容必须回到参考模型。\n    for p in 0..PAGES {\n        e.write_page(DS, p, &vec![0xffu8; SIZE as usize]).unwrap();\n    }\n    let report = e.restore(DS, &i3.id).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report.chain.len(), 4);\n    assert_eq!(report.applied_pages[&f1.id].len(), PAGES as usize);\n    assert_eq!(report.applied_pages[&i1.id], vec![0]);\n    assert_eq!(report.applied_pages[&i2.id], vec![0, 1]);\n    assert_eq!(report.applied_pages[&i3.id], vec![0]);\n    m.assert_matches(&e, DS);\n\n    // 沿链恢复到更早的 i1：页 0 回到 v1，其余为零页。\n    let report1 = e.restore(DS, &i1.id).unwrap();\n    let d = e.digest(DS).unwrap();\n    let mut early = ReferenceModel::new(SIZE, PAGES);\n    early.patterned(0, 1);\n    assert!(digest_equal(&d, &early.digest()));\n    assert_eq!(report1.chain.len(), 2);\n\n    // 进程重启后磁盘状态仍然可用。\n    let e2 = reopen_disk(&root);\n    let chain2 = e2.resolve_chain(DS, &i3.id).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(chain2.len(), 4);\n    e2.restore(DS, &i3.id).unwrap();\n    let m2 = {\n        let mut x = ReferenceModel::new(SIZE, PAGES);\n        x.patterned(0, 1);\n        x.patterned(0, 2);\n        x.patterned(1, 3);\n        x.patterned(0, 4);\n        x\n    };\n    m2.assert_matches(&e2, DS);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn incremental_rejects_page_not_newer_than_parent_chain() {\n    let (e, _root, mut m) = setup(\"stale-page\");\n\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 9, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(0, 9);\n    let f = e.checkpoint_full(DS).unwrap();\n\n    // 不更新页 0 就建增量：版本未高于父链 -> 拒绝。\n    let err = e\n        .checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[0])\n        .unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::BadRequest(_)), \"{err:?}\");\n\n    // 空增量也拒绝。\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[]).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::BadRequest(_)\n    ));\n\n    // 更新一次 -> 增量成功。\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 10, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(0, 10);\n    let i1 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, Some(&f.id), &[0]).unwrap();\n\n    // i1 之后页 0 未再更新，再次提交同页 -> 拒绝（不能重复固化同版本）。\n    let err = e\n        .checkpoint_incremental(DS, Some(&i1.id), &[0])\n        .unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::BadRequest(_)), \"{err:?}\");\n\n    // 显式指定不存在的父 -> 严格 MissingParent（发布前检查）。\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 11, SIZE as usize);\n    let err = e\n        .checkpoint_incremental(DS, 基础场景：全量/增量检查点、同页多次更新、严格父链恢复、固定页约束、重启持久化。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse cpengine::engine::digest_equal;\nuse cpengine::error::EngineError;\n\nconst DS: &str = \"d1\";\nconst SIZE: u32 = 16;\nconst PAGES: u32 = 4;\n\nfn setup(label: &str) -> (Engine, PathBuf, ReferenceModel) {\n    let (e, root) = disk_engine(label);\n    make_dataset(&e, DS, SIZE, PAGES);\n    let m = ReferenceModel::new(SIZE, PAGES);\n    (e, root, m)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn fixed_page_constraints_are_enforced() {\n    let (e, _root) = disk_engine(\"fixed\");\n    make_dataset(&e, \"fx\", 8, 2);\n\n    // 页越界。\n    let err = e.write_page(\"fx\", 2, &[0u8; 8]).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::BadRequest(_)), \"{err:?}\");\n\n    // 页内容长度不符。\n    let err = e.write_page(\"fx\", 0, &[0u8; 7]).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::BadRequest(_)), \"{err:?}\");\n\n    // 创建数据集参数非法。\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.create_dataset(\"a/../b\", 8, 2).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::BadRequest(_)\n    ));\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.create_dataset(\"zero\", 0, 2).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::BadRequest(_)\n    ));\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.create_dataset(\"zero2\", 8, 0).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::BadRequest(_)\n    ));\n\n    // 重复数据集名。\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.create_dataset(\"fx\", 8, 2).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::Conflict(_)\n    ));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn same_page_multiple_updates_full_incremental_chain() {\n    let (e, root, mut m) = setup(\"multi-update\");\n\n    // 页 0 连续更新 3 次、页 1 更新 2 次，交替打检查点。\n    let f1 = e.checkpoint_full(DS).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(f1.kind, \"full\");\n    assert_eq!(f1.pages.len(), PAGES as usize);\n    assert!(f1.parent.is_none());\n    m.assert_matches(&e, DS);\n\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 1, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(0, 1);\n    let i1 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[0]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(i1.kind, \"incremental\");\n    assert_eq!(i1.parent.as_deref(), Some(f1.id.as_str()));\n    assert_eq!(i1.pages.len(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(i1.pages[&0].version, 1);\n\n    // 同页第二次更新。\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 2, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(0, 2);\n    put_only(&e, DS, 1, 3, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(1, 3);\n    let i2 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[0, 1]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(i2.pages[&0].version, 2);\n    assert_eq!(i2.pages[&1].version, 1);\n\n    // 同页第三次更新（只在 i3 中固化页 0）。\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 4, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(0, 4);\n    let i3 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[0]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(i3.pages[&0].version, 3);\n\n    // 链结构。\n    let chain = e.resolve_chain(DS, &i3.id).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(chain, vec![f1.id.clone(), i1.id.clone(), i2.id.clone(), i3.id.clone()]);\n\n    // 父 meta CRC 已记录且与实际一致。\n    let i3_meta = e.repo().read_meta(DS, &i3.id).unwrap();\n    let parent_bytes = std::fs::read(e.repo().meta_path(DS, &i2.id)).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(\n        i3_meta.parent_meta_crc.as_deref(),\n        Some(format!(\"{:08x}\", cpengine::checksum::crc32(&parent_bytes)).as_str())\n    );\n\n    // 当前工作集必须与参考模型一致。\n    m.assert_matches(&e, DS);\n\n    // 把工作集全部破坏成 0xff，然后严格沿链恢复到 i3，内容必须回到参考模型。\n    for p in 0..PAGES {\n        e.write_page(DS, p, &vec![0xffu8; SIZE as usize]).unwrap();\n    }\n    let report = e.restore(DS, &i3.id).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report.chain.len(), 4);\n    assert_eq!(report.applied_pages[&f1.id].len(), PAGES as usize);\n    assert_eq!(report.applied_pages[&i1.id], vec![0]);\n    assert_eq!(report.applied_pages[&i2.id], vec![0, 1]);\n    assert_eq!(report.applied_pages[&i3.id], vec![0]);\n    m.assert_matches(&e, DS);\n\n    // 沿链恢复到更早的 i1：页 0 回到 v1，其余为零页。\n    let report1 = e.restore(DS, &i1.id).unwrap();\n    let d = e.digest(DS).unwrap();\n    let mut early = ReferenceModel::new(SIZE, PAGES);\n    early.patterned(0, 1);\n    assert!(digest_equal(&d, &early.digest()));\n    assert_eq!(report1.chain.len(), 2);\n\n    // 进程重启后磁盘状态仍然可用。\n    let e2 = reopen_disk(&root);\n    let chain2 = e2.resolve_chain(DS, &i3.id).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(chain2.len(), 4);\n    e2.restore(DS, &i3.id).unwrap();\n    let m2 = {\n        let mut x = ReferenceModel::new(SIZE, PAGES);\n        x.patterned(0, 1);\n        x.patterned(0, 2);\n        x.patterned(1, 3);\n        x.patterned(0, 4);\n        x\n    };\n    m2.assert_matches(&e2, DS);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn incremental_rejects_page_not_newer_than_parent_chain() {\n    let (e, _root, mut m) = setup(\"stale-page\");\n\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 9, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(0, 9);\n    let f = e.checkpoint_full(DS).unwrap();\n\n    // 不更新页 0 就建增量：版本未高于父链 -> 拒绝。\n    let err = e\n        .checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[0])\n        .unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::BadRequest(_)), \"{err:?}\");\n\n    // 空增量也拒绝。\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[]).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::BadRequest(_)\n    ));\n\n    // 更新一次 -> 增量成功。\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 10, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(0, 10);\n    let i1 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, Some(&f.id), &[0]).unwrap();\n\n    // i1 之后页 0 未再更新，再次提交同页 -> 拒绝（不能重复固化同版本）。\n    let err = e\n        .checkpoint_incremental(DS, Some(&i1.id), &[0])\n        .unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::BadRequest(_)), \"{err:?}\");\n\n    // 显式指定不存在的父 -> 严格 MissingParent（发布前检查）。\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 11, SIZE as usize);\n    let err = e\n        .checkpoint_incremental(DS, Some(\"d1-cp999999\"), &[0])\n        .unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::MissingParent { .. }), \"{err:?}\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn multiple_full_roots_are_independent_snapshots() {\n    let (e, _root, mut m) = setup(\"multi-full\");\n\n    // 根 1：初始零页。\n    let f0 = e.checkpoint_full(DS).unwrap();\n\n    put_only(&e, DS, 2, 5, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(2, 5);\n    let i1 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[2]).unwrap();\n\n    // 根 2：在当前工作集上再打一个全量，它无父、自成链。\n    let f1 = e.checkpoint_full(DS).unwrap();\n    assert!(f1.parent.is_none());\n    assert_eq!(f1.pages.len(), PAGES as usize);\n    assert_eq!(f1.pages[&2].version, 1);\n    let chain = e.resolve_chain(DS, &f1.id).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(chain, vec![f1.id.clone()]);\n\n    // 从旧根恢复：页 2 回到零。\n    e.restore(DS, &f0.id).unwrap();\n    let zero = ReferenceModel::new(SIZE, PAGES);\n    zero.assert_matches(&e, DS);\n\n    // 从 f0 之后的增量恢复仍然合法。\n    e.restore(DS, &i1.id).unwrap();\n    m.assert_matches(&e, DS);\n\n    // 从新根恢复得到当前内容。\n    e.restore(DS, &f1.id).unwrap();\n    m.assert_matches(&e, DS);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn restore_rebuilds_from_zero_not_from_current_workset() {\n    // 严格性证明：即使当前工作集某页是“更新”的内容，恢复一个不含该页更新的\n    // 旧检查点时，也必须先回到全零再沿链应用，而不是叠加当前内容。\n    let (e, _root, mut m) = setup(\"from-zero\");\n    let f = e.checkpoint_full(DS).unwrap();\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 1, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(0, 1);\n    let i1 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[0]).unwrap();\n    put_only(&e, DS, 3, 2, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(3, 2);\n\n    // 恢复 i1：页 3 必须是零页，尽管工作集里它刚被写过。\n    e.restore(DS, &i1.id).unwrap();\n    let d = e.digest(DS).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(d[3].version, 0);\n    assert_eq!(d[3].crc, format!(\"{:08x}\", f;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d5ca90e8-6c22-450c-9f57-6b3b08b23a64","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}
