{"parentUuid":"be4f67a3-d8d4-48ec-99bd-6ef956235c81","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_z8pyx6yia3jef4mvwwxq206u","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/tests/faults.rs","content":"//! 故障场景：父链缺失、循环依赖、页校验损坏、合并发布中断、崩溃后暂存清理。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse cpengine::error::EngineError;\nuse cpengine::io::Op;\n\nconst DS: &str = \"d1\";\nconst SIZE: u32 = 12;\nconst PAGES: u32 = 3;\n\nfn chain(label: &str) -> (Engine, std::sync::Arc<cpengine::io::FaultyIo>, PathBuf, [String; 4]) {\n    let (e, f, root) = faulty_engine(label);\n    make_dataset(&e, DS, SIZE, PAGES);\n    let f0 = e.checkpoint_full(DS).unwrap().id;\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 1, SIZE as usize);\n    let i1 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[0]).unwrap().id;\n    put_only(&e, DS, 1, 2, SIZE as usize);\n    let i2 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[0, 1]).unwrap_err(); // 页0版本未变 -> 必须失败\n    let _ = i2;\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 3, SIZE as usize);\n    let i2 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[0, 1]).unwrap().id;\n    put_only(&e, DS, 2, 4, SIZE as usize);\n    let i3 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[2]).unwrap().id;\n    (e, f, root, [f0, i1, i2, i3])\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn missing_parent_is_detected_strictly() {\n    let (e, _f, root, ids) = chain(\"missing-parent\");\n    let [f0, i1, i2, i3] = ids.clone();\n\n    // 直接删除中间的 i1：i2/i3 的链在此断裂。\n    e.test_delete_checkpoint(DS, &i1).unwrap();\n\n    // i3 与 i2 都必须报 MissingParent，且错误指出缺失的是谁。\n    let err = e.resolve_chain(DS, &i3).unwrap_err();\n    match err {\n        EngineError::MissingParent { checkpoint, missing } => {\n            assert_eq!(missing, i1);\n            // checkpoint 是直接引用缺失父项的那个节点（i2）。\n            assert_eq!(checkpoint, i2);\n        }\n        other => panic!(\"期望 MissingParent，实际 {other:?}\"),\n    }\n    let err = e.restore(DS, &i3).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::MissingParent { .. }), \"{err:?}\");\n\n    // 链根 f0 本身完好，仍可严格恢复（不允许“跳过缺口”）。\n    let report = e.restore(DS, &f0).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report.chain, vec![f0.clone()]);\n    let d = e.digest(DS).unwrap();\n    assert!(d.iter().all(|p| p.version == 0));\n\n    // 重新打开进程：断裂依旧存在且被严格报错（启动清理不“修复”父链）。\n    let e2 = reopen_disk(&root);\n    let err = e2.resolve_chain(DS, &i3).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::MissingParent { .. }), \"{err:?}\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn missing_parent_when_parent_is_root() {\n    let (e, _f, _root, ids) = chain(\"missing-root\");\n    let [f0, i1, _i2, _i3] = ids;\n    e.test_delete_checkpoint(DS, {"parentUuid":"4bae26c3-b4e3-4cbb-a088-b6a5343e5e45","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_vrjdkgho0qt0lnuyh4bapwc9","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/tests/property.rs","content":"//! 属性式测试：随机“写页 -> 偶尔打全量/增量”序列，\n//! 在每个检查点后对照参考模型摘要，并随机恢复到链上任意检查点，\n//! 用重放同一序列的方式验证恢复结果严格正确。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse cpengine::engine::digest_equal;\n\n/// 确定性简易 LCG（不依赖 rand crate）。\nstruct Rng(u64);\nimpl Rng {\n    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        // MMIX 常数。\n        self.0 = self.0.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);\n        self.0\n    }\n    fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> u64 {\n        self.next_u64() % n\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在给定 seed 下执行随机序列并验证。\nfn run_property(seed: u64, page_size: u32, page_count: u32, steps: u32) {\n    let (e, root) = disk_engine(&format!(\"prop-{seed}\"));\n    let ds = \"p\";\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n\n    let mut rng = Rng(seed.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) ^ 0xdead_beef);\n\n    // 记录每个检查点创建时刻，参考模型应当具有的页内容。\n    // 我们不保存全部历史内容，而是：恢复到检查点 id 时，用记录的“逐页 (version,crc)”\n    // 与恢复后摘要直接比较。\n    let mut snapshots: Vec<(String, Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite>)> = Vec::new();\n\n    // 参考模型实时镜像当前工作集。\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n\n    for step in 0..steps {\n        let action = rng.below(10);\n        match action {\n            0..=5 => {\n                // 写 1~2 个随机页。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(2);\n                for _ in 0..n {\n                    let page = rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32;\n                    let tag = rng.below(200) as u8;\n                    let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(page_size as usize, tag);\n                    e.write_page(ds, page, &data).expect(\"write\");\n                    model.write_page(page, data);\n                }\n                model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n            }\n            6 => {\n                // 全量。\n                let meta = e.checkpoint_full(ds).expect(\"full\");\n                let snap = model\n                    .digest()\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .map(common_hack::lite)\n                    .collect();\n                snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n            }\n            7..=8 => {\n                // 增量：收集随机数量的脏页（只选当前版本>0的页，或允许新页）。\n                // 为保证合法，我们只提交“自上次检查点后确实写过”的页：\n                // 简化做法——尝试随机页集合，引擎若以 BadRequest 拒绝则跳过，\n                // 但必须保证：成功时摘要不变、链可解析。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(page_count as u64.min(3));\n                let pages: Vec<u32> = (0..n)\n                    .map(|_| rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32)\n                    .collect();\n                match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, None, &pages) {\n                    Ok(meta) => {\n                        // 成功前提：这些页版本都高于父链。记录快照。\n                        let snap = model\n                            .digest()\n                            .into_iter()\n                            .map(common_hack::lite)\n                            .collect();\n                        snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n                    }\n                    Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {\n                        // 合法拒绝（页不够新/无父/空集去重后为空）。\n                    }\n                    Err(other) => panic!(\"增量出现非预期错误: {other:?}\"),\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // 随机恢复到某个历史检查点（如果有）。\n                if snapshots.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let idx = rng.below(snapshots.len() as u64) as usize;\n                let (id, snap) = &snapshots[idx];\n                let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore 历史检查点\");\n                assert_eq!(*report.chain.last().unwrap(), *id);\n                let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n                let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n                assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap, \"seed={seed} step={step} 恢复到 {id} 后摘要与历史不符\");\n                // 恢复后参考模型也要回滚：直接用摘要构造一个只读对照即可。\n                model = rebuild_model_from_digest(page_size, page_count, &after);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 最终：对每个快照再做一次全量恢复校验，并重启进程验证持久化。\n    for (id, snap) in &snapshots {\n        let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore\");\n        assert_eq!(report.chain.last().unwrap(), id);\n        let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n        assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap);\n    }\n    if !snapshots.is_empty() {\n        let e2 = reopen_disk(&root);\n        let (id, snap) = snapshots.last().unwrap();\n        e2.restore(ds, id).unwrap();\n        let after = e2.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n        assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap);\n    }\n}\n\nmod common_hack {\n    /// 可比较的摘要三元组（不依赖 Serialize）。\n    #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Clone)]\n    pub struct PageDigestLite {\n        pub page: u32,\n        pub version: u64,\n        pub crc: String,\n    }\n    pub fn lite(d: cpengine::engine::PageDigest) -> PageDigestLite {\n        PageDigestLite {\n            page: d.page,\n            version: d.version,\n            crc: d.crc,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 恢复后无法反推出页内容，但参考模型后续还要写页——\n/// 因此这里按“恢复后的真实页字节”重建模型，保证后续镜像准确。\nfn rebuild_model_from_digest(\n    page_size: u32,\n    page_count: u32,\n    digest: &[cpengine::engine::PageDigest],\n) -> ReferenceModel {\n    // digest 只含 crc，无法重建字节；该路径后模型仅用于 assert_matches，\n    // 而 assert_matches 比较的正是 digest 三元组——所以用一个“摘要注入”模型。\n    let _ = (page_size, page_count, digest);\n    unreachable!(\"随机恢复分支不重建可写模型；由 run_property 内 digest 直接比较\")\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_random_update_checkpoint_restore_seeds() {\n    for seed in 1..=12u64 {\n        run_property(seed, 8, 3, 60);\n    }\n    // 稍大的页与更长序列。\n    run_property(101, 64, 6, 120);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_merge_after_random_sequence_matches_model() {\n    // 独立确定性场景：随机更新 -> 形成单链 -> 全量合并 -> 逐页对照。\n    let (e, _root) = disk_engine(\"prop-merge\");\n    let ds = \"m\";\n    let (ps, pc) = (16u32, 5u32);\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, ps, pc);\n    let mut rng = Rng(0x1234_5678);\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(ps, pc);\n\n    let base = e.checkpoint_full(ds).unwrap();\n    let mut tip = base.id.clone();\n    for _ in 0..8 {\n        let page = rng.below(pc as u64) as u32;\n        let tag = rng.below(250) as u8;\n        let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(ps as usize, tag);\n        e.write_page(ds, page, &data).unwrap();\n        model.write_page(page, data);\n        match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, Some(&tip), &[page]) {\n            Ok(m) => tip = m.id,\n            Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {}\n            Err(o) => panic!(\"{o:?}\"),\n        }\n    }\n    let truth = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n    model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n\n    let report = e\n        .merge_checkpoints(ds, &base.id, &tip, false)\n        .unwrap();\n    e.restore(ds, &report.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth, &after));\n    assert_eq!(report.merged_page_count, pc as usize);\n\n    // compact 合并后 merged 依然逐页等于真值。\n    let report2 = e\n        .merge_checkpoints(ds, &base.id, &tip, true)\n        .unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!(\"compact 合并失败\"));\n    e.restore(ds, &report2.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after2 = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth, &after2));\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_56a860da65a4532e437460d4","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1180,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":85816,"output_tokens":2560,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"3a58cfb9-fd48-457d-bfbd-901bcd5583a1","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:25:36.237Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

属性式测试：随机“写页 -> 偶尔打全量/增量”序列，\n//! 在每个检查点后对照参考模型摘要，并随机恢复到链上任意检查点，\n//! 用重放同一序列的方式验证恢复结果严格正确。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse cpengine::engine::digest_equal;\n\n/// 确定性简易 LCG（不依赖 rand crate）。\nstruct Rng(u64);\nimpl Rng {\n    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        // MMIX 常数。\n        self.0 = self.0.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);\n        self.0\n    }\n    fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> u64 {\n        self.next_u64() % n\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在给定 seed 下执行随机序列并验证。\nfn run_property(seed: u64, page_size: u32, page_count: u32, steps: u32) {\n    let (e, root) = disk_engine(&format!(\"prop-{seed}\"));\n    let ds = \"p\";\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n\n    let mut rng = Rng(seed.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) ^ 0xdead_beef);\n\n    // 记录每个检查点创建时刻，参考模型应当具有的页内容。\n    // 我们不保存全部历史内容，而是：恢复到检查点 id 时，用记录的“逐页 (version,crc)”\n    // 与恢复后摘要直接比较。\n    let mut snapshots: Vec<(String, Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite>)> = Vec::new();\n\n    // 参考模型实时镜像当前工作集。\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n\n    for step in 0..steps {\n        let action = rng.below(10);\n        match action {\n            0..=5 => {\n                // 写 1~2 个随机页。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(2);\n                for _ in 0..n {\n                    let page = rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32;\n                    let tag = rng.below(200) as u8;\n                    let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(page_size as usize, tag);\n                    e.write_page(ds, page, &data).expect(\"write\");\n                    model.write_page(page, data);\n                }\n                model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n            }\n            6 => {\n                // 全量。\n                let meta = e.checkpoint_full(ds).expect(\"full\");\n                let snap = model\n                    .digest()\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .map(common_hack::lite)\n                    .collect();\n                snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n            }\n            7..=8 => {\n                // 增量：收集随机数量的脏页（只选当前版本>0的页，或允许新页）。\n                // 为保证合法，我们只提交“自上次检查点后确实写过”的页：\n                // 简化做法——尝试随机页集合，引擎若以 BadRequest 拒绝则跳过，\n                // 但必须保证：成功时摘要不变、链可解析。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(page_count as u64.min(3));\n                let pages: Vec<u32> = (0..n)\n                    .map(|_| rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32)\n                    .collect();\n                match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, None, &pages) {\n                    Ok(meta) => {\n                        // 成功前提：这些页版本都高于父链。记录快照。\n                        let snap = model\n                            .digest()\n                            .into_iter()\n                            .map(common_hack::lite)\n                            .collect();\n                        snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n                    }\n                    Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {\n                        // 合法拒绝（页不够新/无父/空集去重后为空）。\n                    }\n                    Err(other) => panic!(\"增量出现非预期错误: {other:?}\"),\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // 随机恢复到某个历史检查点（如果有）。\n                if snapshots.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let idx = rng.below(snapshots.len() as u64) as usize;\n                let (id, snap) = &snapshots[idx];\n                let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore 历史检查点\");\n                assert_eq!(*report.chain.last().unwrap(), *id);\n                let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n                let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n                assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap, \"seed={seed} step={step} 恢复到 {id} 后摘要与历史不符\");\n                // 恢复后参考模型也要回滚：直接用摘要构造一个只读对照即可。\n                model = rebuild_model_from_digest(page_size, page_count, &after);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 最终：对每个快照再做一次全量恢复校验，并重启进程验证持久化。\n    for (id, snap) in &snapshots {\n        let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore\");\n        assert_eq!(report.chain.last().unwrap(), id);\n        let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n        assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap);\n    }\n    if !snapshots.is_empty() {\n        let e2 = reopen_disk(&root);\n        let (id, snap) = snapshots.last().unwrap();\n        e2.restore(ds, id).unwrap();\n        let after = e2.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n        assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap);\n    }\n}\n\nmod common_hack {\n    /// 可比较的摘要三元组（不依赖 Serialize）。\n    #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Clone)]\n    pub struct PageDigestLite {\n        pub page: u32,\n        pub version: u64,\n        pub crc: String,\n    }\n    pub fn lite(d: cpengine::engine::PageDigest) -> PageDigestLite {\n        PageDigestLite {\n            page: d.page,\n            version: d.version,\n            crc: d.crc,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 恢复后无法反推出页内容，但参考模型后续还要写页——\n/// 因此这里按“恢复后的真实页字节”重建模型，保证后续镜像准确。\nfn rebuild_model_from_digest(\n    page_size: u32,\n    page_count: u32,\n    digest: &[cpengine::engine::PageDigest],\n) -> ReferenceModel {\n    // digest 只含 crc，无法重建字节；该路径后模型仅用于 assert_matches，\n    // 而 assert_matches 比较的正是 digest 三元组——所以用一个“摘要注入”模型。\n    let _ = (page_size, page_count, digest);\n    unreachable!(\"随机恢复分支不重建可写模型；由 run_property 内 digest 直接比较\")\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_random_update_checkpoint_restore_seeds() {\n    for seed in 1..=12u64 {\n        run_property(seed, 8, 3, 60);\n    }\n    // 稍大的页与更长序列。\n    run_property(101, 64, 6, 120);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_merge_after_random_sequence_matches_model() {\n    // 独立确定性场景：随机更新 -> 形成单链 -> 全量合并 -> 逐页对照。\n    let (e, _root) = disk_engine(\"prop-merge\");\n    let ds = \"m\";\n    let (ps, pc) = (16u32, 5u32);\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, ps, pc);\n    let mut rng = Rng(0x1234_5678);\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(ps, pc);\n\n    let base = e.checkpoint_full(ds).unwrap();\n    let mut tip = base.id.clone();\n    for _ in 0..8 {\n        let page = rng.below(pc as u64) as u32;\n        let tag = rng.below(250) as u8;\n        let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(ps as usize, tag);\n        e.write_page(ds, page, &data).unwrap();\n        model.write_page(page, data);\n        match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, Some(&tip), &[page]) {\n            Ok(m) => tip = m.id,\n            Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {}\n            Err(o) => panic!(\"{o:?}\"),\n        }\n    }\n    let truth = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n    model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n\n    let report = e\n        .merge_checkpoints(ds, &base.id, &tip, false)\n        .unwrap();\n    e.restore(ds, &report.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth, &after));\n    assert_eq!(report.merged_page_count, pc as usize);\n\n    // compact 合并后 merged 依然逐页等于真值。\n    let report2 = e\n        .merge_checkpoints(ds, &base.id, &tip, true)\n        .unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!(\"compact 合并失败\"));\n    e.restore(ds, &report2.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after2 = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth, &after2));\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"3a58cfb9-fd48-457d-bfbd-901bcd5583a1","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

cpengine::engine::digest_equal;\n\n/// 确定性简易 LCG（不依赖 rand crate）。\nstruct Rng(u64);\nimpl Rng {\n    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        // MMIX 常数。\n        self.0 = self.0.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);\n        self.0\n    }\n    fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> u64 {\n        self.next_u64() % n\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在给定 seed 下执行随机序列并验证。\nfn run_property(seed: u64, page_size: u32, page_count: u32, steps: u32) {\n    let (e, root) = disk_engine(&format!(\"prop-{seed}\"));\n    let ds = \"p\";\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n\n    let mut rng = Rng(seed.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) ^ 0xdead_beef);\n\n    // 记录每个检查点创建时刻，参考模型应当具有的页内容。\n    // 我们不保存全部历史内容，而是：恢复到检查点 id 时，用记录的“逐页 (version,crc)”\n    // 与恢复后摘要直接比较。\n    let mut snapshots: Vec<(String, Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite>)> = Vec::new();\n\n    // 参考模型实时镜像当前工作集。\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n\n    for step in 0..steps {\n        let action = rng.below(10);\n        match action {\n            0..=5 => {\n                // 写 1~2 个随机页。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(2);\n                for _ in 0..n {\n                    let page = rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32;\n                    let tag = rng.below(200) as u8;\n                    let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(page_size as usize, tag);\n                    e.write_page(ds, page, &data).expect(\"write\");\n                    model.write_page(page, data);\n                }\n                model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n            }\n            6 => {\n                // 全量。\n                let meta = e.checkpoint_full(ds).expect(\"full\");\n                let snap = model\n                    .digest()\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .map(common_hack::lite)\n                    .collect();\n                snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n           // 但必须保证：成功时摘要不变、链可解析。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(page_count as u64.min(3));\n                let pages: Vec<u32> = (0..n)\n                    .map(|_| rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32)\n                    .collect();\n                match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, None, &pages) {\n                    Ok(meta) => {\n                        // 成功前提：这些页版本都高于父链。记录快照。\n                        let snap = model\n                            .digest()\n                            .into_iter()\n                            .map(common_hack::lite)\n                            .collect();\n                        snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n                    }\n                    Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {\n                        // 合法拒绝（页不够新/无父/空集去重后为空）。\n                    }\n                    Err(other) => panic!(\"增量出现非预期错误: {other:?}\"),\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // 随机恢复到某个历史检查点（如果有）。\n                if snapshots.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let idx = rng.below(snapshots.len() as u64) as usize;\n                let (id, snap) = &snapshots[idx];\n                let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore 历史检查点\");\n                assert_eq!(*report.chain.last().unwrap(), *id);\n                let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n                let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n                assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap, \"seed={seed} step={step} 恢复到 {id} 后摘要与历史不符\");\n                // 恢复后参考模型也要回滚：从引擎工作集读回真实字节与版本重建。\n                model = model_from_engine(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 最终：对每个快照再做一次全量恢复校验，并重启进程验证持久化。\n    for (id, snap) in &snapshots {\n        let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore\");\n        assert_eq!(report.chain.last().unwrap(), id);\n        let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n        assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap);\n    }\n    if !snapshots.is_empty() {\n        let e2 = reopen_disk(&root);\n        let (id, snap) = snapshots.last().unwrap();\n        e2.restore(ds, id).unwrap();\n        let after = e2.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n        assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap);\n    }\n}\n\nmod common_hack {\n    /// 可比较的摘要三元组（不依赖 Serialize）。\n    #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Clone)]\n    pub struct PageDigestLite {\n        pub page: u32,\n        pub version: u64,\n        pub crc: String,\n    }\n    pub fn lite(d: cpengine::engine::PageDigest) -> PageDigestLite {\n       e.write_page(ds, page, &data).unwrap();\n        model.write_page(page, data);\n        match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, Some(&tip), &[page]) {\n            Ok(m) => tip = m.id,\n report = e\n        .merge_checkpoints(ds, &base.id, &tip, false)\n        .unwrap();\n    e.restore(ds, &report.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n {"parentUuid":"6ef22d8d-ef0c-4f2d-bcab-9bc8b124df5f","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_omtvs13aa1sbw9mnqr90dkg2","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/tests/http_api.rs","content":"//! HTTP 端到端测试：真实 TcpListener（端口 0 自动分配）+ 手写 HTTP/1.1 请求。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse cpengine::http::App;\nuse cpengine::server;\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nstruct TestServer {\n    addr: String,\n    _root: std::path::PathBuf,\n}\n\nfn spawn_server(label: &str) -> TestServer {\n    let root = common::temp_root(label);\n    let (app, _f) = server::build_app(&root, true).expect(\"build app\");\n    let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n    let app = Arc::new(app);\n    std::thread::spawn(move || server::serve(listener, app));\n    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));\n    TestServer {\n        addr,\n        _root: root,\n    }\n}\n\nstruct Resp {\n    status: u16,\n    json: serde_json::Value,\n}\n\nfn req(server: &TestServer, method: &str, path: &str, body: Option<&str>) -> Resp {\n    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect(&server.addr).unwrap();\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).unwrap();\n    let body = body.unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let head = format!(\n        \"{method} {path} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n{body}\",\n        body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(head.as_bytes()).unwrap();\n    let mut raw = Vec::new();\n    stream.read_to_end(&mut raw).unwrap();\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw);\n    let status: u16 = text\n        .lines()\n        .next()\n        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().nth(1))\n        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n    let body_part = text.split(\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\").nth(1).unwrap_or(\"{}\");\n    let json: serde_json::Value =\n        serde_json::from_str(body_part).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!(\"非 JSON 响应: {body_part:?} ({e})\"));\n    Resp { status, json }\n}\n\nfn data(r: &Resp) -> &serde_json::Value {\n    &r.json[\"data\"]\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_full_workflow() {\n    let s = spawn_server(\"http-basic\");\n\n    // health\n    let r = req(&s, \"GET\", \"/\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"engine\"], \"incremental-checkpoint-engine\");\n\n    // 创建数据集\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"name\":\"ds\",\"page_size\":8,\"page_count\":3}\"#),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, \"{}\", r.json);\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"next_seq\"], 1);\n\n    // 重复创建 -> 409\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"name\":\"ds\",\"page_size\":8,\"page_count\":3}\"#),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n    assert_eq!(r.json[\"error\"][\"code\"], \"conflict\");\n\n    // 初始摘要全为零页、版本 0\n    let r = req(&s, \"GET\", \"/datasets/ds/digest\", None);\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"digest\"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 3);\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"digest\"][0][\"version\"], 0);\n\n    // 全量（零页）\n    let r = req(&s, \"POST\", \"/datasets/ds/checkpoints/full\", Some(\"{}\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, \"{}\", r.json);\n    let f0 = data(&r)[\"id\"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"kind\"], \"full\");\n\n    // 同页三次更新 + 两个增量\n    for (tag, pages) in [(1u8, \"0\"), (2, \"0\"), (3, \"1\")] {\n        let r = req(\n            &s,\n            \"PUT\",\n            \"/datasets/ds/pages/0\",\n            Some(&format!(r#\"{{\"pattern\":{tag}}}\"#)),\n        );\n        assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"write {}\", r.json);\n        let _ = pages;\n    }\n    // 上面循环只写了页 0 三次；再写页 1 一次。\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/datasets/ds/pages/1\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"pattern\":3}\"#),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"{}\", r.json);\n\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/ds/checkpoints/incremental\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"pages\":[0]}\"#),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, \"{}\", r.json);\n    let i1 = data(&r)[\"id\"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"pages\"][\"0\"][\"version\"], 3); // 页 0 已写 3 次\n\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/ds/checkpoints/incremental\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"pages\":[1]}\"#),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, \"{}\", r.json);\n    let i2 = data(&r)[\"id\"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();\n\n    // 链\n    let r = req(&s, \"GET\", &format!(\"/datasets/ds/checkpoints/{i2}/chain\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let chain = data(&r)[\"chain\"].as_array().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(chain[0], f0);\n    assert_eq!(chain[1], i1);\n    assert_eq!(chain[2], i2);\n\n    // 破坏工作集后恢复\n    for p in 0..3 {\n        req(\n            &s,\n            \"PUT\",\n            &format!(\"/datasets/ds/pages/{p}\"),\n            Some(r#\"{\"byte\":255}\"#),\n        );\n    }\n    let before_truth = {\n        // 记录逐次更新到 i2 的真值摘要：直接用 engine 视角 = i2 恢复结果\n        let r = req(&s, \"POST\", &format!(\"/datasets/ds/checkpoints/{i2}/restore\"), Some(\"{}\"));\n        assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"{}\", r.json);\n        data(&r)[\"digest\"].clone()\n    };\n    assert_eq!(before_truth[0][\"version\"], 3);\n    assert_eq!(before_truth[1][\"version\"], 1);\n    assert_eq!(before_truth[2][\"version\"], 0);\n\n    // 合并 f0..i2\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/ds/merge\",\n        Some(&format!(r#\"{{\"base\":\"{f0}\",\"tip\":\"{i2}\"}}\"#)),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, \"{}\", r.json);\n    let merged = data(&r)[\"merged_id\"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"merged_page_count\"], 3);\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        &format!(\"/datasets/ds/checkpoints/{merged}/restore\"),\n        Some(\"{}\"),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"digest\"], before_truth);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_fault_injection_and_missing_parent() {\n    let s = spawn_server(\"http-faults\");\n    req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"name\":\"d\",\"page_size\":4,\"page_count\":2}\"#),\n    );\n    let f0 = data(&req(&s, \"POST\", \"/datasets/d/checkpoints/full\", Some(\"{}\")))[\"id\"]\n        .as_str()\n        .unwrap()\n        .to_string();\n    req(&s, \"PUT\", \"/datasets/d/pages/0\", Some(r#\"{\"byte\":7}\"#));\n    let i1 = data(&req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/d/checkpoints/incremental\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"pages\":[0]}\"#),\n    ))[\"id\"]\n        .as_str()\n        .unwrap()\n        .to_string();\n    req(&s, \"PUT\", \"/datasets/d/pages/1\", Some(r#\"{\"byte\":8}\"#));\n    let i2 = data(&req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/d/checkpoints/incremental\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"pages\":[1]}\"#),\n    ))[\"id\"]\n        .as_str()\n        .unwrap()\n        .to_string();\n\n    // 删除 i1 -> i2 链断裂\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        &format!(\"/datasets/d/checkpoints/{i1}/delete\"),\n        Some(\"{}\"),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = req(&s, \"GET\", &format!(\"/datasets/d/checkpoints/{i2}/chain\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n    assert_eq!(r.json[\"error\"][\"code\"], \"missing_parent\");\n\n    // f0 仍可用\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        &format!(\"/datasets/d/checkpoints/{f0}/restore\"),\n        Some(\"{}\"),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n\n    // 故障注入：下一次目录发布（增量）失败\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/faults\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"op\":\"rename_publish\",\"trigger_at\":1,\"note\":\"http 模拟掉电\"}\"#),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    req(&s, \"PUT\", \"/datasets/d/pages/0\", Some(r#\"{\"byte\":9}\"#));\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/d/checkpoints/incremental\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"pages\":[0]}\"#),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 500);\n    assert_eq!(r.json[\"error\"][\"code\"], \"injected_fault\");\n    // one-shot 自动解除，后续恢复正常。\n    let r = req(&s, \"GET\", \"/faults\", None);\n    assert_eq!(data(&r), serde_json::Value::Null);\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/d/checkpoints/incremental\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"pages\":[0]}\"#),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, \"{}\", r.json);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_cycle_and_checksum_errors() {\n    let s = spawn_server(\"http-cycle\");\n    req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"name\":\"d\",\"page_size\":4,\"page_count\":2}\"#),\n    );\n    let f0 = data(&req(&s, \"POST\", \"/datasets/d/checkpoints/full\", Some(\"{}\")))[\"id\"]\n        .as_str()\n        .unwrap()\n        .to_string();\n    req(&s, \"PUT\", \"/datasets/d/pages/0\", Some(r#\"{\"byte\":1}\"#));\n    let i1 = data(&req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/d/checkpoints/incremental\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"pages\":[0]}\"#),\n    ))[\"id\"]\n        .as_str()\n        .unwrap()\n        .to_string();\n\n    // 造环：i1.parent = i1\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        &format!(\"/datasets/d/checkpoints/{i1}/rewire\"),\n        Some(&format!(r#\"{{\"parent\":\"{i1}\"}}\"#)),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = req(&s, \"GET\", &format!(\"/datasets/d/checkpoints/{i1}/chain\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n    assert_eq!(r.json[\"error\"][\"code\"], \"cycle_detected\");\n\n    // CRC 损坏：f0 的页 0\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        &format!(\"/datasets/d/checkpoints/{f0}/corrupt\"),\n        Some(r#\"{\"page\":0,\"byte\":200}\"#),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    // f0 恢复现在必须 checksum_mismatch（环的 i1 走不到 f0；f0 自己可直接验证）\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        &format!(\"/datasets/d/checkpoints/{f0}/restore\"),\n        Some(\"{}\"),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n    assert_eq!(r.json[\"error\"][\"code\"], \"checksum_mismatch\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_bad_routes_and_payloads() {\n    let s = spawn_server(\"http-bad\");\n    req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"name\":\"d\",\"page_size\":4,\"page_count\":2}\"#),\n    );\n\n    // 未知路由\n    assert_eq!(req(&s, \"GET\", \"/nope\", None).status, 404);\n    // 坏 JSON\n    let r = req(&s, \"POST\", \"/datasets\", Some(\"{bad\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 400);\n    assert_eq!(r.json[\"error\"][\"code\"], \"bad_json\");\n    // 页大小不符\n    let r = req(&s, \"PUT\", \"/datasets/d/pages/0\", Some(r#\"{\"hex\":\"aabb\"}\"#));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 400);\n    assert_eq!(r.json[\"error\"][\"code\"], \"bad_page_size\");\n    // 页越界\n    let r = req(&s, \"PUT\", \"/datasets/d/pages/9\", Some(r#\"{\"byte\":1}\"#));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 400);\n}\n\n// 让 App 类型在本测试文件中被认为“被使用”（server 装配已间接使用）。\n#[allow(dead_code)]\nfn _use(_: &App) {}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_51c59d192fb9b642bbd60806","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":494,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":89912,"output_tokens":3976,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"abfa3255-c2f3-4aaa-ac59-1f58c97e6eda","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:27:14.092Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

{"parentUuid":"52df5a91-940c-436d-8dfb-03fc661f348b","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_dzz5e4i5gsgsky7jwegqx8ir","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/README.md","content":"# 增量检查点引擎（Incremental Checkpoint Engine）\n\n纯后端的**文件支持检查点存储库**：在固定大小页（fixed-size page）数据集上提供\n**全量（full）**与**增量（incremental）**检查点、记录**父检查点 ID / 页版本 / CRC 校验**、\n沿依赖链**严格恢复**，以及把一条检查点链**合并（merge）**为独立全量快照。\n另带一个仅依赖 Rust 标准库的**本地 HTTP 验证入口**，和一个**可注入 I/O 层**用于模拟\n“检查点发布 / 合并中途掉电”等故障。\n\n> 本项目不包含任何前端。\n\n---\n\n## 1. 它解决什么问题\n\n```\n写页(工作集) ──► full ──► inc ──► inc ──► ...        （每页带版本号 + CRC）\n                   ▲        │       │\n                   └────────┴───────┘  parent 指针（父检查点 ID）\n```\n\n- 工作集是 N 个**固定大小**的页；每次写页，该页版本号 +1。\n- **full**：固化全部页，无父。\n- **incremental**：只固化“比父链已知版本更新”的页，记录父 ID 与父 meta 的 CRC。\n- **恢复**：不信任当前工作集，从**全零页**出发沿父链 root→tip 逐节点应用；\n  父链缺一环、链上有环、CRC 不符、页版本回退 —— 一律失败，**绝不跳过缺口猜测**。\n- **合并**：把 `base(full/merged) … tip` 一整段链压成一个新的无父 `merged` 全量；\n  合并后的最终页内容必须与“逐次更新到 tip”完全一致（用页摘要逐页比对）。\n\n## 2. 磁盘格式（摘要）\n\n```\n<root>/\n├── repo.json                       # 存储库标识与格式版本\n└── datasets/\n    └── <name>/\n        ├── state.json              # page_size/page_count（不可变）、next_seq、\n        │                           #   每页版本、每页当前 CRC、tip\n        ├── working/                # 当前工作集：p0.bin … pN-1.bin（原子覆盖）\n        ├── checkpoints/\n        │   ├── <ds>-cp000001/      # full\n        │   │   ├── meta.json       # id/kind/parent/parent_meta_crc/pages...\n        │   │   └── pages/p<id>.bin # 定长页内容\n        │   ├── <ds>-cp000002/      # incremental（parent 指向前一检查点）\n        │   ├── <ds>-mrg000007/     # merged（无父，含 merged_sources）\n        │   └── .staging.<id>/      # 发布前暂存（崩溃后重开自动清理）\n        └── .orphans/               # 发布了一半（无 meta）的目录被隔离于此\n```\n\n完整字段说明见 [`docs/disk-format.md`](docs/disk-format.md)。\n\n### 同步边界（什么时候数据算落盘）\n\n- 每个文件写入 = **临时文件 → `fsync(file)` → `rename` → `fsync(父目录)`**\n  （[`IoBackend::write_atomic`](src/io.rs)）。调用方要么看到旧文件要么看到新文件。\n- 检查点发布 = 所有页与 `meta.json` 先写入 `.staging.<id>/` 并 fsync，\n  然后**一次目录 rename** 原子发布 + fsync 父目录（主要同步边界），\n  最后才原子更新 `state.json`。\n- 因此发布 rename 之前崩溃：正式空间看不到该检查点，暂存目录重开时清除；\n  rename 之后崩溃：检查点完整可见。\n- **边界声明**：只保证单进程崩溃一致性；不做多进程/多机并发协调、不做 WAL、\n  不做页级 mmap。本地 HTTP 服务默认只绑定 `127.0.0.1`，无鉴权/TLS。\n\n## 3. 构建与运行\n\n```bash\ncargo build --release\ncargo run -- --root ./cpengine-data --addr 127.0.0.1:8088\n# 可选 --no-faulty 关闭 /faults 故障注入端点\n```\n\n需要 Rust 1.74+（使用了 `split_once` 等稳定 API）。依赖只有\n`serde` / `serde_json` / `crc32fast`。\n\n快速手动演练：\n\n```bash\nexamples/demo.sh                 # 完整 happy-path（建数据集→写页→检查点→恢复→合并）\nexamples/demo-faults.sh          # 父链缺失 / 循环 / CRC / 发布中断演练\n```\n\nHTTP 接口与字段见 [`docs/api.md`](docs/api.md)，可直接在 REST 客户端执行的请求样例见\n[`examples/requests.http`](examples/requests.http)。\n\n## 4. 自动化测试\n\n```bash\ncargo test                       # 全部单元 + 集成测试\ncargo test --test faults -- --nocapture\n```\n\n测试矩阵（对应验收点）：\n\n| 验收点 | 测试 |\n|---|---|\n| 同页多次更新、全量/增量链、页摘要对照 | `tests/basic.rs::same_page_multiple_updates_full_incremental_chain` |\n| 对照逐次更新后的页摘要（确定性随机 12+ 种子） | `tests/property.rs::property_random_update_checkpoint_restore_seeds` |\n| 父链缺失（中间节点/链根）严格报错 | `tests/faults.rs::missing_parent_*` |\n| 循环依赖（回指环 + 自环）严格报错 | `tests/faults.rs::cycle_dependency_is_detected` |\n| CRC 损坏（根页/增量页）严格报错 | `tests/faults.rs::checksum_corruption_is_detected_on_restore_and_merge` |\n| 合并保持最终页内容 | `tests/faults.rs::merge_preserves_final_page_content_against_sequential_updates`、`tests/property.rs::property_merge_after_random_sequence_matches_model` |\n| 合并/检查点发布中断不留半成品，重启恢复 | `tests/faults.rs::interrupted_merge_*`、`crash_before_publish_*` |\n| HTTP 端到端（含故障端点、错误码） | `tests/http_api.rs` |\n\n## 5. 关键设计取舍\n\n- **恢复从全零重建**而不是叠加当前工作集：避免“旧页残留被误认为链内容”\n  （`tests/basic.rs::restore_rebuilds_from_zero_not_from_current_workset`）。\n- **增量只接受版本严格更高的页**：同版本重复固化直接拒绝，杜绝同页重复更新被漏记。\n- **`parent_meta_crc`**：子检查点记录父 `meta.json` 的 CRC，可发现父元数据被静默改写。\n- **合并默认不删源（`compact:false`）**；`compact:true` 只在 merged 原子发布成功后\n  删除中间节点，且要求 tip 是当前尖端（否则会打断现存检查点的父链）。\n- **故障注入是一个 I/O 装饰器**（[`FaultyIo`](src/io.rs)），按\n  “操作类型（write_atomic/rename_publish/remove/…）+ 第 N 次命中”注入错误，\n  业务代码不感知，磁盘路径与真实运行完全一致。\n\n## 6. 目录结构\n\n```\nsrc/\n├── main.rs        # CLI 入口\n├── lib.rs\n├── error.rs       # EngineError（MissingParent/Cycle/Checksum/VersionRegression…）\n├── checksum.rs    # CRC32 + hex\n├── io.rs          # IoBackend trait / DiskIo / FaultyIo（同步边界所在）\n├── storage.rs     # 磁盘格式、暂存发布、崩溃后清理\n├── engine.rs      # 写页 / full / incremental / 严格父链恢复 / merge\n├── http.rs        # 手写 HTTP/1.1 路由\n└── server.rs      # TcpListener 装配\ntests/             # basic / faults / property / http_api 集成测试\ndocs/              # disk-format.md / api.md\nexamples/          # requests.http / demo*.sh\n```\n\n## 7. 实际运行记录\n\n命令、输出与未通过项如实记录在 [`RUNLOG.md`](RUNLOG.md)。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_1643edb981428160921d1ba1","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":979,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":94008,"output_tokens":2153,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"5d00db53-8acf-4968-8a85-547bf852076f","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:29:27.449Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

当前工作集：p0.bin … pN-1.bin（原子覆盖）\n        ├── checkpoints/\n        │   ├── <ds>-cp000001/      # full\n        │   │   ├── meta.json       # id/kind/parent/parent_meta_crc/pages...\n        │   │   └── pages/p<id>.bin # 定长页内容\n        │   ├── <ds>-cp000002/      # incremental（parent 指向前一检查点）\n        │   ├── <ds>-mrg000007/     # merged（无父，含 merged_sources）\n        │   └── .staging.<id>/      # 发布前暂存（崩溃后重开自动清理）\n        └── .orphans/               # 发布了一半（无 meta）的目录被隔离于此\n```\n\n完整字段说明见 [`docs/disk-format.md`](docs/disk-format.md)。\n\n### 同步边界（什么时候数据算落盘）\n\n- 每个文件写入 = **临时文件 → `fsync(file)` → `rename` → `fsync(父目录)`**\n  （[`IoBackend::write_atomic`](src/io.rs)）。调用方要么看到旧文件要么看到新文件。\n- 检查点发布 = 所有页与 `meta.json` 先写入 `.staging.<id>/` 并 fsync，\n  然后**一次目录 rename** 原子发布 + fsync 父目录（主要同步边界），\n  最后才原子更新 `state.json`。\n- 因此发布 rename 之前崩溃：正式空间看不到该检查点，暂存目录重开时清除；\n  rename 之后崩溃：检查点完整可见。\n- **边界声明**：只保证单进程崩溃一致性；不做多进程/多机并发协调、不做 WAL、\n  不做页级 mmap。本地 HTTP 服务默认只绑定 `127.0.0.1`，无鉴权/TLS。\n\n## 3. 构建与运行\n\n```bash\ncargo build --release\ncargo run -- --root ./cpengine-data --addr 127.0.0.1:8088\n# 可选 --no-faulty 关闭 /faults 故障注入端点\n```\n\n需要 Rust 1.74+（使用了 `split_once` 等稳定 API）。依赖只有\n`serde` / `serde_json` / `crc32fast`。\n\n快速手动演练：\n\n```bash\nexamples/demo.sh                 # 完整 happy-path（建数据集→写页→检查点→恢复→合并）\nexamples/demo-faults.sh          # 父链缺失 / 循环 / CRC / 发布中断演练\n```\n\nHTTP 接口与字段见 [`docs/api.md`](docs/api.md)，可直接在 REST 客户端执行的请求样例见\n[`examples/requests.http`](examples/requests.http)。\n\n## 4. 自动化测试\n\n```bash\ncargo test                       # 全部单元 + 集成测试\ncargo test --test faults -- --nocapture\n```\n\n测试矩阵（对应验收点）：\n\n| 验收点 | 测试 |\n|---|---|\n| 同页多次更新、全量/增量链、页摘要对照 | `tests/basic.rs::same_page_multiple_updates_full_incremental_chain` |\n| 对照逐次更新后的页摘要（确定性随机 12+ 种子） | `tests/property.rs::property_random_update_checkpoint_restore_seeds` |\n| 父链缺失（中间节点/链根）严格报错 | `tests/faults.rs::missing_parent_*` |\n| 循环依赖（回指环 + 自环）严格报错 | `tests/faults.rs::cycle_dependency_is_detected` |\n| CRC 损坏（根页/增量页）严格报错 | `tests/faults.rs::checksum_corruption_is_detected_on_restore_and_merge` |\n| 合并保持最终页内容 | `tests/faults.rs::merge_preserves_final_page_content_against_sequential_updates`、`tests/property.rs::property_merge_after_random_sequence_matches_model` |\n| 合并/检查点发布中断不留半成品，重启恢复 | `tests/faults.rs::interrupted_merge_*`、`crash_before_publish_*` |\n| HTTP 端到端（含故障端点、错误码） | `tests/http_api.rs` |\n\n## 5. 关键设计取舍\n\n- **恢复从全零重建**而不是叠加当前工作集：避免“旧页残留被误认为链内容”\n  （`tests/basic.rs::restore_rebuilds_from_zero_not_from_current_workset`）。\n- **增量只接受版本严格更高的页**：同版本重复固化直接拒绝，杜绝同页重复更新被漏记。\n- **`parent_meta_crc`**：子检查点记录父 `meta.json` 的 CRC，可发现父元数据被静默改写。\n- **合并默认不删源（`compact:false`）**；`compact:true` 只在 merged 原子发布成功后\n  删除中间节点，且要求 tip 是当前尖端（否则会打断现存检查点的父链）。\n- **故障注入是一个 I/O 装饰器**（[`FaultyIo`](src/io.rs)），按\n  “操作类型（write_atomic/rename_publish/remove/…）+ 第 N 次命中”注入错误，\n  业务代码不感知，磁盘路径与真实运行完全一致。\n\n## 6. 目录结构\n\n```\nsrc/\n├── main.rs        # CLI 入口\n├── lib.rs\n├── error.rs       # EngineError（MissingParent/Cycle/Checksum/VersionRegression…）\n├── checksum.rs    # CRC32 + hex\n├── io.rs          # IoBackend trait / DiskIo / FaultyIo（同步边界所在）\n├── storage.rs     # 磁盘格式、暂存发布、崩溃后清理\n├── engine.rs      # 写页 / full / incremental / 严格父链恢复 / merge\n├── http.rs        # 手写 HTTP/1.1 路由\n└── server.rs      # TcpListener 装配\ntests/             # basic / faults / property / http_api 集成测试\ndocs/              # disk-format.md / api.md\nexamples/          # requests.http / demo*.sh\n```\n\n## 7. 实际运行记录\n\n命令、输出与未通过项如实记录在 [`RUNLOG.md`](RUNLOG.md)。\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"5d00db53-8acf-4968-8a85-547bf852076f","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

{"parentUuid":"07d344fa-54e3-4313-9a1d-a1c9fb90bcf8","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_i5f451wa3alr8njuka1er4m2","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/docs/disk-format.md","content":"# 磁盘格式说明（format version = 1）\n\n所有 JSON 文件均为 `serde_json`  pretty JSON（UTF-8、无 BOM）；页文件为原始字节。\n标识符（数据集名、检查点 ID 自定义部分）只允许 `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`，长度 1..=64，\n不得以 `.` 开头，因此不存在路径穿越空间。\n\n## 1. 存储库布局\n\n```\n<root>/\n├── repo.json\n└── datasets/\n    └── <dataset>/\n        ├── state.json\n        ├── working/\n        │   ├── p0.bin\n        │   └── ...\n        ├── checkpoints/\n        │   ├── <dataset>-cp000001/\n        │   │   ├── meta.json\n        │   │   └── pages/\n        │   │       ├── p0.bin\n        │   │       └── ...\n        │   ├── <dataset>-cp000002/\n        │   ├── <dataset>-mrg000005/\n        │   └── .staging.<dataset>-cpNNNNNN/     # 发布前暂存\n        └── .orphans/                            # 发布了一半的目录隔离区\n```\n\n检查点 ID 由引擎分配：\n\n- 普通检查点：`<dataset>-cp<seq:06>`，其中 seq 取自 `state.next_seq`（从 1 起）。\n- 合并检查点：`<dataset>-mrg<seq:06>`。\n\n## 2. `repo.json`\n\n```json\n{\n  \"format_version\": 1,\n  \"engine\": \"incremental-checkpoint-engine\",\n  \"created_at_ms\": 1727000000000\n}\n```\n\n## 3. `state.json`（每个数据集一份）\n\n```json\n{\n  \"format_version\": 1,\n  \"dataset\": \"demo\",\n  \"page_size\": 16,\n  \"page_count\": 4,\n  \"next_seq\": 7,\n  \"page_versions\": [3, 1, 0, 0],\n  \"current_crc\": [\"a1b2c3d4\", \"11223344\", \"c9bce2ae\", \"c9bce2ae\"],\n  \"tip\": \"demo-cp000006\",\n  \"created_at_ms\": 1727000000000\n}\n```\n\n- `page_size` / `page_count`：数据集创建后**不可变**；任何写入长度不符或页 id\n  越界都返回 400/`BadRequest`。\n- `page_versions[i]`：页 i 的当前版本，从 0 开始，每写一次 +1。\n- `current_crc[i]`：工作集该页当前内容的 CRC32 hex。零页 CRC 随 `page_size` 变化，\n  初始化时按全零计算（例如 16 字节零页为 `c9bce2ae` 之外的值，以实际计算为准）。\n- `tip`：最近一次创建检查点的 id；增量检查点未显式给 parent 时挂在 tip 上。\n  该字段用 `#[serde(default)]` 兼容旧文件，缺失视为 null。\n- `next_seq`：下一个检查点序号。进程重开时会校正为“磁盘上最大 seq + 1”。\n\n## 4. 检查点 `meta.json`\n\n```json\n{\n  \"id\": \"demo-cp000003\",\n  \"kind\": \"incremental\",\n  \"parent\": \"demo-cp000002\",\n  \"parent_meta_crc\": \"8d1f9a20\",\n  \"dataset\": \"demo\",\n  \"seq\": 3,\n  \"created_at_ms\": 1727000001234,\n  \"pages\": {\n    \"0\": { \"version\": 2, \"size\": 16, \"crc\": \"3a2f1c99\" },\n    \"1\": { \"version\": 1, \"size\": 16, \"crc\": \"7766a10b\" }\n  },\n  \"page_ids\": [0, 1],\n  \"merged_sources\": [],\n  \"conflicts\": []\n}\n```\n\n字段语义：\n\n| 字段 | 说明 |\n|---|---|\n| `kind` | `full`（全部页、无父）/ `incremental`（脏页子集、必有父）/ `merged`（合并产物、无父、全部页） |\n| `parent` | 父检查点 id；full/merged 为 `null` |\n| `parent_meta_crc` | 父 `meta.json` **文件字节**的 CRC32 hex；用于发现父元数据被篡改 |\n| `pages.<id>.version` | 该页内容在数据集中的版本（= 发布时 state.page_versions[id]；merged 取链上应用后的版本） |\n| `pages.<id>.size` | 必须恒等于数据集 `page_size` |\n| `pages.<id>.crc` | `pages/p<id>.bin` 文件字节的 CRC32（IEEE）hex |\n| `merged_sources` | merged 记录被压缩的源检查点 id（base 自身不含在内） |\n| `conflicts` | 预留给多分支合并；当前严格线性链合并恒为空，同版本不同内容会直接报 `VersionRegression` |\n\n页内容文件：`pages/p<id>.bin`，**恰好 `page_size` 字节**，无额外头部。\n\n## 5. 不变量（引擎负责维持）\n\n1. full/merged 的 `pages` 恰好包含 `0..page_count` 全部页；`parent = null`。\n2. incremental 至少 1 页且每页版本**严格大于**父链上该页已知最大版本；`parent` 非空。\n3. 任一 `pages` 条目与其 `.bin` 的 CRC、size 一致（读取时必校验）。\n4. 依赖链终止于某个 full/merged；中间不得缺环、不得重复节点。\n5. 沿链从根到尖应用时，每页版本单调不降；同版本内容必须相同。\n\n## 6. 崩溃恢复时的目录处置\n\n进程打开存储库时（`Repository::open`）执行一次性清理：\n\n- `checkpoints/.staging.*`：**删除**（rename 发布前的暂存，从未对外可见）。\n- `checkpoints/<正式名>/` 但缺少 `meta.json`：移动到 `.orphans/<名字>` 隔离保留。\n- `next_seq` 小于磁盘最大 seq 时校正为 max+1。\n- **不**自动修复/隔离父链断裂的正式检查点 —— 那是要严格暴露的故障形态。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_69ea51216207cf728767fe69","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":3136,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":94008,"output_tokens":1707,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"765d7a35-a61f-45b2-a777-3e196cee6c8c","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:30:09.177Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

不变量（引擎负责维持）\n\n1. full/merged 的 `pages` 恰好包含 `0..page_count` 全部页；`parent = null`。\n2. incremental 至少 1 页且每页版本**严格大于**父链上该页已知最大版本；`parent` 非空。\n3. 任一 `pages` 条目与其 `.bin` 的 CRC、size 一致（读取时必校验）。\n4. 依赖链终止于某个 full/merged；中间不得缺环、不得重复节点。\n5. 沿链从根到尖应用时，每页版本单调不降；同版本内容必须相同。\n\n## 6. 崩溃恢复时的目录处置\n\n进程打开存储库时（`Repository::open`）执行一次性清理：\n\n- `checkpoints/.staging.*`：**删除**（rename 发布前的暂存，从未对外可见）。\n- `checkpoints/<正式名>/` 但缺少 `meta.json`：移动到 `.orphans/<名字>` 隔离保留。\n- `next_seq` 小于磁盘最大 seq 时校正为 max+1。\n- **不**自动修复/隔离父链断裂的正式检查点 —— 那是要严格暴露的故障形态。\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"765d7a35-a61f-45b2-a777-3e196cee6c8c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

{"parentUuid":"3cee048b-c5c1-48c6-848d-74fa2e5dadbf","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_2m99zktjy47zfj6g70h193qk","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/docs/api.md","content":"# HTTP API（本地验证入口）\n\n默认 `http://127.0.0.1:8088`。所有请求/响应使用 JSON（页内容用小写 hex 传输）。\n\n- 成功：`200/201`，`{\"ok\": true, \"data\": ...}`\n- 失败：`4xx/5xx`，`{\"ok\": false, \"error\": {\"code\": \"...\", \"message\": \"...\"}}`\n\n错误码：`bad_request` / `not_found` / `conflict` / `missing_parent` /\n`cycle_detected` / `checksum_mismatch` / `version_regression` /\n`injected_fault` / `bad_json`。\n\n## 数据集\n\n### `POST /datasets`\n```json\n{ \"name\": \"demo\", \"page_size\": 16, \"page_count\": 4 }\n```\n→ 201，返回 state.json 内容。`page_size/page_count` 此后不可变。\n\n### `GET /datasets` / `GET /datasets/{name}` / `DELETE /datasets/{name}`\n\n### `GET /datasets/{name}/digest`\n逐页摘要（对照逐次更新结果的主要手段）：\n```json\n{ \"digest\": [ {\"page\":0,\"version\":3,\"size\":16,\"crc\":\"3a2f1c99\"}, ... ] }\n```\n\n## 页（工作集）\n\n### `PUT /datasets/{name}/pages/{page}`\n三种 body：\n```json\n{ \"hex\": \"010203...\" }   // 恰好 page_size 字节（hex 后）\n{ \"byte\": 65 }            // 整页填同一字节\n{ \"pattern\": 7 }          // 可辨识测试图案：tag + (offset % 7)\n```\n→ 页版本 +1，返回新摘要。长度不符 / 越界 → 400。\n\n### `GET /datasets/{name}/pages/{page}`\n```json\n{ \"page\": {\"page\":0,\"version\":2,\"size\":16,\"crc\":\"...\"}, \"hex\": \"....\" }\n```\n\n## 检查点\n\n### `POST /datasets/{name}/checkpoints/full`\nbody 可空 `{}`。固化全部页，返回 meta。\n\n### `POST /datasets/{name}/checkpoints/incremental`\n```json\n{ \"parent\": \"demo-cp000001\", \"pages\": [0, 2] }\n```\n`parent` 省略时使用 `state.tip`。任一指定页版本未严格高于父链已知版本 → 400。\n\n### `GET /datasets/{name}/checkpoints`\n全部检查点 meta。\n\n### `GET /datasets/{name}/checkpoints/{id}`\n单个 meta。\n\n### `GET /datasets/{name}/checkpoints/{id}/chain`\n严格解析依赖链：\n```json\n{ \"tip\": \"demo-cp000003\", \"chain\": [\"demo-cp000001\",\"demo-cp000002\",\"demo-cp000003\"] }\n```\n父缺失 → 409 `missing_parent`；环 → 409 `cycle_detected`。\n\n### `POST /datasets/{name}/checkpoints/{id}/restore`\n从**全零页**沿链 root→id 应用，安装到工作集。返回：\n```json\n{\n  \"target\": \"demo-cp000003\",\n  \"chain\": [\"...\"],\n  \"applied_pages\": { \"demo-cp000001\": [0,1,2,3], \"demo-cp000002\": [0] },\n  \"digest\": [ ... ]\n}\n```\nCRC 损坏 → 409 `checksum_mismatch`；版本回退 → 409 `version_regression`。\n\n## 合并\n\n### `POST /datasets/{name}/merge`\n```json\n{ \"base\": \"demo-cp000001\", \"tip\": \"demo-cp000005\", \"compact\": false }\n```\n- `base` 必须是 full/merged，且必须出现在 tip 的依赖链中。\n- 产物为无父 merged 全量（`<ds>-mrgNNNNNN`），含全部页与最终版本。\n- `compact:true` 在 merged 发布成功后删除中间源节点（要求 tip 是当前尖端）。\n→ 201，返回 MergeReport（sources / page_counts / merged_page_count 等）。\n\n## 故障演练（仅 `--faulty` 启动时可用）\n\n### `POST /faults`\n```json\n{ \"op\": \"rename_publish\", \"trigger_at\": 1, \"persistent\": false, \"note\": \"模拟掉电\" }\n```\n`op` ∈ `write_atomic` / `rename_publish` / `dir_sync` / `mkdir` / `remove`；\n`trigger_at` 为 1 起算的命中次数；`persistent:false` 表示一次性（触发后自动解除）。\n\n### `GET /faults`（当前计划，未武装返回 data=null） / `DELETE /faults`（解除）\n\n### 损坏钩子（测试用，直接改磁盘）\n- `POST /datasets/{name}/checkpoints/{id}/corrupt` — `{\"page\":0,\"byte\":200}` 或 `{\"hex\":\"...\"}`\n- `POST /datasets/{name}/checkpoints/{id}/rewire` — `{\"parent\":\"<其它检查点>\"}`（造环）\n- `POST /datasets/{name}/checkpoints/{id}/delete` — 删除整个检查点目录（造父链缺失）\n\n### `GET /datasets/{name}/orphans`\n查看崩溃后被隔离的半成品目录名。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_1a4f9fcb3c9383dec0d862da","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1809,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":97080,"output_tokens":1425,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"1e97bd6e-b0a9-4afb-b050-0d96d44f22a5","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:30:41.351Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

{"parentUuid":"6abc20cf-680d-4063-8b08-7b09970cc63c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_sha9nw5vpiai5oqt1gqtfq7g","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/examples/requests.http","content":"### 增量检查点引擎 —— HTTP 请求样例\n### 兼容 VS Code REST Client / JetBrains HTTP Client；变量 @baseUrl 可改。\n@baseUrl = http://127.0.0.1:8088\n@ds = demo\n\n### 0. 健康检查\nGET {{baseUrl}}/\n\n### 1. 创建固定页数据集（每页 16 字节，共 4 页）\nPOST {{baseUrl}}/datasets\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"name\": \"{{ds}}\", \"page_size\": 16, \"page_count\": 4 }\n\n### 2. 初始全量检查点（零页）\nPOST {{baseUrl}}/datasets/{{ds}}/checkpoints/full\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{}\n\n### 3. 同页多次更新：页 0 连写三次，页 1 写一次\nPUT {{baseUrl}}/datasets/{{ds}}/pages/0\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"pattern\": 1 }\n\n###\nPUT {{baseUrl}}/datasets/{{ds}}/pages/0\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"pattern\": 2 }\n\n###\nPUT {{baseUrl}}/datasets/{{ds}}/pages/0\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"pattern\": 3 }\n\n###\nPUT {{baseUrl}}/datasets/{{ds}}/pages/1\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"byte\": 65 }\n\n### 4. 增量检查点（页 0 已到版本 3）\n# @name inc1\nPOST {{baseUrl}}/datasets/{{ds}}/checkpoints/incremental\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"pages\": [0] }\n\n###\n@i1 = {{inc1.response.body.data.id}}\n\n### 5. 再写页 1 并打第二个增量\nPUT {{baseUrl}}/datasets/{{ds}}/pages/1\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"pattern\": 9 }\n\n###\n# @name inc2\nPOST {{baseUrl}}/datasets/{{ds}}/checkpoints/incremental\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"pages\": [1] }\n\n###\n@i2 = {{inc2.response.body.data.id}}\n\n### 6. 查看严格父链\nGET {{baseUrl}}/datasets/{{ds}}/checkpoints/{{i2}}/chain\n\n### 7. 当前逐页摘要（逐次更新后的真值）\nGET {{baseUrl}}/datasets/{{ds}}/digest\n\n### 8. 破坏工作集（全部填 0xff）\nPUT {{baseUrl}}/datasets/{{ds}}/pages/0\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"byte\": 255 }\n\n### 9. 沿依赖链恢复到 i2\nPOST -> 偶尔打全量/增量”序列，\n//! 在每个检查点后对照参考模型摘要，并随机恢复到链上任意检查点，\n//! 用重放同一序列的方式验证恢复结果严格正确。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse cpengine::engine::digest_equal;\n\n/// 确定性简易 LCG（不依赖 rand crate）。\nstruct Rng(u64);\nimpl Rng {\n    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        // MMIX 常数。\n        self.0 = self.0.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);\n        self.0\n    }\n    fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> u64 {\n        self.next_u64() % n\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在给定 seed 下执行随机序列并验证。\nfn run_property(seed: u64, page_size: u32, page_count: u32, steps: u32) {\n    let (e, root) = disk_engine(&format!(\"prop-{seed}\"));\n    let ds = \"p\";\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n\n    let mut rng = Rng(seed.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) ^ 0xdead_beef);\n\n    // 记录每个检查点创建时刻，参考模型应当具有的页内容。\n    // 我们不保存全部历史内容，而是：恢复到检查点 id 时，用记录的“逐页 (version,crc)”\n    // 与恢复后摘要直接比较。\n    let mut snapshots: Vec<(String, Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite>)> = Vec::new();\n\n    // 参考模型实时镜像当前工作集。\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n\n    for step in 0..steps {\n        let action = rng.below(10);\n        match action {\n            0..=5 => {\n                // 写 1~2 个随机页。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(2);\n                for _ in 0..n {\n                    let page = rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32;\n                    let tag = rng.below(200) as u8;\n                    let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(page_size as usize, tag);\n                    e.write_page(ds, page, &data).expect(\"write\");\n                    model.write_page(page, data);\n                }\n                model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n            }\n            6 => {\n                // 全量。\n                let meta = e.checkpoint_full(ds).expect(\"full\");\n                let snap = model\n                    .digest()\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .map(common_hack::lite)\n                    .collect();\n                snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n            }\n            7..=8 => {\n                // 增量：收集随机数量的脏页（只选当前版本>0的页，或允许新页）。\n                // 为保证合法，我们只提交“自上次检查点后确实写过”的页：\n                // 简化做法——尝试随机页集合，引擎若以 BadRequest 拒绝则跳过，\n                // 但必须保证：成功时摘要不变、链可解析。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(page_count as u64.min(3));\n                let pages: Vec<u32> = (0..n)\n                    .map(|_| rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32)\n                    .collect();\n                match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, None, &pages) {\n                    Ok(meta) => {\n                        // 成功前提：这些页版本都高于父链。记录快照。\n                        let snap = model\n                            .digest()\n                            .into_iter()\n                            .map(common_hack::lite)\n                            .collect();\n                        snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n                    }\n                    Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {\n                        // 合法拒绝（页不够新/无父/空集去重后为空）。\n                    }\n                    Err(other) => panic!(\"增量出现非预期错误: {other:?}\"),\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // 随机恢复到某个历史检查点（如果有）。\n                if snapshots.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let idx = rng.below(snapshots.len() as u64) as usize;\n                let (id, snap) = &snapshots[idx];\n                let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore 历史检查点\");\n                assert_eq!(*report.chain.last().unwrap(), *id);\n                let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n                let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n                assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap, \"seed={seed} step={step} 恢复到 {id} 后摘要与历史不符\");\n                // 恢复后参考模型也要回滚：从引擎工作集读回真实字节与版本重建。\n                model = model_from_engine(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 最终：对每个快照再做一次全量恢复校验，并重启进程验证持久化。\n    for (id, snap) in &snapshots {\n        let report = }","originalFile":"//! 属性式测试：随机“写页 -> 偶尔打全量/增量”序列，\n//! 在每个检查点后对照参考模型摘要，并随机恢复到链上任意检查点，\n//! 用重放同一序列的方式验证恢复结果严格正确。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse cpengine::engine::digest_equal;\n\n/// 确定性简易 LCG（不依赖 rand crate）。\nstruct Rng(u64);\nimpl Rng {\n    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        // MMIX 常数。\n        self.0 = self.0.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);\n        self.0\n    }\n    fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> u64 {\n        self.next_u64() % n\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在给定 seed 下执行随机序列并验证。\nfn run_property(seed: u64, page_size: u32, page_count: u32, steps: u32) {\n    let (e, root) = disk_engine(&format!(\"prop-{seed}\"));\n    let ds = \"p\";\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n\n    let mut rng = Rng(seed.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) ^ 0xdead_beef);\n\n    // 记录每个检查点创建时刻，参考模型应当具有的页内容。\n    // 我们不保存全部历史内容，而是：恢复到检查点 id 时，用记录的“逐页 (version,crc)”\n    // 与恢复后摘要直接比较。\n    let mut snapshots: Vec<(String, Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite>)> = Vec::new();\n\n    // 参考模型实时镜像当前工作集。\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n\n    for step in 0..steps {\n        let action = rng.below(10);\n        match action {\n            0..=5 => {\n                // 写 1~2 个随机页。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(2);\n                for _ in 0..n {\n                    let page = rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32;\n                    let tag = rng.below(200) as u8;\n                    let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(page_size as usize, tag);\n                    e.write_page(ds, page, &data).expect(\"write\");\n                    model.write_page(page, data);\n                }\n                model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n            }\n            6 => {\n                // 全量。\n                let meta = e.checkpoint_full(ds).expect(\"full\");\n                let snap = model\n                    .digest()\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .map(common_hack::lite)\n                    .collect();\n                snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n            }\n            7..=8 => {\n                // 增量：收集随机数量的脏页（只选当前版本>0的页，或允许新页）。\n                // 为保证合法，我们只提交“自上次检查点后确实写过”的页：\n                // 简化做法——尝试随机页集合，引擎若以 BadRequest 拒绝则跳过，\n                // 但必须保证：成功时摘要不变、链可解析。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(page_count as u64.min(3));\n                let pages: Vec<u32> = (0..n)\n                    .map(|_| rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32)\n                    .collect();\n                match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, None, &pages) {\n                    Ok(meta) => {\n                        // 成功前提：这些页版本都高于父链。记录快照。\n                        let snap = model\n                            .digest()\n                            .into_iter()\n                            .map(common_hack::lite)\n                            .collect();\n                        snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n                    }\n                    Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {\n                        // 合法拒绝（页不够新/无父/空集去重后为空）。\n                    }\n                    Err(other) => panic!(\"增量出现非预期错误: {other:?}\"),\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // 随机恢复到某个历史检查点（如果有）。\n                if snapshots.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let idx = rng.below(snapshots.len() as u64) as usize;\n                let (id, snap) = &snapshots[idx];\n                let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore 历史检查点\");\n                assert_eq!(*report.chain.last().unwrap(), *id);\n                let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n                let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n                assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap, \"seed={seed} step={step} 恢复到 {id} 后摘要与历史不符\");\n                // 恢复后参考模型也要回滚：从引擎工作集读回真实字节与版本重建。\n                model = model_from_engine(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 最终：对每个快照再做一次全量恢复校验，并重启进程验证持久化。\n    for (id, snap) in &snapshots {\n        let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore\");\n        assert_eq!(report.chain.last().unwrap(), id);\n        let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n        assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap);\n    }\n    if !snapshots.is_empty() {\n        let e2 = reopen_disk(&root);\n        let (id, snap) = snapshots.last().unwrap();\n        e2.restore(ds, id).unwrap();\n        let after = e2.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n        assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap);\n    }\n}\n\nmod common_hack {\n    /// 可比较的摘要三元组（不依赖 Serialize）。\n    #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Clone)]\n    pub struct PageDigestLite {\n        pub page: u32,\n        pub version: u64,\n        pub crc: String,\n    }\n    pub fn lite(d: cpengine::engine::PageDigest) -> PageDigestLite {\n        PageDigestLite {\n            page: d.page,\n            version: d.version,\n            crc: d.crc,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn lite_all(d: &[cpengine::engine::PageDigest]) -> Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite> {\n    d.iter().cloned().map(common_hack::lite).collect()\n}\n\n/// 从引擎当前工作集读回全部页，重建参考模型（随机恢复后使用）。\nfn model_from_engine(\n    e: &Engine,\n    ds: &str,\n    page_size: u32,\n    page_count: u32,\n) -> ReferenceModel {\n    let st = e.state(ds).unwrap();\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n    for p in 0..page_count {\n        let (bytes, info) = e.read_page(ds, p).unwrap();\n        model.data[p as usize] = bytes;\n        model.versions[p as usize] = st.page_versions[p as usize].max(info.version);\n    }\n    model\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_random_update_checkpoint_restore_seeds() {\n    for seed in 1..=12u64 {\n        run_property(seed, 8, 3, 60);\n    }\n    // 稍大的页与更长序列。\n    run_property(101, 64, 6, 120);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_merge_after_random_sequence_matches_model() {\n    // 独立确定性场景：随机更新 -> 形成单链 -> 全量合并 -> 逐页对照。\n    let (e, _root) = disk_engine(\"prop-merge\");\n    let ds = \"m\";\n    let (ps, pc) = (16u32, 5u32);\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, ps, pc);\n    let mut rng = Rng(0x1234_5678);\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(ps, pc);\n\n    let base = e.checkpoint_full(ds).unwrap();\n    let mut tip = base.id.clone();\n    for _ in 0..8 {\n        let page = rng.below(pc as u64) as u32;\n        let tag = rng.below(250) as u8;\n        let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(ps as usize, tag);\n        e.write_page(ds, page, &data).unwrap();\n        model.write_page(page, data);\n        match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, Some(&tip), &[page]) {\n            Ok(m) => tip = m.id,\n            Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {}\n            Err(o) => panic!(\"{o:?}\"),\n        }\n    }\n    let truth = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n    model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n\n    let report = e\n        .merge_checkpoints(ds, &base.id, &tip, false)\n        .unwrap();\n    e.restore(ds, &report.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth, &after));\n    assert_eq!(report.merged_page_count, pc as usize);\n\n    // compact 合并后 merged 依然逐页等于真值。\n    let report2 = e\n        .merge_checkpoints(ds, &base.id, &tip, true)\n        .unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!(\"compact 合并失败\"));\n    e.restore(ds, &report2.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after2 = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth, &after2));\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":54,"oldLines":11,"newStart":54,"newLines":7,"lines":["             6 => {","  fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> u64 {\n        self.next_u64() % n\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在给定 seed 下执行随机序列并验证。\nfn run_property(seed: u64, page_size: u32, page_count: u32, steps: u32) {\n    let (e, root) = 记录每个检查点创建时刻，参考模型应当具有的页内容。\n    // 我们不保存全部历史内容，而是：恢复到检查点 id 时，用记录的“逐页 (version,crc)”\n    // 与恢复后摘要直接比较。\n    let mut snapshots: Vec<(String, Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite>)> = Vec::new();\n\n    // 参考模型实时镜像当前工作集。\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n\n    for step in 0..steps {\n        let action = rng.below(10);\n        match action {\n            0..=5 => {\n                // 写 1~2 个随机页。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(2);\n                for _ in 0..n {\n                    let page = rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32;\n                    let tag = rng.below(200) as u8;\n                    let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(page_size as usize, tag);\n                    e.write_page(ds, page, &data).expect(\"write\");\n                    model.write_page(page, data);\n                }\n                model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n            }\n            6 => {\n                // 全量。\n                let meta = e.checkpoint_full(ds).expect(\"full\");\n                let snap = lite_all(&model.digest());\n                snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n            }\n            7..=8 => {\n                // 增量：收集随机数量的脏页（只选当前版本>0的页，或允许新页）。\n                // 为保证合法，我们只提交“自上次检查点后确实写过”的页：\n                // 简化做法——尝试随机页集合，引擎若以 BadRequest 拒绝则跳过，\n                // 但必须保证：成功时摘要不变、链可解析。\n                let        match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, None, &pages) {\n                    Ok(meta) => {\n                        // 成功前提：这些页版本都高于父链。记录快照。\n                        let snap = model\n                            .digest()\n                            .into_iter()\n                            .map(common_hack::lite)\n                            .collect();\n                        snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n                    }\n                    Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {\n                        // 合法拒绝（页不够新/无父/空集去重后为空）。\n                    }\n                    Err(other) => panic!(\"增量出现非预期错误: {other:?}\"),\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // 随机恢复到某个历史检查点（如果有）。\n                if snapshots.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let idx = rng.below(snapshots.len() as u64) as usize;\n                let (id, snap) = &snapshots[idx];\n                let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore 历史检查点\");\n                assert_eq!(*report.chain.last().unwrap(), *id);\n                let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n                let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n                assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap, \"seed={seed} step={step} 恢复到 {id} 后摘要与历史不符\");\n                // 恢复后参考模型也要回滚：从引擎工作集读回真实字节与版本重建。\n                model = model_from_engine(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 最终：对每个快照再做一次全量恢复校验，并重启进程验证持久化。\n    for (id, snap) in &snapshots {\n        let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore\");\n        assert_eq!(report.chain.last().unwrap(), id);\n        let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n        assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap);\n    }\n    if !snapshots.is_empty() {\n        let e2 = reopen_disk(&root);\n        let (id, snap) = snapshots.last().unwrap();\n        e2.restore(ds, id).unwrap();\n        let after = e2.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n        assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap);\n    }\n}\n\nmod common_hack {\n    /// 可比较的摘要三元组（不依赖 Serialize）。\n    #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Clone)]\n    pub struct PageDigestLite {\n        pub page: u32,\n        pub version: u64,\n        pub crc: String,\n    }\n    pub fn lite(d: cpengine::engine::PageDigest) -> PageDigestLite {\n        PageDigestLite {\n            page: d.page,\n            version: d.version,\n            crc: d.crc,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn lite_all(d: &[cpengine::engine::PageDigest]) -> Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite> {\n    d.iter().cloned().map(common_hack::lite).collect()\n}\n\n/// 从引擎当前工作集读回全部页，重建参考模型（随机恢复后使用）。\nfn model_from_engine(\n    e: &Engine,\n    ds: &str,\n    page_size: u32,\n    page_count: u32,\n) -> ReferenceModel {\n    let st = e.state(ds).unwrap();\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n    for p in 0..page_count {\n        let (bytes, info) = e.read_page(ds, p).unwrap();\n        model.data[p as usize] = bytes;\n        model.versions[p as usize] = st.page_versions[p as usize].max(info.version);\n    }\n    model\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_random_update_checkpoint_restore_seeds() {\n    for seed in 1..=12u64 {\n        run_property(seed, 8, 3, 60);\n    }\n    // 稍大的页与更长序列。\n    run_property(101, 64, 6, 120);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_merge_after_random_sequence_matches_model() {\n    // 独立确定性场景：随机更新 -> 形成单链 -> 全量合并 -> 逐页对照。\n    let (e, _root) = disk_engine(\"prop-merge\");\n    let ds = \"m\";\n    let (ps, pc) = (16u32,       e.write_page(ds, page, &data).unwrap();\n        model.write_page(page, data);\n        match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, Some(&tip), &[page]) {\n            Ok(m) => tip = m.id,\n
