e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after = lite_all(&after);\n        assert_eq!(lite_after, *snap);\n    }","originalFile":"//! 属性式测试：随机“写页 -> 偶尔打全量/增量”序列，\n//! 在每个检查点后对照参考模型摘要，并随机恢复到链上任意检查点，\n//! 用重放同一序列的方式验证恢复结果严格正确。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse cpengine::engine::digest_equal;\n\n/// 确定性简易 LCG（不依赖 rand crate）。\nstruct Rng(u64);\nimpl Rng {\n    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        // MMIX 常数。\n        self.0 = self.0.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);\n        self.0\n    }\n    fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> u64 {\n        self.next_u64() % n\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在给定 seed 下执行随机序列并验证。\nfn run_property(seed: u64, page_size: u32, page_count: u32, steps: u32) {\n    let (e, root) = disk_engine(&format!(\"prop-{seed}\"));\n    let ds = \"p\";\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n\n    let mut rng = Rng(seed.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) ^ 0xdead_beef);\n\n    // 记录每个检查点创建时刻，参考模型应当具有的页内容。\n    // 我们不保存全部历史内容，而是：恢复到检查点 id 时，用记录的“逐页 (version,crc)”\n    // 与恢复后摘要直接比较。\n    let mut snapshots: Vec<(String, Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite>)> = Vec::new();\n\n    // 参考模型实时镜像当前工作集。\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n\n    for step in 0..steps {\n        let action = rng.below(10);\n        match action {\n            0..=5 => {\n                // 写 1~2 个随机页。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(2);\n                for _ in 0..n {\n                    let page = rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32;\n                    let tag = rng.below(200) as u8;\n                    let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(page_size as usize, tag);\n                    e.write_page(ds, page, &data).expect(\"write\");\n                    model.write_page(page, data);\n                }\n                model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n            }\n            6 => {\n                // 全量。\n                let meta = e.checkpoint_full(ds).expect(\"full\");\n                let snap = lite_all(&model.digest());\n                snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n            }\n            7..=8 => {\n                // 增量：收集随机数量的脏页（只选当前版本>0的页，或允许新页）。\n                // 为保证合法，我们只提交“自上次检查点后确实写过”的页：\n                // 简化做法——尝试随机页集合，引擎若以 BadRequest 拒绝则跳过，\n                // 但必须保证：成功时摘要不变、链可解析。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(page_count as u64.min(3));\n                let pages: Vec<u32> = (0..n)\n                    .map(|_| rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32)\n                    .collect();\n                match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, None, &pages) {\n                    Ok(meta) => {\n                        // 成功前提：这些页版本都高于父链。记录快照。\n                        let snap = lite_all(&model.digest());\n                        snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n                    }\n                    Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {\n                        // 合法拒绝（页不够新/无父/空集去重后为空）。\n                    }\n                    Err(other) => panic!(\"增量出现非预期错误: {other:?}\"),\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // 随机恢复到某个历史检查点（如果有）。\n                if snapshots.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let idx = rng.below(snapshots.len() as u64) as usize;\n                let (id, snap) = &snapshots[idx];\n                let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore 历史检查点\");\n                assert_eq!(*report.chain.last().unwrap(), *id);\n                let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n                let lite_after = lite_all(&after);\n                assert_eq!(lite_after, *snap, \"seed={seed} step={step} 恢复到 {id} 后摘要与历史不符\");\n                // 恢复后参考模型也要回滚：从引擎工作集读回真实字节与版本重建。\n                model = model_from_engine(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 最终：对每个快照再做一次全量恢复校验，并重启进程验证持久化。\n    for (id, snap) in &snapshots {\n        let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore\");\n        assert_eq!(report.chain.last().unwrap(), id);\n        let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n        assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap);\n    }\n    if !snapshots.is_empty() {\n        let e2 = reopen_disk(&root);\n        let (id, snap) = snapshots.last().unwrap();\n        e2.restore(ds, id).unwrap();\n        let after = e2.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();\n        assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap);\n    }\n}\n\nmod common_hack {\n    /// 可比较的摘要三元组（不依赖 Serialize）。\n    #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Clone)]\n    pub struct PageDigestLite {\n        pub page: u32,\n        pub version: u64,\n        pub crc: String,\n    }\n    pub fn lite(d: cpengine::engine::PageDigest) -> PageDigestLite {\n        PageDigestLite {\n            page: d.page,\n            version: d.version,\n            crc: d.crc,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn lite_all(d: &[cpengine::engine::PageDigest]) -> Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite> {\n    d.iter().cloned().map(common_hack::lite).collect()\n}\n\n/// 从引擎当前工作集读回全部页，重建参考模型（随机恢复后使用）。\nfn model_from_engine(\n    e: &Engine,\n    ds: &str,\n    page_size: u32,\n    page_count: u32,\n) -> ReferenceModel {\n    let st = e.state(ds).unwrap();\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n    for p in 0..page_count {\n        let (bytes, info) = e.read_page(ds, p).unwrap();\n        model.data[p as usize] = bytes;\n        model.versions[p as usize] = st.page_versions[p as usize].max(info.version);\n    }\n    model\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_random_update_checkpoint_restore_seeds() {\n    for seed in 1..=12u64 {\n        run_property(seed, 8, 3, 60);\n    }\n    // 稍大的页与更长序列。\n    run_property(101, 64, 6, 120);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_merge_after_random_sequence_matches_model() {\n    // 独立确定性场景：随机更新 -> 形成单链 -> 全量合并 -> 逐页对照。\n    let (e, _root) = disk_engine(\"prop-merge\");\n    let ds = \"m\";\n    let (ps, pc) = (16u32, 5u32);\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, ps, pc);\n    let mut rng = Rng(0x1234_5678);\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(ps, pc);\n\n    let base = e.checkpoint_full(ds).unwrap();\n    let mut tip = base.id.clone();\n    for _ in 0..8 {\n        let page = rng.below(pc as u64) as u32;\n        let tag = rng.below(250) as u8;\n        let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(ps as usize, tag);\n        e.write_page(ds, page, &data).unwrap();\n        model.write_page(page, data);\n        match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, Some(&tip), &[page]) {\n            Ok(m) => tip = m.id,\n            Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {}\n            Err(o) => panic!(\"{o:?}\"),\n        }\n    }\n    let truth = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n    model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n\n    let report = e\n        .merge_checkpoints(ds, &base.id, &tip, false)\n        .unwrap();\n    e.restore(ds, &report.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth, &after));\n    assert_eq!(report.merged_page_count, pc as usize);\n\n    // compact 合并后 merged 依然逐页等于真值。\n    let report2 = e\n        .merge_checkpoints(ds, &base.id, &tip, true)\n        .unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!(\"compact 合并失败\"));\n    e.restore(ds, &report2.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after2 = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth, &after2));\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":101,"oldLines":8,"newStart":101,"newLines":8,"lines":["         let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore\");","         assert_eq!(report.chain.last().unwrap(), id);","         let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();","-        let lite_after: Vec<_> = after.iter().map(common_hack::lite).collect();","-        assert_eq!(&lite_after, snap);","+        let lite_after = lite_all(&after);","+        assert_eq!(lite_after, *snap);","     }","     if !snapshots.is_empty() {","         let e2 = reopen_disk(&root);"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"bfe9d31a-9c55-4791-914f-a0ff49b7b644","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

page: u32,\n        expected: u32,\n        actual: u32,\n    },\n    /// 页版本在应用检查点链时回退（依赖链不自洽）。\n    VersionRegression {\n        page: u32,\n        previous: u64,\n        incoming: u64,\n    },\n    /// 故障注入策略主动中止了某次操作。\n    InjectedFault(String),\n}\n\npub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, EngineError>;\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for EngineError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            EngineError::Io(s) => write!(f, \"I/O 错误: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::Serde(s) => write!(f, \"序列化错误: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::Conflict(s) => write!(f, \"状态冲突: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::NotFound(s) => write!(f, \"不存在: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::BadRequest(s) => write!(f, \"非法请求: {s}\"),\n EngineError::CycleDetected(id) => write!(f, \"检查点父链存在循环依赖，环上检查点: {id}\"),\n            EngineError::ChecksumMismatch { checkpoint, page, expected, actual } => write!(\n                f,\n for EngineError {}\n\nimpl From<io::Error> for EngineError {\n    fn from(e: io::Error) -> Self {\n        EngineError::Io(e.to_string())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl From<serde_json::Error> for EngineError {\n Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, EngineError>;\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for EngineError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n    /// 仅供测试/故障演练：在磁盘上手工制造一个父链环。\n    /// 做法：把 incremental 检查点的 meta.json parent 改成链上更早的节点。\n    pub fn test_rewire_parent(\n        &self,\n        dataset: &str,\n        id: &str,\n parent（用于制造循环依赖）。\n    ///\n    /// 会同步把 `parent_meta_crc` 重算为**新父 meta 的真实 CRC**，\n    /// 因此该操作只改变拓扑（用于纯粹演练 CycleDetected）；\n    /// 若要演练父元数据 CRC 失配，用 `test_corrupt_parent_meta_crc`。\n    pub fn test_rewire_parent(\n        &self,\n        dataset: &str,\n        id: &str,\n        new_parent: &str,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        let mut meta = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, id)?;\n        meta.parent = Some(new_parent.to_string());\n        let parent_bytes = self.repo.io().read(&self.repo.meta_path(dataset, new_parent))?;\n        meta.parent_meta_crc = Some(format!(\"{:08x}\", crc32(&parent_bytes)));\n        let path = self.repo.meta_path(dataset, id);\n        self.repo\n            .io()\n            .write_atomic(&path, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&meta)?)\n    }\n\n    /// 仅供测试：把子 meta 中记录的父 meta CRC 改错（演练父元数据失配）。\n    pub fn test_corrupt_parent_meta_crc(\n        &self,\n        dataset: &str,\n        id: &str,\n        wrong_hex: &str,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        let mut meta = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, id)?;\n        meta.parent_meta_crc = Some(wrong_hex.to_string());\n        let path = self.repo.meta_path(dataset, id);\n        self.repo\n            .io()\n            .write_atomic(&path, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&meta)?)\n    }"},"name":"Edit","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_8e41e43c1f29181c7db448dc","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1529,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":111416,"output_tokens":772,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"afe804ad-6a47-4b98-baf3-0d6b2b7b9b36","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:41:59.878Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

chain(\"merge-compact\");\n    let [f0, i1, i2, i3] = ids.clone();\n\n    // 武装到第 2 次 Remove（要删的源为 i1,i2,i3 共 3 次 remove，第 2 次中断）。\n    f.arm(cpengine::io::FaultPlan {\n        op: Op::Remove,\n        trigger_at: 2,\n        persistent: false,\n        note: \"压缩删除源检查点中途失败\".into(),\n    });\n    let report = e.merge_checkpoints(DS, &f0, &i3, true);\n    let err = report.unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::InjectedFault(_)), \"{err:?}\");\n    f.disarm();\n\n    // 合并在删除阶段才失败 => merged 已完整发布。\n    let list = e.repo().list_checkpoints(DS).unwrap();\n    let merged: Vec<String> = list.iter().filter(|id| id.contains(\"-mrg\")).cloned().collect();\n    assert_eq!(merged.len(), 1, \"应恰好有一个 merged: {list:?}\");\n    let merged_id = merged[0].clone();\n\n    e.restore(DS, &merged_id).unwrap();\n    let expected = {\n        let mut m = ReferenceModel::new(SIZE, PAGES);\n        m.patterned(0, 1);\n        m.patterned(1, 2);\n        m.patterned(0, 3);\n        m.patterned(2, 4);\n        m\n    };\n    expected.assert_matches(&e, DS);\n\n    // 重开进程后 merged 依然独立可恢复。\n    let e2 = reopen_faulty(&root, f.clone());\n    e2.restore(DS, &merged_id).unwrap();\n    expected.assert_matches(&e2, DS);\n\n    let _ = (i1, i2);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn parent_meta_crc_mismatch_is_detected() {\n    // 父 meta 被静默改写（CRC 失配）必须严格报错，而不是按旧拓扑恢复。\n    let (e, _f, _root, ids) = chain(\"parent-crc\");\n    let [_f0, i1, _i2, i3] = ids;\n    e.test_corrupt_parent_meta_crc(DS, &i3, \"deadbeef\").unwrap();\n    let err = e.resolve_chain(DS, &i3).unwrap_err();\n    match err {\n        EngineError::ParentMetaCrcMismatch { checkpoint, parent, .. } => {\n            assert_eq!(checkpoint, i3);\n            assert_eq!(parent, i1);\n        }\n        other => panic!(\"期望 ParentMetaCrcMismatch，实际 {other:?}\"),\n    }\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.restore(DS, &i3).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::ParentMetaCrcMismatch { .. }\n    ));\n}"},"name":"Edit","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_edf453270ed0f1a1ccdf74ab","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1511,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":113464,"output_tokens":1583,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"da59c07f-c237-431e-a6fe-4df3c90f64ae","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:43:32.037Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

self.0\n    }\n    fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> u64 {\n        self.next_u64() % n\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在给定 seed 下执行随机序列并验证。\nfn run_property(seed: u64, page_size: u32, page_count: u32, steps: u32) {\n    let (e, root) = disk_engine(&format!(\"prop-{seed}\"));\n    let ds = \"p\";\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n\n    let mut rng = Rng(seed.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) ^ 0xdead_beef);\n\n    // 记录每个检查点创建时刻，参考模型应当具有的页内容。\n    // 我们不保存全部历史内容，而是：恢复到检查点 id 时，用记录的“逐页 (version,crc)”\n    // 与恢复后摘要直接比较。\n    let mut snapshots: Vec<(String, Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite>)> = Vec::new();\n\n    // 参考模型实时镜像当前工作集。\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n\n    for step in 0..steps {\n        let action = rng.below(10);\n        match action {\n            0..=5 => {\n                // 写 1~2 个随机页。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(2);\n                for _ in 0..n {\n                    let page = rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32;\n                    let tag = rng.below(200) as u8;\n                    let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(page_size as usize, tag);\n                    e.write_page(ds, page, &data).expect(\"write\");\n                    model.write_page(page, data);\n                }\n                model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n            }\n            6 => {\n                // 全量。\n                let meta = e.checkpoint_full(ds).expect(\"full\");\n                let snap = lite_all(&model.digest());\n                snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n            }\n            7..=8 => {\n                // 增量：收集随机数量的脏页（只选当前版本>0的页，或允许新页）。\n                // 为保证合法，我们只提交“自上次检查点后确实写过”的页：\n                // 简化做法——尝试随机页集合，引擎若以 BadRequest 拒绝则跳过，\n                // {\n                        // 合法拒绝（页不够新/无父/空集去重后为空）。\n                    }\n                    Err(other) => panic!(\"增量出现非预期错误: {other:?}\"),\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // 随机恢复到某个历史检查点（如果有）。\n                if snapshots.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let idx = rng.below(snapshots.len() as u64) as usize;\n                let (id, snap) = &snapshots[idx];\n                let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore 历史检查点\");\n                assert_eq!(*report.chain.last().unwrap(), *id);\n             // 恢复后参考模型也要回滚：从引擎工作集读回真实字节与版本重建。\n                model = model_from_engine(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 最终：对每个快照再做一次全量恢复校验，并重启进程验证持久化。\n    for (id, snap) in &snapshots {\n        let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore\");\n        assert_eq!(report.chain.last().unwrap(), id);\n        let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after = lite_all(&after);\n        assert_eq!(lite_after, *snap);\n    }\n    if !snapshots.is_empty() {\n        let e2 = reopen_disk(&root);\n        let (id, snap) = snapshots.last().unwrap();\n        e2.restore(ds, id).unwrap();\n        let after = e2.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after = lite_all(&after);\n        assert_eq!(lite_after, *snap);\n    }\n}\n\nmod common_hack {\n    /// 可比较的摘要三元组（不依赖 Serialize）。\n    #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Clone)]\n    pub struct PageDigestLite {\n        pub page: u32,\n        pub version: u64,\n        pub crc: String,\n    }\n    pub fn lite(d: cpengine::engine::PageDigest) -> PageDigestLite {\n        PageDigestLite {\n            page: d.page,\n            version: d.version,\n            crc: d.crc,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn lite_all(d: &[cpengine::engine::PageDigest]) -> Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite> {\n    d.iter().cloned().map(common_hack::lite).collect()\n}\n\n/// model.versions[p as usize] = st.page_versions[p as usize].max(info.version);\n    }\n    model\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_random_update_checkpoint_restore_seeds() {\n    for seed in 1..=12u64 {\n 可注入的 I/O 抽象层。\n//!\n//! 引擎不直接调用 [`std::fs`]，而是依赖 [`IoBackend`] trait。\n//! 生产环境使用 [`DiskIo`]（真实文件系统 + 显式 fsync）；\n//! 测试与 HTTP 故障演练使用 [`FaultyIo`] 包装真实磁盘 I/O，\n//! 按“操作类型 + 命中次数”注入 [`EngineError::InjectedFault`]，\n//! 用以模拟检查点发布 / 合并中途崩溃（参见 `storage` 中暂存目录的使用）。\n//!\n//! # 同步边界（durability contract）\n//!\n//! - [`IoBackend::write_atomic`]：写临时文件 -> `fsync(file)` -> `rename` 到目标路径\n//!   -> `fsync(父目录)`。rename 在同一文件系统上是原子的，因此调用方要么看到旧文件、\n//!   要么看到新文件，绝不会看到半截内容。\n//! - 目录发布（暂存目录 rename 为正式检查点目录）同样在 rename 后 fsync 父目录。\n//! - 仅保证单进程内的崩溃一致性；不涉及多进程并发（README 已明确该边界）。\n\nuse crate::error::{EngineError, Result};\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\n/// 可被注入故障的 I/O 操作类别。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]\npub enum Op {\n    /// 写并 fsync 普通文件（state.json、repo.json、meta.json）。\n    WriteAtomic,\n    /// rename 发布动作（暂存目录 -> 正式检查点目录、临时页 -> 正式页）。\n    RenamePublish,\n    /// 目录 fsync。\n    DirSync,\n    /// 创建目录。\n    Mkdir,\n    /// 删除文件/目录。\n    Remove,\n}\n\nimpl Op {\n    /// 故障计划 JSON 中使用的短名。\n    pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            Op::WriteAtomic => \"write_atomic\",\n            Op::RenamePublish => \"rename_publish\",\n            Op::DirSync => \"dir_sync\",\n            Op::Mkdir => \"mkdir\",\n            Op::Remove => \"remove\",\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Option<Op> {\n        Some(match s {\n            \"write_atomic\" => Op::WriteAtomic,\n            \"rename_publish\" => Op::RenamePublish,\n            \"dir_sync\" => Op::DirSync,\n            \"mkdir\" => Op::Mkdir,\n            \"remove\" => Op::Remove,\n            _ => return None,\n        })\n    }\n}\n\n/// 引擎所依赖的全部文件系统操作。\npub trait IoBackend: Send + Sync {\n    /// 递归创建目录（已存在视为成功）。\n    fn mkdir_p(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()>;\n    /// 判断路径是否存在。\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool;\n    /// 读取整个文件。\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<u8>>;\n    /// 读取目录下的条目名（非递归）。\n    fn list_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>>;\n    /// 删除文件或递归删除目录。\n    fn remove(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()>;\n    /// rename（要求同一文件系统）。\n    fn rename(&self, src: &Path, dst: &Path) -> Result<()>;\n    /** 原子发布一个文件：同目录临时文件 + fsync + rename + fsync(父目录)。 */\n    fn write_atomic(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> Result<()>;\n    /** 原子发布一个目录：将 `staging` rename 为 `target`，并 fsync 父目录。 */\n    fn publish_dir(&self, staging: &Path, target: &Path) -> Result<()>;\n}\n\n/// 真实磁盘 I/O。所有持久化写入都走 fsync。\n#[derive(Default)]\npub struct DiskIo;\n\nimpl DiskIo {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        DiskIo\n    }\n\n    /// fsync 目录（Unix 上保证 rename/create 落盘）。\n    fn sync_parent(dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        #[cfg(unix)]\n        {\n            use std::os::unix::io::AsRawFd;\n            let f = std::fs::File::open(dir)?;\n            // 平台返回码已检查；sync 失败必须上抛，不能假装持久化成功。\n            nix_fsync(f.as_raw_fd())?;\n        }\n        #[cfg(not(unix))]\n        {\n            let _ = dir;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nmod sys {\n    extern \"C\" {\n        pub fn fsync(fd: std::os::unix::io::RawFd) -> std::os::raw::c_int;\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nfn nix_fsync(fd: std::os::unix::io::RawFd) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    // 直接 extern \"C\"，避免引入 libc 依赖。\n    let rc = unsafe { sys::fsync(fd) };\n    if rc == 0 {\n        Ok(())\n    } else {\n        Err(std::io::Error::last_os_error())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl IoBackend for DiskIo {\n    fn mkdir_p(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(path)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        path.exists()\n    }\n\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        Ok(std::fs::read(path)?)\n    }\n\n    fn list_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut names = Vec::new();\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(names);\n        }\n        for e in std::fs::read_dir(path)? {\n            names.push(e?.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned());\n        }\n        Ok(names)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        if path.is_dir() {\n            std::fs::remove_dir_all(path)?;\n        } else {\n            std::fs::remove_file(path)?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, src: &Path, dst: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        std::fs::rename(src, dst)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn write_atomic(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        let parent = path.parent().unwrap_or_else(|| Path::new(\".\"));\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n        let tag = file_tag(path);\n        let tmp = parent.join(format!(\".tmp.{tag}.{}\", std::process::id()));\n        {\n            use std::io::Write;\n            let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n                .write(true)\n                .create(true)\n                .truncate(true)\n                .open(&tmp)?;\n            f.write_all(data)?;\n            f.sync_all()?;\n        }\n        std::fs::rename(&tmp, path)?;\n        Self::sync_parent(parent)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn publish_dir(&self, staging: &Path, target: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        if let Some(parent) = target.parent() {\n            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n        }\n        std::fs::rename(staging, target)?;\n        if let Some(parent) = target.parent() {\n            Self::sync_parent(parent)?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nfn file_tag(path: &Path) -> String {\n    // 仅用于临时文件命名，不需要稳定/安全。\n    let s = path.to_string_lossy();\n    let mut h: u64 = 1469598103934665603;\n    for b in s.bytes() {\n        h ^= b as u64;\n        h = h.wrapping_mul(1099511628211);\n    }\n    format!(\"{h:016x}\")\n}\n\n/// 故障计划：对某类操作的第 `trigger_at` 次调用注入错误。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct FaultPlan {\n    pub op: Op,\n    /// 1 起算：第几次命中该类操作时触发（1 = 下一次就触发）。\n    pub trigger_at: u64,\n    /// 触发后是否继续生效（false = one-shot，触发后自动解除）。\n    pub persistent: bool,\n    /// 注入错误时附带的说明。\n    pub note: String,\n}\n\n/// 包装真实磁盘的故障注入 I/O。\npub struct FaultyIo {\n    inner: DiskIo,\n    plan: Some(plan);\n        self.counts.lock().unwrap().clear();\n    }\n\n    /// 解除故障计划。\n    pub fn disarm(&self) {\n        *self.plan.lock().unwrap() = None;\n FaultPlanSnapshot {\n            op: p.op.as_str(),\n            trigger_at: p.trigger_at,\n            persistent: p.persistent,\n            note: p.note.clone(),\n            hits: *self.counts.lock().unwrap().get(&p.op).unwrap_or(&0),\n        })\n    }\n\n    fn gate(&self, op: Op) -> Result<()> {\n        let mut plan_guard = self.plan.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut counts = self.counts.lock().unwrap();\n        let hit = {\n            let c = counts.entry(op).or_insert(0);\n            *c += 1;\n            *c\n        };\n        if let Some(plan) = plan_guard.as_ref() {\n            if plan.op == op && hit == plan.trigger_at {\n                let err = EngineError::InjectedFault(format!(\n                    \"{}（第 {hit} 次 {} 操作）{}\",\n                    plan.note,\n                    op.as_str(),\n                    if plan.persistent { \" [持续故障]\" } else { \"\" }\n                ));\n                if !plan.persistent {\n                    *plan_guard = None;\n                }\n                return Err(err);\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 故障计划的只读快照（用于 HTTP 响应）。\n#[derive(Debug, serde::Serialize)]\npub struct FaultPlanSnapshot {\n    pub op: &'static str,\n    pub trigger_at: u64,\n    pub persistent: bool,\n    pub note: String,\n    pub hits: u64,\n}\n\nimpl IoBackend for FaultyIo {\n    fn mkdir_p(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        self.gate(Op::Mkdir)?;\n        self.inner.mkdir_p(path)\n    }\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n /// 创建全量检查点：从工作集逐页读取全部页并固化。\n181\t    pub fn checkpoint_full(&self, dataset: &str) -> Result<CheckpointMeta> {\n182\t        let mut state = self.repo.load_state(dataset)?;\n183\t        let id = Err(EngineError::CycleDetected(cur_id));\n329\t            }\n330\t            let meta = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, &cur_id)?;\n331\t            match meta.kind.as_str() {\n332\t 检查点引擎：固定页数据集上的全量/增量检查点、严格父链恢复与合并。\n//!\n//! ## 核心概念\n//!\n//! - **固定页数据集**：创建时锁定 `page_size`（字节）与 `page_count`，之后所有\n//!   页写入必须恰好 `page_size` 字节，页 id 落在 `0..page_count`。\n//!\n//! - **页版本（page version）**：每页维护从 1 起的单调版本号，工作集每写一次\n//!   该页版本 +1。检查点为包含的每一页记录写入时的版本与内容 CRC。\n//!\n//! - **全量检查点（full）**：包含全部页，`parent = null`。一个数据集可以有多条\n//!   全量链根；从某个全量检查点恢复即得到该检查点的完整内容。\n//!\n//! - **增量检查点（incremental）**：只包含自父检查点以来版本变高的页（实际实现为\n//!   “调用 checkpoint 时显式收集的脏页集合”，但要求每页版本严格高于父链上的\n//!   已知版本，否则拒绝发布），`parent` 指向上一个检查点（full 或 incremental）。\n//!\n//! - **严格父链恢复**：恢复 incremental 必须递归/迭代走到链根（full/merged），\n//!   按从根到尖的顺序应用；父 meta 文件缺失 -> [`EngineError::MissingParent`]；\n//!   链上出现重复 id -> [`EngineError::CycleDetected`]；CRC 不符 ->\n//!   [`EngineError::ChecksumMismatch`]；页版本在链上回退 ->\n//!   [`EngineError::VersionRegression`]。没有“猜测最近 full”的捷径。\n//!\n//! ## 合并\n//!\n//! `merge_checkpoints(base, tip)`：取 `base`（须为 full/merged）与它的某条严格\n//! 后代链 `tip`，把 `base..=tip` 的累积效果压缩成一个新的 full（`kind = merged`，\n//! 无父，记录 `merged_sources`）。合并的全部磁盘写入先入暂存目录再原子 rename\n//! 发布；故障注入若让发布中断，磁盘上不会出现“半成品 merged 检查点”。\n\nuse crate::checksum::crc32;\nuse crate::error::{EngineError, Result};\nuse crate::storage::{\n    CheckpointMeta, DatasetState, KIND_FULL, KIND_INCREMENTAL, KIND_MERGED, MergeConflict,\n    PageToWrite, Repository,\n};\nuse std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\n\n/// 引擎：绑定一个存储库，提供数据集/页/检查点操作。\npub struct Engine {\n    repo: Repository,\n}\n\n/// 恢复结果描述。\n#[derive(Debug, serde::Serialize)]\npub struct RestoreReport {\n    pub target: String,\n    /// 沿依赖链实际应用的检查点 id（从根到尖）。\n    pub chain: Vec<String>,\n    /// 每个被应用的检查点各写入了哪些页。\n    pub applied_pages: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u32>>,\n    /// 恢复完成后工作集页摘要。\n    pub digest: Vec<PageDigest>,\n}\n\n/// 单页摘要。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize)]\npub struct PageDigest {\n    pub page: u32,\n    pub version: u64,\n    pub size: u32,\n    /// 工作集当前内容的 CRC32 hex。\n    pub crc: String,\n}\n\n/// 合并结果。\n#[derive(Debug, serde::Serialize)]\npub struct MergeReport {\n    pub base: String,\n    pub tip: String,\n    pub merged_id: String,\n    /// 被压缩掉的检查点（base 之后、tip 及之前的链上节点；base 本身保留）。\n    pub sources: BTreeSet<String>,\n    /// 链上各检查点包含的页数。\n    pub page_counts: BTreeMap<String, usize>,\n    /// 合并检查点自身的页数（应当 = page_count，因为 base 是 full）。\n    pub merged_page_count: usize,\n    pub digest_before_gc: Vec<PageDigest>,\n}\n\nimpl Engine {\n    pub fn open(root: impl Into<PathBuf>, io: crate::io::SharedIo) -> Result<Self> {\n        Ok(Engine {\n            repo: Repository::open(root, io)?,\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn init(root: impl Into<PathBuf>, io: crate::io::SharedIo) -> Result<Self> {\n        Ok(Engine {\n            repo: Repository::init(root, io)?,\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn repo(&self) -> &Repository {\n        &self.repo\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 数据集 ----------\n\n    pub fn create_dataset(&self, name: &str, page_size: u32, page_count: u32) -> Result<DatasetState> {\n        self.repo.create_dataset(name, page_size, page_count)\n    }\n\n    pub fn state(&self, dataset: &str) -> Result<DatasetState> {\n        self.repo.load_state(dataset)\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 页写入 ----------\n\n    /// 向工作集写一页（内容必须恰好为 page_size 字节）。\n    /// 页版本 +1，内容 CRC 更新；工作页文件原子覆盖（fsync）。\n    pub fn write_page(&self, dataset: &str, page: u32, data: &[u8]) -> Result<PageDigest> {\n        let mut state = self.repo.load_state(dataset)?;\n        if page >= state.page_count {\n            return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                \"页 id {page} 越界（共 {} 页）\",\n                state.page_count\n            )));\n        }\n        if data.len() != state.page_size as usize {\n            return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                \"页内容长度 {} != 固定页大小 {}\",\n                data.len(),\n                state.page_size\n            )));\n        }\n        self.repo.write_working_page(dataset, page, data)?;\n        state.page_versions[page as usize] += 1;\n        state.current_crc[page as usize] = format!(\"{:08x}\", crc32(data));\n        self.repo.write_state(&state)?;\n        Ok(PageDigest {\n            page,\n            version: state.page_versions[page as usize],\n            size: state.page_size,\n            crc: state.current_crc[page as usize].clone(),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 读一页工作集内容（未写过则为全零）。\n    pub fn read_page(&self, dataset: &str, page: u32) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, PageDigest)> {\n        let state = self.repo.load_state(dataset)?;\n        if page >= state.page_count {\n            return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                \"页 id {page} 越界（共 {} 页）\",\n                state.page_count\n            )));\n        }\n        let data = self.repo.read_working_page(&state, page)?;\n        Ok((\n            data,\n            PageDigest {\n                page,\n                version: state.page_versions[page as usize],\n                size: state.page_size,\n                crc: state.current_crc[page as usize].clone(),\n            },\n        ))\n    }\n\n    /// 当前工作集逐页摘要。\n    pub fn digest(&self, dataset: &str) -> Result<Vec<PageDigest>> {\n        let state = self.repo.load_state(dataset)?;\n        Ok((0..state.page_count)\n            .map(|p| PageDigest {\n                page: p,\n                version: state.page_versions[p as usize],\n                size: state.page_size,\n                crc: state.current_crc[p as usize].clone(),\n            })\n            .collect())\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 检查点 ----------\n\n    fn allocate_id(&self, state: &DatasetState, tag: &str) -> String {\n        format!(\"{}-{}{:06}\", state.dataset, tag, state.next_seq)\n    }\n\n    /// 创建全量检查点：从工作集逐页读取全部页并固化。\n    pub fn checkpoint_full(&self, dataset: &str) -> Result<CheckpointMeta> {\n        let mut state = self.repo.load_state(dataset)?;\n        let id = self.allocate_id(&state, \"cp\");\n        let mut pages: Vec<(u32, Vec<u8>)> = Vec::with_capacity(state.page_count as usize);\n        for p in 0..state.page_count {\n            pages.push((p, self.repo.read_working_page(&state, p)?));\n        }\n        let to_write: Vec<PageToWrite<'_>> = pages\n            .iter()\n            .map(|(id, data)| PageToWrite {\n                id: *id,\n                version: state.page_versions[*id as usize],\n                data,\n            })\n            .collect();\n        let meta = self.repo.publish_checkpoint(\n            &mut state,\n            &id,\n            KIND_FULL,\n            None,\n            &to_write,\n            vec![],\n            vec![],\n        )?;\n        state.tip = Some(meta.id.clone());\n        self.repo.write_state(&state)?;\n        Ok(meta)\n    }\n\n    /// 创建增量检查点，默认挂在 state.tip 上。\n    /// `pages` 为要固化的页 id 列表；这些页的当前版本必须严格高于\n    /// 父链上对应页的已知版本。\n    pub fn checkpoint_incremental(\n        &self,\n        dataset: &str,\n        parent: Option<&str>,\n        pages: &[u32],\n    ) -> Result<CheckpointMeta> {\n        let mut state = self.repo.load_state(dataset)?;\n        let parent_id = match parent {\n            Some(p) => p.to_string(),\n            None => state\n                .tip\n                .clone()\n                .ok_or_else(|| {\n                    EngineError::BadRequest(\"数据集尚无检查点，增量必须显式指定 parent 或先建全量\".into())\n                })?,\n        };\n\n        // 去重 + 越界检查。\n        let mut wanted: BTreeSet<u32> = BTreeSet::new();\n        for p in pages {\n            if *p >= state.page_count {\n                return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                    \"页 id {p} 越界（共 {} 页）\",\n                    state.page_count\n                )));\n            }\n            wanted.insert(*p);\n        }\n        if wanted.is_empty() {\n            return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(\n                \"增量检查点至少包含一页\".into(),\n            ));\n        }\n\n        // 取父检查点，沿父链计算每页已知最大版本。\n        // 严格性：父链必须完整无环，否则 resolve_chain 直接报错。\n        let chain = self.resolve_chain(dataset, &parent_id)?; // root..=parent\n        let mut known_versions: BTreeMap<u32, u64> = BTreeMap::new();\n        for cid in &chain {\n            let m = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, cid)?;\n            for (pid, e) in &m.pages {\n                known_versions\n                    .entry(*pid)\n                    .and_modify(|v| *v = (*v).max(e.version))\n                    .or_insert(e.version);\n            }\n        }\n\n        let mut payload: Vec<(u32, Vec<u8>)> = Vec::new();\n        for pid in &wanted {\n            let cur_ver = state.page_versions[*pid as usize];\n            if let Some(&kv) = known_versions.get(pid) {\n                if cur_ver <= kv {\n                    return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                        \"页 {pid} 版本 {cur_ver} 未高于父链已知版本 {kv}，增量中不允许旧页/重复页\"\n                    )));\n                }\n            }\n            // 链上从无此页记录（理论上 full 根覆盖全部页，不会发生；防御性保留）。\n            let data = self.repo.read_working_page(&state, *pid)?;\n            payload.push((*pid, data));\n        }\n\n        let id = self.allocate_id(&state, \"cp\");\n        let to_write: Vec<PageToWrite<'_>> = payload\n            .iter()\n            .map(|(pid, data)| PageToWrite {\n                id: *pid,\n                version: state.page_versions[*pid as usize],\n                data,\n            })\n            .collect();\n        let meta = self.repo.publish_checkpoint(\n            &mut state,\n            &id,\n            KIND_INCREMENTAL,\n            Some(&parent_id),\n            &to_write,\n            vec![],\n            vec![],\n        )?;\n        state.tip = Some(meta.id.clone());\n        self.repo.write_state(&state)?;\n        Ok(meta)\n    }\n\n    /// 列出检查点（含 meta 概要）。\n    pub fn list_checkpoints(&self, dataset: &str) -> Result<Vec<CheckpointMeta>> {\n        let ids = self.repo.list_checkpoints(dataset)?;\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        for id in ids {\n            out.push(self.repo.read_meta(dataset, &id)?);\n        }\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 严格父链 ----------\n\n    /** 解析检查点 `tip` 的依赖链：返回从链根（full/merged）到 tip 的 id 序列。\n\n    严格规则：\n    - full/merged：parent 必须为 null，链为自身；\n    - incremental：parent 必须存在且类型合法，沿 parent 向上直到 full/merged；\n    - 父 meta 文件缺失 -> MissingParent；\n    - 路径上重复出现某 id -> CycleDetected（循环依赖）；\n    - incremental 的父若是 incremental/full/merged 之外的类型 -> BadRequest。\n    */\n    pub fn resolve_chain(&self, dataset: &str, tip: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        // 先确认 tip 存在（给出清晰的 NotFound）。\n        let first = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, tip)?;\n        let mut up = Vec::new();\n        let mut cur_id = first.id.clone();\n        let mut seen: BTreeSet<String> = BTreeSet::new();\n        loop {\n            if !seen.insert(cur_id.clone()) {\n                return Err(EngineError::CycleDetected(cur_id));\n            }\n            let meta = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, &cur_id)?;\n            match meta.kind.as_str() {\n                KIND_FULL | KIND_MERGED => {\n                    if meta.parent.is_some() {\n                        return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                            \"检查点 {} 声明为 {} 却带有 parent\",\n                            meta.id, meta.kind\n                        )));\n                    }\n                    up.push(meta.id.clone());\n                    break;\n                }\n                KIND_INCREMENTAL => {\n                    let parent = meta.parent.clone().ok_or_else(|| {\n                        EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                            \"增量检查点 {} 缺少 parent\",\n                            meta.id\n                        ))\n                    })?;\n                    // 结构性检查优先：父已在当前路径上出现 -> 环闭合。\n                    // （自环也在此被抓住，不必先读取/比对父 CRC。）\n                    if seen.contains(&parent) {\n                        return Err(EngineError::CycleDetected(parent));\n                    }\n                    // 检查父文件确实存在，错误里带上当前检查点。\n                    if !self.repo.io().exists(&self.repo.meta_path(dataset, &parent)) {\n                        return Err(EngineError::MissingParent {\n                            checkpoint: cur_id,\n                            missing: parent,\n                        });\n                    }\n                    // 严格校验子记录的父 meta CRC（父元数据被静默改写则失败）。\n                    self.repo.verify_parent_meta_crc(dataset, &meta)?;\n                    up.push(meta.id.clone());\n                    cur_id = parent;\n                }\n                k => {\n                    return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                        \"检查点 {cur_id} 的类型 {k} 不受支持\"\n                    )));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        up.reverse();\n        Ok(up)\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 恢复 ----------\n\n    /** 严格沿依赖链恢复 `tip` 到工作集。\n\n    步骤：\n    1. resolve_chain 得到 root..=tip（任何缺失/环/坏类型立即失败）；\n    2. 从全零页开始，按链顺序应用每个检查点中**通过 CRC 校验**的页；\n    3. 应用时检查页版本单调不降且同版本内容一致（VersionRegression）；\n    4. 全部应用完成后，一次性把结果安装到 `working/` 并把 state 的\n       版本/CRC 指针对齐到 tip——安装前先在内存中构造好完整结果，\n       因此中途故障不会留下“半个恢复”。\n    */\n    pub fn restore(&self, dataset: &str, tip: &str) -> Result<RestoreReport> {\n        let chain = self.resolve_chain(dataset, tip)?;\n        let state0 = self.repo.load_state(dataset)?;\n        let page_count = state0.page_count as usize;\n        let page_size = state0.page_size as usize;\n\n        // 从全零开始：严格按链重建，不依赖当前 working/。\n        let mut content: Vec<Vec<u8>> = (0..page_count)\n            .map(|_| vec![0u8; page_size])\n            .collect();\n        let mut versions = vec![0u64; page_count];\n        let mut present = vec![false; page_count];\n        let mut applied_pages: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u32>> = BTreeMap::new();\n\n        for cid in &chain {\n            let loaded = self.repo.load_checkpoint(dataset, cid)?;\n            let mut touched = Vec::new();\n            for (pid, entry) in &loaded.meta.pages {\n                let data = loaded.pages.get(pid).ok_or_else(|| {\n                    EngineError::NotFound(format!(\"检查点 {cid} 页 {pid} 载入缺失\"))\n                })?;\n                let idx = *pid as usize;\n                if present[idx] {\n                    if entry.version < versions[idx] {\n                        return Err(EngineError::VersionRegression {\n                            page: *pid,\n                            previous: versions[idx],\n                            incoming: entry.version,\n                        });\n                    }\n                    if entry.version == versions[idx] && data != &content[idx] {\n                        return Err(EngineError::VersionRegression {\n                            page: *pid,\n                            previous: versions[idx],\n                            incoming: entry.version,\n                        });\n                    }\n                }\n                content[idx] = data.clone();\n                versions[idx] = entry.version;\n                present[idx] = true;\n                touched.push(*pid);\n            }\n            touched.sort_unstable();\n            applied_pages.insert(cid.clone(), touched);\n        }\n\n        // 根覆盖完整性检查。\n        let root_meta = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, &chain[0])?;\n        if root_meta.pages.len() != page_count {\n            return Err(EngineError::Conflict(format!(\n                \"链根 {} 只含 {}/{} 页，不是完整快照\",\n                chain[0],\n                root_meta.pages.len(),\n                page_count\n            )));\n        }\n        if !present.iter().all(|x| *x) {\n            return Err(EngineError::Conflict(format!(\n                \"依赖链未覆盖全部 {page_count} 页，无法严格恢复\"\n            )));\n        }\n\n        // 一次性安装：先写全部工作页（各自原子），最后原子切换 state 指针。\n        for (pid, bytes) in content.iter().enumerate() {\n            self.repo\n                .install_working_page(dataset, pid as u32, bytes)?;\n        }\n        let mut state = state0;\n        for pid in 0..page_count {\n            state.page_versions[pid] = versions[pid];\n            state.current_crc[pid] = format!(\"{:08x}\", crc32(&content[pid]));\n        }\n        state.tip = Some(tip.to_string());\n        self.repo.write_state(&state)?;\n\n        let digest = self.digest(dataset)?;\n        Ok(RestoreReport {\n            target: tip.to_string(),\n            chain,\n            applied_pages,\n            digest,\n        })\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 合并 ----------\n\n    /** 把 `base..=tip` 合并成新的无父 merged 检查点。\n\n    前置：\n    - base 必须是 full/merged；\n    - tip 必须是 base 的严格后代（base 出现在 tip 的依赖链中）；\n    - 链完整、无环、全部 CRC 通过（resolve_chain + load 时保证）。\n\n    合并语义：以 base 为完整初始快照，沿链逐页应用到 tip，得到最终页集合；\n    merged 检查点记录全部页（与 full 同构）。**默认不删除源检查点**\n    （`compact = false`）；`compact = true` 时在 merged 发布成功后删除\n    “base 之后（不含 base）到 tip（含）”的中间节点。删除阶段发生故障时，\n    merged 已落盘并可独立恢复，剩余源只是冗余，不影响最终页内容。\n\n    merged 的页版本取链上应用后的版本，merged_sources 记录被压缩的节点。\n    */\n    pub fn merge_checkpoints(\n        &self,\n        dataset: &str,\n        base: &str,\n        tip: &str,\n        compact: bool,\n    ) -> Result<MergeReport> {\n        let base_meta = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, base)?;\n        if !matches!(base_meta.kind.as_str(), KIND_FULL | KIND_MERGED) {\n            return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                \"合并基点 {base} 必须是 full/merged，实际为 {}\",\n                base_meta.kind\n            )));\n        }\n        let chain = self.resolve_chain(dataset, tip)?;\n        let base_pos = chain\n            .iter()\n            .position(|c| c == base)\n            .ok_or_else(|| EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                \"{tip} 的依赖链不包含基点 {base}，无法合并\"\n            )))?;\n        let sub = &chain[base_pos..]; // base..=tip\n\n        // 复用恢复逻辑构造最终页内容（严格 CRC + 版本检查），\n        // 但起点是 base 快照而不是全数据集链根。\n        let state0 = self.repo.load_state(dataset)?;\n        let page_count = state0.page_count as usize;\n        let page_size = state0.page_size as usize;\n        let mut content: Vec<Vec<u8>> = vec![vec![0u8; page_size]; page_count];\n        let mut versions = vec![0u64; page_count];\n        let mut present = vec![false; page_count];\n        let mut page_counts: BTreeMap<String, usize> = BTreeMap::new();\n\n        for (i, cid) in sub.iter().enumerate() {\n            let loaded = self.repo.load_checkpoint(dataset, cid)?;\n            page_counts.insert(cid.clone(), loaded.meta.pages.len());\n            let is_root = i == 0;\n            for (pid, entry) in &loaded.meta.pages {\n                let data = loaded.pages.get(pid).ok_or_else(|| {\n                    EngineError::NotFound(format!(\"检查点 {cid} 页 {pid} 载入缺失\"))\n                })?;\n                let idx = *pid as usize;\n                if present[idx] {\n                    if entry.version < versions[idx]\n                        || (entry.version == versions[idx] && data != &content[idx])\n                    {\n                        return Err(EngineError::VersionRegression {\n                            page: *pid,\n                            previous: versions[idx],\n                            incoming: entry.version,\n                        });\n                    }\n                }\n                content[idx] = data.clone();\n                versions[idx] = entry.version;\n                present[idx] = true;\n            }\n            if is_root && loaded.meta.pages.len() != page_count {\n                return Err(EngineError::Conflict(format!(\n                    \"合并基点 {cid} 只含 {}/{} 页，不是完整快照\",\n                    loaded.meta.pages.len(),\n                    page_count\n                )));\n            }\n        }\n        if !present.iter().all(|x| *x) {\n            return Err(EngineError::Conflict(\n                \"合并链未覆盖全部页\".into(),\n            ));\n        }\n\n        // 冲突记录：严格父子链上同版本不同内容已在上面拒绝；\n        // conflicts 字段保留给将来多分支合并，线性合并恒为空。\n        let conflicts: Vec<MergeConflict> = Vec::new();\n\n        let sources: BTreeSet<String> = sub[1..].iter().cloned().collect();\n        let digest_before_gc = self.digest(dataset)?;\n\n        let mut state = self.repo.load_state(dataset)?;\n        // compact 安全前置：tip 必须是当前尖端（其后无增量后代），否则删除\n        // 源节点会打断现存检查点的父链。\n        if compact && state.tip.as_deref() != Some(tip) {\n            return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                \"compact 要求 tip 为当前尖端检查点（tip={tip}, 当前={:?}）；请改用 compact=false\",\n                state.tip\n            )));\n        }\n        let merged_id = self.allocate_id(&state, \"mrg\");\n        let to_write: Vec<PageToWrite<'_>> = content\n            .iter()\n            .enumerate()\n            .map(|(pid, data)| PageToWrite {\n                id: pid as u32,\n                version: versions[pid],\n                data,\n            })\n            .collect();\n        let meta = self.repo.publish_checkpoint(\n            &mut state,\n            &merged_id,\n            KIND_MERGED,\n            None,\n            &to_write,\n            sources.iter().cloned().collect(),\n            conflicts,\n        )?;\n        state.tip = Some(meta.id.clone());\n        self.repo.write_state(&state)?;\n\n        // 发布成功之后才允许压缩删除；此处故障只留下冗余源，merged 仍完整。\n        if compact {\n            for cid in &sources {\n                self.repo.remove_checkpoint(dataset, cid)?;\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(MergeReport {\n            base: base.to_string(),\n            tip: tip.to_string(),\n            merged_id: meta.id.clone(),\n            sources,\n            page_counts,\n            merged_page_count: meta.pages.len(),\n            digest_before_gc,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 仅供测试/故障演练：在磁盘上手工改写检查点的 parent（用于制造循环依赖）。\n    ///\n    /// 会同步把 `parent_meta_crc` 重算为**新父 meta 的真实 CRC**，\n    /// 因此该操作只改变拓扑（用于纯粹演练 CycleDetected）；\n    /// 若要演练父元数据 CRC 失配，用 `test_corrupt_parent_meta_crc`。\n    pub fn test_rewire_parent(\n        &self,\n        dataset: &str,\n        id: &str,\n        new_parent: &str,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        let mut meta = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, id)?;\n        meta.parent = Some(new_parent.to_string());\n        let parent_bytes = self.repo.io().read(&self.repo.meta_path(dataset, new_parent))?;\n        meta.parent_meta_crc = Some(format!(\"{:08x}\", crc32(&parent_bytes)));\n        let path = self.repo.meta_path(dataset, id);\n        self.repo\n            .io()\n            .write_atomic(&path, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&meta)?)\n    }\n\n    /// 仅供测试：把子 meta 中记录的父 meta CRC 改错（演练父元数据失配）。\n    pub fn test_corrupt_parent_meta_crc(\n        &self,\n        dataset: &str,\n        id: &str,\n        wrong_hex: &str,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        let mut meta = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, id)?;\n        meta.parent_meta_crc = Some(wrong_hex.to_string());\n        let path = self.repo.meta_path(dataset, id);\n        self.repo\n            .io()\n            .write_atomic(&path, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&meta)?)\n    }\n\n    /// 仅供测试：把某页数据改成错误版本语义（保留 CRC 字段，数据被换）。\n    pub fn test_corrupt_page(&self, dataset: &str, id: &str, page: u32, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        self.repo.corrupt_page_file(dataset, id, page, bytes)\n    }\n\n    /// 仅供测试：删除检查点目录，制造父链缺失。\n    pub fn test_delete_checkpoint(&self, dataset: &str, id: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        self.repo.delete_checkpoint_dir(dataset, id)\n    }\n}\n\n/// 摘要比对辅助：两段页摘要是否逐项一致（测试与 HTTP 对照用）。\npub fn digest_equal(a: &[PageDigest], b: &[PageDigest]) -> bool {\n    a.len() == b.len()\n        && a.iter().zip(b).all(|(x, y)| {\n            x.page == y.page && x.version == y.version && x.size == y.size && x.crc == y.crc\n        })\n}\n\n/// 摘要的稳定文本形式（每行 `page version crc`），用于逐次更新对照。\npub fn digest_text(d: &[PageDigest]) -> String {\n    d.iter()\n        .map(|p| format!(\"{}\\t{}\\t{}\", p.page, p.version, p.crc))\n        .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n        .join(\"\\n\")\n}\n\n/// 内部辅助：构造页内容（测试和 HTTP demo 用）。\npub fn filled_page(size: usize, byte: u8) -> Vec<u8> {\n    vec![byte; size]\n}\n\n/// 生成可辨识的页内容：首字节为标记，其余为标记+偏移，便于合并冲突排查。\npub fn (16u32, 5u32);\n\n    // 构造一条 full->inc... 链，返回 (base, tip, 真值摘要)。\n    let build = |label: &str, ds: &str| {\n        let (e, root) = disk_engine(label);\n        make_dataset(&e, ds, ps, pc);\n        let mut rng = Rng(0x1234_5678);\n        let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(ps, pc);\n        let base = e.checkpoint_full(ds).unwrap();\n        let mut tip = base.id.clone();\n        for _ in e.write_page(ds, page, &data).unwrap();\n            model.write_page(page, data);\n            match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, Some(&tip), &[page]) {\n                Ok(m) => tip = m.id,\n &tip));\n}","newString":"#[test]\nfn property_merge_after_random_sequence_matches_model() {\n    // 独立确定性场景：随机更新 -> 形成单链 -> 合并 -> 逐页对照。\n    // 非压缩合并与压缩合并分别在两条同构链上验证（压缩会删除源、不可逆）。\n    let (ps, pc) = (16u32, 5u32);\n\n    // 构造一条 full->inc... 链，返回 (base, tip, 真值摘要)。\n    let build = |label: &str, ds: &str| {\n        let (e, root) = disk_engine(label);\n        make_dataset(&e, ds, ps, pc);\n        let mut rng = Rng(0x1234_5678);\n        let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(ps, pc);\n        let base = e.checkpoint_full(ds).unwrap();\n        let mut tip = base.id.clone();\n        for _ in 0..8 {\n            let page = rng.below(pc as u64) as u32;\n            let tag = rng.below(250) as u8;\n            let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(ps as usize, tag);\n            e.write_page(ds, page, &data).unwrap();\n            model.write_page(page, data);\n            match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, Some(&tip), &[page]) {\n                Ok(m) => tip = m.id,\n                Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {}\n                Err(o) => panic!(\"{o:?}\"),\n            }\n        }\n        let truth = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n        (e, root, base.id, tip, truth)\n    };\n\n    // 1) 非压缩合并：源全部保留，merged 逐页等于真值。\n    let (e, _r, base, tip, truth) = build(\"prop-merge\", \"m\");\n    let report = e\n        .merge_checkpoints(\"m\", &base, &tip, false)\n        .unwrap();\n    e.restore(\"m\", &report.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after = e.digest(\"m\").unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth, &after));\n    assert_eq!(report.merged_page_count, pc as usize);\n    assert_eq!(report.sources.len(), report.page_counts.len() - 1);\n    // 源节点仍然存在。\n    for s in &report.sources {\n        assert!(e.repo().read_meta(\"m\", s).is_ok());\n    }\n\n    // 2) 压缩合并：merged 原子发布后删除 i1..tip；merged 依然逐页等于真值。\n    let (e2, root2, base2, tip2, truth2) = build(\"prop-merge-compact\", \"c\");\n    let report2 = e2\n        .merge_checkpoints(\"c\", &base2, &tip2, true)\n        .expect(\"compact 合并失败\");\n    e2.restore(\"c\", &report2.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after2 = e2.digest(\"c\").unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth2, &after2));\n\n    // 源增量已被删除：现存节点只有 base(full) 与 merged。\n    let remaining = e2.repo().list_checkpoints(\"c\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(remaining.len(), 2, \"{remaining:?}\");\n    assert!(remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &report2.merged_id));\n    assert!(remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &base2));\n    assert!(!remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &tip2));\n\n    // 重启进程后 merged 仍然独立可恢复（不依赖任何已删源）。\n    let e3 = reopen_disk(&root2);\n    e3.restore(\"c\", &report2.merged_id).unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth2, &e3.digest(\"c\").unwrap()));\n}","originalFile":"//! 属性式测试：随机“写页 -> 偶尔打全量/增量”序列，\n//! 在每个检查点后对照参考模型摘要，并随机恢复到链上任意检查点，\n//! 用重放同一序列的方式验证恢复结果严格正确。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse cpengine::engine::digest_equal;\n\n/// 确定性简易 LCG（不依赖 rand crate）。\nstruct Rng(u64);\nimpl Rng {\n    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        // MMIX 常数。\n        self.0 = self.0.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);\n        self.0\n    }\n    fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> u64 {\n        self.next_u64() % n\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在给定 seed 下执行随机序列并验证。\nfn run_property(seed: u64, page_size: u32, page_count: u32, steps: u32) {\n    let (e, root) = disk_engine(&format!(\"prop-{seed}\"));\n    let ds = \"p\";\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n\n    let mut rng = Rng(seed.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) ^ 0xdead_beef);\n\n    // 记录每个检查点创建时刻，参考模型应当具有的页内容。\n    // 我们不保存全部历史内容，而是：恢复到检查点 id 时，用记录的“逐页 (version,crc)”\n    // 与恢复后摘要直接比较。\n    let mut snapshots: Vec<(String, Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite>)> = Vec::new();\n\n    // 参考模型实时镜像当前工作集。\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n\n    for step in 0..steps {\n        let action = rng.below(10);\n        match action {\n            0..=5 => {\n                // 写 1~2 个随机页。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(2);\n                for _ in 0..n {\n                    let page = rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32;\n                    let tag = rng.below(200) as u8;\n                    let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(page_size as usize, tag);\n                    e.write_page(ds, page, &data).expect(\"write\");\n                    model.write_page(page, data);\n                }\n                model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n            }\n            6 => {\n                // 全量。\n                let meta = e.checkpoint_full(ds).expect(\"full\");\n                let snap = lite_all(&model.digest());\n                snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n            }\n            7..=8 => {\n                // 增量：收集随机数量的脏页（只选当前版本>0的页，或允许新页）。\n                // 为保证合法，我们只提交“自上次检查点后确实写过”的页：\n                // 简化做法——尝试随机页集合，引擎若以 BadRequest 拒绝则跳过，\n                // 但必须保证：成功时摘要不变、链可解析。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(page_count as u64.min(3));\n                let pages: Vec<u32> = (0..n)\n                    .map(|_| rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32)\n                    .collect();\n                match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, None, &pages) {\n                    Ok(meta) => {\n                        // 成功前提：这些页版本都高于父链。记录快照。\n                        let snap = lite_all(&model.digest());\n                        snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n                    }\n                    Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {\n                        // 合法拒绝（页不够新/无父/空集去重后为空）。\n                    }\n                    Err(other) => panic!(\"增量出现非预期错误: {other:?}\"),\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // 随机恢复到某个历史检查点（如果有）。\n                if snapshots.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let idx = rng.below(snapshots.len() as u64) as usize;\n                let (id, snap) = &snapshots[idx];\n                let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore 历史检查点\");\n                assert_eq!(*report.chain.last().unwrap(), *id);\n                let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n                let lite_after = lite_all(&after);\n                assert_eq!(lite_after, *snap, \"seed={seed} step={step} 恢复到 {id} 后摘要与历史不符\");\n                // 恢复后参考模型也要回滚：从引擎工作集读回真实字节与版本重建。\n                model = model_from_engine(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 最终：对每个快照再做一次全量恢复校验，并重启进程验证持久化。\n    for (id, snap) in &snapshots {\n        let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore\");\n        assert_eq!(report.chain.last().unwrap(), id);\n        let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after = lite_all(&after);\n        assert_eq!(lite_after, *snap);\n    }\n    if !snapshots.is_empty() {\n        let e2 = reopen_disk(&root);\n        let (id, snap) = snapshots.last().unwrap();\n        e2.restore(ds, id).unwrap();\n        let after = e2.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after = lite_all(&after);\n        assert_eq!(lite_after, *snap);\n    }\n}\n\nmod common_hack {\n    /// 可比较的摘要三元组（不依赖 Serialize）。\n    #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Clone)]\n    pub struct PageDigestLite {\n        pub page: u32,\n        pub version: u64,\n        pub crc: String,\n    }\n    pub fn lite(d: cpengine::engine::PageDigest) -> PageDigestLite {\n        PageDigestLite {\n            page: d.page,\n            version: d.version,\n            crc: d.crc,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn lite_all(d: &[cpengine::engine::PageDigest]) -> Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite> {\n    d.iter().cloned().map(common_hack::lite).collect()\n}\n\n/// 从引擎当前工作集读回全部页，重建参考模型（随机恢复后使用）。\nfn model_from_engine(\n    e: &Engine,\n    ds: &str,\n    page_size: u32,\n    page_count: u32,\n) -> ReferenceModel {\n    let st = e.state(ds).unwrap();\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n    for p in 0..page_count {\n        let (bytes, info) = e.read_page(ds, p).unwrap();\n        model.data[p as usize] = bytes;\n        model.versions[p as usize] = st.page_versions[p as usize].max(info.version);\n    }\n    model\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_random_update_checkpoint_restore_seeds() {\n    for seed in 1..=12u64 {\n        run_property(seed, 8, 3, 60);\n    }\n    // 稍大的页与更长序列。\n    run_property(101, 64, 6, 120);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_merge_after_random_sequence_matches_model() {\n    // 独立确定性场景：随机更新 -> 形成单链 -> 全量合并 -> 逐页对照。\n    let (e, _root) = disk_engine(\"prop-merge\");\n    let ds = \"m\";\n    let (ps, pc) = (16u32, 5u32);\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, ps, pc);\n    let mut rng = Rng(0x1234_5678);\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(ps, pc);\n\n    let base = e.checkpoint_full(ds).unwrap();\n    let mut tip = base.id.clone();\n    for _ in 0..8 {\n        let page = rng.below(pc as u64) as u32;\n        let tag = rng.below(250) as u8;\n        let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(ps as usize, tag);\n        e.write_page(ds, page, &data).unwrap();\n        model.write_page(page, data);\n        match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, Some(&tip), &[page]) {\n            Ok(m) => tip = m.id,\n            Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {}\n            Err(o) => panic!(\"{o:?}\"),\n        }\n    }\n    let truth = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n    model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n\n    let report = e\n        .merge_checkpoints(ds, &base.id, &tip, false)\n        .unwrap();\n    e.restore(ds, &report.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth, &after));\n    assert_eq!(report.merged_page_count, pc as usize);\n\n    // compact 合并：merged 原子发布后删除 i1..tip；merged 依然逐页等于真值。\n    let report2 = e\n        .merge_checkpoints(ds, &base.id, &tip, true)\n        .expect(\"compact 合并失败\");\n    e.restore(ds, &report2.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after2 = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth, &after2));\n\n    // 源增量已被删除：从现存任何非 merged 旧节点恢复要么是 full（base），\n    // 要么指向已删父节点——但 merged 独立成立。\n    let remaining = e.repo().list_checkpoints(ds).unwrap();\n    assert!(remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &report2.merged_id));\n    assert!(remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &base.id));\n    assert!(!remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &tip));\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":163,"oldLines":51,"newStart":163,"newLines":68,"lines":[" "," #[test]"," fn    }\n269\t\n270\t    /// 原子覆盖一页工作集内容（含 fsync）。\n271\t    pub fn write_working_page(&self, dataset: &str, page: u32, data: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n272\t        self.io\n273\t (KIND_INCREMENTAL, None) => {\n454\t                return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(\"增量检查点必须指定 parent\".into()))\n455\t            }\n456\t            (k, Some(p)) => {\n457\t                return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n458\t                    \"{k} 检查点不能有父（却指定了 {p}）\"\n459\t                )))\n460\t            }\n461\t            (k, None) => {\n462\t                return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\"未知检查点类型 {k}\")))\n463\t            }\n464\t        };\n465\t\n466\t        // 3. 构造暂存目录并写页。\n467\t        let staging = self\n468\t }\n607\t}\n608\t\n609\t/// 标识符规则：数据集名 / 检查点 id 必须为 [A-Za-z0-9._-] 且不以点开头，\n610\t/// 长度 1..=64，杜绝路径穿越。\n611\tpub fn validate_ident(name: &str) -> Result<()> {\n612\t    if name.is_empty() || name.len() > 64 {\n613\t        return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n614\t            \"标识符长度必须在 1..=64：{name:?}\"\n615\t        )));\n616\t    }\n617\t    if name.starts_with('.') || name.contains('/') || name.contains('\\\\') {\n618\t        return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n619\t            \"标识符不能以点开头或包含路径分隔符：{name:?}\"\n620\t        )));\n621\t    }\n622\t    if !name\n623\t        .chars()\n624\t        .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_' || c == '-' || c == '.')\n625\t    {\n626\t        return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n627\t            \"标识符只能包含字母数字、下划线、连字符、点：{name:?}\"\n628\t        )));\n629\t    }\n630\t    Ok(())\n631\t}\n632\t\n633\tfn is_ident(name: &str) -> bool {\n634\t KIND_FULL: &str = \"full\";\n/// 增量检查点。\npub const KIND_INCREMENTAL: &str = \"incremental\";\n/// 合并检查点。\npub const KIND_MERGED: &str = \"merged\";\n\n/// 检查点元数据（同时落盘为每个检查点目录下的 `meta.json`）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct CheckpointMeta {\n    /// 全局唯一 ID，形如 `<数据集名>-seq000007`（合并目标可能为 `<数据集名>-mrg000007`）。\n    pub id: String,\n    /// `full` / `incremental` / `merged`。\n    pub kind: String,\n    /// 父检查点 ID；full/merged 为 null。\n    pub parent: Option<String>,\n    /// 父检查点 meta.json 字节的 CRC32 hex；null 表示无父。\n    pub parent_meta_crc: Option<String>,\n    /// 数据集名。\n    pub dataset: String,\n    /// 数据集内单调递增的序号（state.json 维护）。\n    pub seq: u64,\n    /// 创建时的单调时钟描述（毫秒）。\n    pub created_at_ms: u128,\n    /// 本检查点包含的页。\n    pub pages: BTreeMap<u32, PageEntry>,\n    /// pages 的覆盖页 id 有序列表（与 pages 键一致，便于人工阅读）。\n    pub page_ids: Vec<u32>,\n    /// 合并检查点专用：被合并掉的检查点 ID 列表。\n    pub merged_sources: Vec<String>,\n    /// 合并时的冲突记录（同版本不同内容，按分支侧胜出）。\n    pub conflicts: Vec<MergeConflict>,\n}\n\n/// 检查点中的一页。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct PageEntry {\n    /// 数据集工作页的版本号（从 1 起，每次写入该页 +1）。\n    pub version: u64,\n    /// 页内容字节数（固定等于数据集 page_size）。\n    pub size: u32,\n    /// `pages/p<id>.bin` 的 CRC32（8 位小写 hex）。\n    pub crc: String,\n}\n\n/// 合并冲突记录。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct MergeConflictRecord {\n    pub page: u32,\n    pub version: u64,\n    /// 各来源在该页的 crc。\n    pub source_crc: BTreeMap<String, String>,\n    /// 最终保留的来源。\n    pub winner: String,\n}\n\n// serde 别名，引擎层使用 MergeConflict 名称。\npub type MergeConflict = MergeConflictRecord;\n\n/// 数据集持久状态（`<root>/datasets/<name>/state.json`）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct DatasetState {\n    pub format_version: u32,\n    pub dataset: String,\n    /// 固定页大小（字节）。\n    pub page_size: u32,\n    /// 固定页数。\n    pub page_count: u32,\n    /// 数据集内下一个检查点序号。\n    pub next_seq: u64,\n    /// 每页的当前版本（初始为 0，表示从未写入）。\n    pub page_versions: Vec<u64>,\n    /// 每页当前内容的 crc hex（初始为全零页的 crc）。\n    pub current_crc: Vec<String>,\n    /// 当前工作集的“尖端”检查点 id：最近一次创建的检查点（full 重置，\n    /// incremental 续接，merge 后指向 merged）。仅用于提示与默认 parent。\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub tip: Option<String>,\n    /// 数据集创建时间。\n    pub created_at_ms: u128,\n}\n\n/// read_page(&self, dataset: &str, id: &str, page: u32, entry: &PageEntry) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        let path = self\n            .ckpt_dir(dataset, id)\n            .join(\"pages\")\n publish_checkpoint(\n        &self,\n        state: &mut DatasetState,\n        id: &str,\n        kind: &str,\n        parent: Option<&str>,\n        pages: &[PageToWrite<'_>],\n _root) = disk_engine(\"fixed\");\n    make_dataset(&e, \"fx\", 8, 2);\n\n    // 页越界。\n    let err = e.write_page(\"fx\", 2, &[0u8; 8]).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::BadRequest(_)), \"{err:?}\");\n\n    // 页内容长度不符。\n    let err = e.write_page(\"fx\", 0, &[0u8; 7]).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::BadRequest(_)), \"{err:?}\");\n\n    // 创建数据集参数非法。\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.create_dataset(\"a/../b\", 8, 2).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::BadRequest(_)\n    ));\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.create_dataset(\"zero\", 0, 2).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::BadRequest(_)\n    ));\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.create_dataset(\"zero2\", 8, 0).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::BadRequest(_)\n    ));\n\n    // 重复数据集名。\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.create_dataset(\"fx\", 8, 2).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::Conflict(_)\n    ));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn same_page_multiple_updates_full_incremental_chain() {\n    let (e, root, mut m) = setup(\"multi-update\");\n\n    // 页 0 连续更新 3 次、页 1 更新 2 次，交替打检查点。\n    let f1 = e.checkpoint_full(DS).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(f1.kind, \"full\");\n    assert_eq!(f1.pages.len(), PAGES as usize);\n    assert!(f1.parent.is_none());\n    m.assert_matches(&e, DS);\n\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 1, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(0, 1);\n    let i1 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[0]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(i1.kind, \"incremental\");\n    assert_eq!(i1.parent.as_deref(), Some(f1.id.as_str()));\n    assert_eq!(i1.pages.len(), 1);\n std::sync::Arc;\n\nstatic SEQ: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n\n/// 创建一个全新的临时存储根目录并返回（目录不存在，由引擎 init）。\npub fn temp_root(label: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    let n = SEQ.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n {\n    let root = temp_root(label);\n    let f = Arc::new(FaultyIo::new());\n    let io: SharedIo = f.clone();\n    let e = Engine::init(&root, io).expect(\"init repo\");\n    (e, f, root)\n}\n\n/// 在已存在的根目录上重新打开引擎（模拟进程重启）。\npub fn reopen_disk(root: &std::path::Path) -> Engine {\n    let io: SharedIo = Arc::new(DiskIo::new());\n    Engine::open(root, io).expect(\"reopen repo\")\n}\n\npub fn reopen_faulty(root: &std::path::Path, faulty: Arc<FaultyIo>) -> Engine {\n    let io: SharedIo = faulty.clone();\n    Engine::open(root, io).expect(\"reopen repo\")\n}\n\n/// 参考模型：逐次更新的固定页数据集镜像。\n///\n/// 与引擎并行执行同样的操作序列；任何时候它的摘要都应当等于\n/// `engine.digest()`，恢复/合并后也必须一致。\npub struct ReferenceModel {\n    pub page_size: u32,\n    pub data: Vec<Vec<u8>>,\n    pub versions: Vec<u64>,\n}\n\nimpl ReferenceModel {\n    pub fn new(page_size: u32, page_count: u32) -> Self {\n        ReferenceModel {\n            page_size,\n            data: vec![vec![0u8; page_size as usize]; page_count as usize],\n            versions: vec![0; page_count as usize],\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn write_page(&mut self, page: u32, data: Vec<u8>) {\n        assert_eq!(data.len(), self.page_size as usize);\n        self.data[page as usize] = data;\n        self.versions[page as usize] += 1;\n    }\n\n    pub fn patterned(&mut self, page: u32, tag: u8) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let d = pattern_page(self.page_size as usize, tag);\n        self.write_page(page, d.clone());\n        d\n    }\n\n    pub fn digest(&self) -> Vec<PageDigest> {\n        self.data\n            .iter()\n            .zip(&self.versions)\n            .enumerate()\n            .map(|(i, (bytes, v))| PageDigest {\n                page: i as u32,\n                version: *v,\n                size: );\n    }\n}\n\n/// 建数据集并返回其元信息。\npub fn make_dataset(engine: &Engine, name: &str, page_size: u32, page_count: u32) {\n    engine\n        .create_dataset(name, page_size, page_count)\n        .expect(\"create dataset\");\n}\n\n/// 仅写一页（pattern 内容）。\npub fn put_only(engine: &Engine, ds: &str, page: u32, tag: u8, size: usize) {\n    let d = pattern_page(size, tag);\n    engine.write_page(ds, .map_err(map_error)?;\n        return Ok((201, ok_json(report)));\n    }\n\n    // /datasets/{name}/pages/{page}\n    if tail.len() == 2 && tail[0] == \"pages\" {\n        let page: u32 = tail[1]\n            .parse()\n            .map_err(|_| http400(\"bad_page\", format!(\"页 id 非法：{}\", tail[1])))?;\n        match m.as_str() {\n            \"PUT\" => {\n                let st = engine.state(name).map_err(map_error)?;\n                let payload = parse_page_payload(req, st.page_size as usize)?;\n                let d = engine.write_page(name, page, &payload).map_err(map_error)?;\n                return Ok((200, ok_json(d)));\n            }\n            \"GET\" => {\n                let (data, d) = engine.read_page(name, page).map_err(map_error)?;\n                // 页内容以 hex 返回（raw 字节可通过 tests/ 里的引擎 API 获取）。\n                return Ok((\n                    200,\n                    ok_json(json!({\n                        \"page\": d,\n                        \"hex\": crate::checksum::to_hex(&data),\n                    })),\n                ));\n            }\n            _ => return Err(http400(\"method\", \"该路径仅支持 GET/PUT\")),\n        }\n    }\n\n    // /datasets/{name}/checkpoints/...\n    if tail.first() == Some(&\"checkpoints\") {\n        return route_checkpoints(app, req, name, &tail[1..]);\n    }\n\n    Err(http404(format!(\"没有匹配的数据集子路径：/{}\", tail.join(\"/\"))))\n}\n\nfn route_checkpoints(\n    app: &App,\n    req: &Request,\n    name: &str,\n    tail: &[&str],\n) -> std::result::Result<(u16, serde_json::Value), HttpError> {\n    let engine = &app.engine;\n    let m = &req.method;\n\n    // /checkpoints\n    if tail.is_empty() && m == \"GET\" {\n        let all = engine.list_checkpoints(name).map_err(map_error)?;\n        return Ok((200, ok_json(json!({\"checkpoints\": all}))));\n    }\n    // /checkpoints/full\n    if tail == [\"full\"] && m == \"POST\" {\n        let meta = engine.checkpoint_full(name).map_err(map_error)?;\n        return Ok((201, ok_json(meta)));\n    }\n    // /checkpoints/incremental\n    if tail == [\"incremental\"] && m == \"POST\" {\n        let v = json_body(req)?;\n        let parent = v.get(\"parent\").and_then(|x| x.as_str());\n        let pages: Vec<u32> = v\n            .get(\"pages\")\n            .and_then(|x| x.as_array())\n            .ok_or_else(|| http400(\"missing_field\", \"缺少 pages 数组\"))?\n            .iter()\n            .map(|p| {\n                p.as_u64()\n                    .map(|n| n as u32)\n                    .ok_or_else(|| http400(\"bad_page\", \"pages 必须为整数数组\"))\n            })\n            .collect::<std::result::Result<_, _>>()?;\n        let meta = engine\n            .checkpoint_incremental(name, parent, &pages)\n            .map_err(map_error)?;\n        return Ok((201, ok_json(meta)));\n    }\n\n    // /checkpoints/{id}[/chain|/restore|/corrupt|/rewire|/delete]\n    if let Some(id) = tail.first() {\n        let sub = &tail[1..];\n        match sub {\n            [] if *m == \"GET\" => {\n                let meta = engine.repo().read_meta(name, id).map_err(map_error)?;\n                return Ok((200, ok_json(meta)));\n            }\n            [\"chain\"] if *m == \"GET\" => {\n                let chain = engine.resolve_chain(name, id).map_err(map_error)?;\n                return Ok((200, ok_json(json!({\"tip\": id, \"chain\": chain}))));\n            }\n            [\"restore\"] if *m == \"POST\" => {\n                let report = engine.restore(name, id).map_err(map_error)?;\n                return Ok((200, ok_json(report)));\n            }\n            [\"corrupt\"] if *m == \"POST\" => {\n                let v = json_body(req)?;\n                let page = v\n                    .get(\"page\")\n                    .and_then(|x| x.as_u64())\n                    .ok_or_else(|| http400(\"missing_field\", \"缺少 page\"))?\n                    as u32;\n                let st = engine.state(name).map_err(map_error)?;\n                let bytes = if let Some(hex) = v.get(\"hex\").and_then(|x| x.as_str()) {\n                    from_hex(hex).map_err(|e| http400(\"bad_hex\", e))?\n                } else if let Some(byte) = v.get(\"byte\").and_then(|x| x.as_u64()) {\n                    vec![byte as u8; st.page_size as usize]\n                } else {\n                    return Err(http400(\n                        \"missing_field\",\n                        \"需要 {hex} 或 {byte} 指定损坏内容\",\n                    ));\n                };\n                engine\n                    .test_corrupt_page(name, id, page, &bytes)\n                    .map_err(map_error)?;\n                return Ok((\n                    200,\n                    ok_json(json!({\"corrupted\": true, \"checkpoint\": id, \"page\": page})),\n                ));\n            }\n            [\"rewire\"] if *m == \"POST\" => {\n                let v = json_body(req)?;\n                let new_parent = v\n                    .get(\"parent\")\n                    .and_then(|x| x.as_str())\n                    .ok_or_else(|| http400(\"missing_field\", \"缺少 parent\"))?;\n                engine\n                    .test_rewire_parent(name, id, new_parent)\n                    .map_err(map_error)?;\n                return Ok((\n                    200,\n                    ok_json(json!({\"rewired\": id, \"parent\": new_parent})),\n                ));\n            }\n            [\"delete\"] if *m == \"POST\" => {\n                engine.test_delete_checkpoint(name, id).map_err(map_error)?;\n                return Ok((200, ok_json(json!({\"deleted\": id}))));\n            }\n            _ => {}\n        }\n    }\n\n    Err(http404(format!(\"没有匹配的检查点子路径：/{}\",    let m = ReferenceModel::new(SIZE, PAGES);\n    (e, root, m)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn fixed_page_constraints_are_enforced() {\n    let (e, _root) = disk_engine(\"fixed\");\n    make_dataset(&e, \"fx\", 8, Rng(u64);\nimpl Rng {\n    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        // MMIX 常数。\n        self.0 = self.0.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);\n        self.0\n    }\n    fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> u64 {\n        self.next_u64() % n\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在给定 seed 下执行随机序列并验证。\nfn run_property(seed: u64, page_size: u32, page_count: u32, steps: u32) {\n    let (e, root) = disk_engine(&format!(\"prop-{seed}\"));\n    let ds = \"p\";\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n\n    let mut rng = Rng(seed.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) ^ 0xdead_beef);\n\n    // 记录每个检查点创建时刻，参考模型应当具有的页内容。\n    // 我们不保存全部历史内容，而是：恢复到检查点 id 时，用记录的“逐页 (version,crc)”\n    // 与恢复后摘要直接比较。\n    let mut snapshots: Vec<(String, Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite>)> = Vec::new();\n\n    // 参考模型实时镜像当前工作集。\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n\n    for step in 0..steps {\n        let action = rng.below(10);\n        match action {\n            0..=5 => {\n                // 写 1~2 个随机页。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(2);\n                for _ in 0..n {\n                    let page = rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32;\n                    let tag = rng.below(200) as u8;\n                    let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(page_size as usize, tag);\n                    e.write_page(ds, page, &data).expect(\"write\");\n                    model.write_page(page, data);\n                }\n                model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n            }\n            6 => {\n                // 全量。\n                let meta = e.checkpoint_full(ds).expect(\"full\");\n                let snap = lite_all(&model.digest());\n                snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n            }\n            7..=8 => {\n                // 增量：收集随机数量的脏页（只选当前版本>0的页，或允许新页）。\n                // 为保证合法，我们只提交“自上次检查点后确实写过”的页：\n                // 简化做法——尝试随机页集合，引擎若以 BadRequest 拒绝则跳过，\n                // 但必须保证：成功时摘要不变、链可解析。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(page_count as u64.min(3));\n                let pages: Vec<u32> = (0..n)\n                    .map(|_| rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32)\n                    .collect();\n                match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, None, &pages) {\n                    Ok(meta) => {\n                        // 成功前提：这些页版本都高于父链。记录快照。\n                        let snap = e.create_dataset(\"zero2\", 8, 0).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::BadRequest(_)\n    ));\n\n    // 重复数据集名。\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.create_dataset(\"fx\", 8, 2).unwrap_err(),\n        EngineError::Conflict(_)\n    ));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn same_page_multiple_updates_full_incremental_chain() {\n    let (e, root, mut m) = setup(\"multi-update\");\n\n    // 页 0 连续更新 3 次、页 1 更新 2 m.assert_matches(&e, DS);\n\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 1, SIZE as usize);\n    m.patterned(0, 1);\n    let i1 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[0]).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(i1.kind, \"incremental\");\n    assert_eq!(i1.parent.as_deref(), Some(f1.id.as_str()));\n    assert_eq!(i1.pages.len(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(i1.pages[&0].version, 1);\n\n    // 同页第二次更新。\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, m2.assert_matches(&e2, DS);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn incremental_rejects_page_not_newer_than_parent_chain() {\n    let (e, _root, mut m) = setup(\"stale-page\");\n\n    put_only(&e, DS, 0, 9, SIZE as
