0, 3, SIZE as usize);\n    let i2 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, &[0, 1]).unwrap().id;\n    put_only(&e, DS, 2, 4, SIZE as usize);\n    let i3 = e.checkpoint_incremental(DS, None, root, ids) = chain(\"missing-parent\");\n    let [f0, i1, i2, i3] = ids.clone();\n\n    // 直接删除中间的 i1：i2/i3 的链在此断裂。\n    e.test_delete_checkpoint(DS, &i1).unwrap();\n\n    // i3 与 i2 都必须报 i1);\n            // checkpoint 是直接引用缺失父项的那个节点（i2）。\n            assert_eq!(checkpoint, i2);\n        }\n        other => panic!(\"期望 MissingParent，实际 {other:?}\"),\n    }\n    let err = e.restore(DS, &i3).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::MissingParent { .. }), \"{err:?}\");\n\n    // 链根 f0 本身完好，仍可严格恢复（不允许“跳过缺口”）。\n    let report = e.restore(DS, &f0).unwrap();\n reopen_disk(&root);\n    let err = e2.resolve_chain(DS, &i3).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, EngineError::MissingParent { .. }), \"{err:?}\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn  }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn cycle_dependency_is_detected() {\n    let (e, _f, root, ids) = chain(\"cycle\");\n    let [_f0, i1, i2, i3] = ids.clone();\n\n    // 把链上更早的 i1 的 parent 改写成其后裔 i3：从 i3 出发 {"parentUuid":"6db2d398-6e79-4dd7-b940-a492930fa6d9","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_6q4135udjk28kqktnx2w1usx","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/src/engine.rs","old_string":"    /** 解析检查点 `tip` 的依赖链：返回从链根（full/merged）到 tip 的 id 序列。\n\n    严格规则：\n    - full/merged：parent 必须为 null，链为自身；\n    - incremental：parent 必须存在且类型合法，沿 parent 向上直到 full/merged；\n    - 父 meta 文件缺失 -> MissingParent；\n    - 路径上重复出现某 id -> CycleDetected（循环依赖）；\n    - incremental 的父若是 incremental/full/merged 之外的类型 -> BadRequest。\n    */\n    pub fn resolve_chain(&self, dataset: &str, tip: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        // 先确认 tip 存在（给出清晰的 NotFound）。\n        let first = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, tip)?;\n        let mut up = Vec::new();\n        let mut cur_id = first.id.clone();\n        let mut seen: BTreeSet<String> = BTreeSet::new();\n        loop {\n            if !seen.insert(cur_id.clone()) {\n                return Err(EngineError::CycleDetected(cur_id));\n            }\n            let meta = self.repo.read_meta(dataset, &cur_id)?;\n            match meta.kind.as_str() {\n                KIND_FULL | KIND_MERGED => {\n                    if meta.parent.is_some() {\n                        return Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                            \"检查点 {} 声明为 {} 却带有 parent\",\n                            meta.id, meta.kind\n                        )));\n                    }\n                    up.push(meta.id.clone());\n                    break;\n                }\n                KIND_INCREMENTAL => {\n                    let parent = meta.parent.clone().ok_or_else(|| {\n                        EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                            \"增量检查点 {} 缺少 parent\",\n                            meta.id\n                        ))\n                    })?;\n                    // 结构性检查优先：父已在当前路径上出现 -> 环闭合。\n                    // （自环也在此被抓住，不必先读取/比对父 CRC。）\n                    if seen.contains(&parent) {\n                        return Err(EngineError::CycleDetected(parent));\n                    }\n                    // 检查父文件确实存在，错误里带上当前检查点。\n                    if !self.repo.io().exists(&self.repo.meta_path(dataset, &parent)) {\n                        return Err(EngineError::MissingParent {\n                            checkpoint: cur_id,\n Err(EngineError::BadRequest(format!(\n                        \"检查点 {cur_id} 的类型 {k} 不受支持\"\n                    )));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        up.reverse();\n        Ok(up)\n    }","new_string":"    /** 解析检查点 `tip` 的依赖链：返回从链根（full/merged）到 tip 的 id 序列。\n\n    严格规则与错误优先级：\n    1. 先做**纯结构遍历**（只读 parent 指针与 kind）：父 meta 文件缺失 ->\n       MissingParent；路径上重复出现某 id -> CycleDetected（循环依赖）；\n       full/merged 带 parent 或增量无 parent -> BadRequest；\n    2. 结构完整后再逐节点校验 `parent_meta_crc`（父元数据被篡改）->\n       ParentMetaCrcMismatch；页字节 CRC 在 restore/merge 载入时校验。\n\n (e, root) = disk_engine(label);\n        make_dataset(&e, ds, ps, pc);\n        let mut rng = Rng(0x1234_5678);\n        let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(ps, pc);\n        let base = e.checkpoint_full(ds).unwrap();\n        let mut tip = base.id.clone();\n        for _ in 0..8 {\n            let page = rng.below(pc as u64) as u32;\n            let tag = rng.below(250) as u8;\n            let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(ps as usize, tag);\n            e.write_page(ds, page, &data).unwrap();\n            model.write_page(page, data);\n            match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, Some(tip.as_str()), &[page]) {\n                Ok(m) => tip = m.id,\n                Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {}\n                Err(o) => panic!(\"{o:?}\"),\n            }\n        }\n        let truth = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n        (e, root, base.id, tip, truth)\n    };\n\n    // 1) 非压缩合并：源全部保留，merged 逐页等于真值。\n    let (e, _r, base, tip, truth) = build(\"prop-merge\", \"m\");\n    let report = e\n        .merge_checkpoints(\"m\", &base, &tip, false)\n        .unwrap();\n    e.restore(\"m\", &report.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after = e.digest(\"m\").unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth, &after));\n    assert_eq!(report.merged_page_count, pc as usize);\n    assert_eq!(report.sources.len(), report.page_counts.len() - 1);\n    // 源节点仍然存在。\n    for s in &report.sources {\n        assert!(e.repo().read_meta(\"m\", s).is_ok());\n    }\n\n    // 2) 压缩合并：merged 原子发布后删除 i1..tip；merged 依然逐页等于真值。\n    let (e2, root2, base2, tip2, truth2) = build(\"prop-merge-compact\", \"c\");\n    let report2 = e2\n        .merge_checkpoints(\"c\", &base2, &tip2, true)\n        .expect(\"compact 合并失败\");\n    e2.restore(\"c\", &report2.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after2 = e2.digest(\"c\").unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth2, &after2));\n\n    // 源增量已被删除：现存节点只有 base(full) 与 merged。\n    let remaining = e2.repo().list_checkpoints(\"c\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(remaining.len(), 2, \"{remaining:?}\");\n    assert!(remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &report2.merged_id));\n    assert!(remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &base2));\n    assert!(!remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &tip2));\n\n    // 重启进程后 merged 仍然独立可恢复（不依赖任何已删源）。\n    let e3 = HTTP 端到端测试：真实 TcpListener（端口 0 自动分配）+ 手写 HTTP/1.1 请求。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse cpengine::server;\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nstruct TestServer {\n    addr: String,\n    _root: std::path::PathBuf,\n}\n\nfn spawn_server(label: &str) -> TestServer {\n    let root = common::temp_root(label);\n    let (app, _f) = server::build_app(&root, true).expect(\"build app\");\n    let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n    let app = std::sync::Arc::new(app);\n    std::thread::spawn(move || server::serve(listener, app));\n    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));\n    TestServer {\n        addr,\n        _root: root,\n    }\n}\n\nstruct Resp {\n    status: u16,\n    json: serde_json::Value,\n}\n\n/// 发起一次请求；`body` 为空串表示无 body。\nfn req(server: &TestServer, method: &str, path: &str, body: &str) -> Resp {\n    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect(&server.addr).unwrap();\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).unwrap();\n    let head = format!(\n        \"{method} {path} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n{body}\",\n        body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(head.as_bytes()).unwrap();\n    let mut raw = Vec::new();\n    stream.read_to_end(&mut raw).unwrap();\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw);\n    let status: u16 = text\n        .lines()\n        .next()\n        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().nth(1))\n        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n    let body_part = text.split(\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\").nth(1).unwrap_or(\"{}\");\n    let json: serde_json::Value =\n        serde_json::from_str(body_part).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!(\"非 JSON 响应: {body_part:?} ({e})\"));\n    Resp { status, json }\n}\n\nfn data(r: &Resp) -> &serde_json::Value {\n    &r.json[\"data\"]\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_full_workflow() {\n    let s = spawn_server(\"http-basic\");\n\n    // health\n    let r = req(&s, \"GET\", \"/\", \"\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"engine\"].as_str(), Some(\"incremental-checkpoint-engine\"));\n\n    // 创建数据集\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets\",\n        r#\"{\"name\":\"ds\",\"page_size\":8,\"page_count\":3}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, \"{}\", r.json);\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"next_seq\"].as_u64(), Some(1));\n\n    // 重复创建 -> 409\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets\",\n        r#\"{\"name\":\"ds\",\"page_size\":8,\"page_count\":3}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n    assert_eq!(r.json[\"error\"][\"code\"].as_str(), Some(\"conflict\"));\n\n    // 初始摘要全为零页、版本 0\n    let r = req(&s, \"GET\", \"/datasets/ds/digest\", \"\");\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"digest\"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 3);\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"digest\"][0][\"version\"].as_u64(), Some(0));\n\n    // 全量（零页）\n    let r = req(&s, \"POST\", \"/datasets/ds/checkpoints/full\", \"{}\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, \"{}\", r.json);\n    let f0 = data(&r)[\"id\"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"kind\"].as_str(), Some(\"full\"));\n\n    // 页 0 连续三次更新（同页多次更新），页 1 一次。\n    for tag in [1u8, 2, 3] {\n        let r = req(\n            &s,\n            \"PUT\",\n            \"/datasets/ds/pages/0\",\n            &format!(r#\"{{\"pattern\":{tag}}}\"#),\n        );\n        assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"write page0 tag={tag}: {}\", r.json);\n    }\n    let r = req(&s, \"PUT\", \"/datasets/ds/pages/1\", r#\"{\"pattern\":3}\"#);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"{}\", r.json);\n\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/ds/checkpoints/incremental\",\n        r#\"{\"pages\":[0]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, \"{}\", r.json);\n    let i1 = data(&r)[\"id\"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"pages\"][\"0\"][\"version\"].as_u64(), Some(3)); // 页 0 已写 3 次\n\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/ds/checkpoints/incremental\",\n        r#\"{\"pages\":[1]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, \"{}\", r.json);\n    let i2 = data(&r)[\"id\"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();\n\n    // 链\n    let r = req(&s, \"GET\", &format!(\"/datasets/ds/checkpoints/{i2}/chain\"), \"\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let chain = data(&r)[\"chain\"].as_array().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(chain[0].as_str(), Some(f0.as_str()));\n    assert_eq!(chain[1].as_str(), Some(i1.as_str()));\n    assert_eq!(chain[2].as_str(), Some(i2.as_str()));\n\n    // 破坏工作集后恢复到 i2，得到逐次更新真值。\n    for p in 0..3 {\n        req(\n            &s,\n            \"PUT\",\n            &format!(\"/datasets/ds/pages/{p}\"),\n            r#\"{\"byte\":255}\"#,\n        );\n    }\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        &format!(\"/datasets/ds/checkpoints/{i2}/restore\"),\n        \"{}\",\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"{}\", r.json);\n    let truth = data(&r)[\"digest\"].clone();\n    assert_eq!(truth[0][\"version\"].as_u64(), Some(3));\n    assert_eq!(truth[1][\"version\"].as_u64(), Some(1));\n    assert_eq!(truth[2][\"version\"].as_u64(), Some(0));\n\n    // 合并 f0..i2，恢复 merged 必须与逐次更新真值一致。\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/ds/merge\",\n        &format!(r#\"{{\"base\":\"{f0}\",\"tip\":\"{i2}\"}}\"#),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, \"{}\", r.json);\n    let merged = data(&r)[\"merged_id\"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"merged_page_count\"].as_u64(), Some(3));\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        &format!(\"/datasets/ds/checkpoints/{merged}/restore\"),\n        \"{}\",\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(data(&r)[\"digest\"], truth);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_fault_injection_and_missing_parent() {\n    let s = spawn_server(\"http-faults\");\n    req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets\",\n        r#\"{\"name\":\"d\",\"page_size\":4,\"page_count\":2}\"#,\n    );\n    let f0 = data(&req(&s, \"POST\", \"/datasets/d/checkpoints/full\", \"{}\"))[\"id\"]\n        .as_str()\n        .unwrap()\n        .to_string();\n    req(&s, \"PUT\", \"/datasets/d/pages/0\", r#\"{\"byte\":7}\"#);\n    let i1 = data(&req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/d/checkpoints/incremental\",\n        r#\"{\"pages\":[0]}\"#,\n    ))[\"id\"]\n        .as_str()\n        .unwrap()\n        .to_string();\n    req(&s, \"PUT\", \"/datasets/d/pages/1\", r#\"{\"byte\":8}\"#);\n    let i2 = data(&req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/d/checkpoints/incremental\",\n        r#\"{\"pages\":[1]}\"#,\n    ))[\"id\"]\n        .as_str()\n        .unwrap()\n        .to_string();\n\n    // 删除 i1 -> i2 链断裂\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        &format!(\"/datasets/d/checkpoints/{i1}/delete\"),\n        \"{}\",\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = req(&s, \"GET\", &format!(\"/datasets/d/checkpoints/{i2}/chain\"), \"\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n    assert_eq!(r.json[\"error\"][\"code\"].as_str(), Some(\"missing_parent\"));\n\n    // f0 仍可用\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        &format!(\"/datasets/d/checkpoints/{f0}/restore\"),\n        \"{}\",\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n\n    // 故障注入：下一次目录发布（增量）失败\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/faults\",\n        r#\"{\"op\":\"rename_publish\",\"trigger_at\":1,\"note\":\"http 模拟掉电\"}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    req(&s, \"PUT\", \"/datasets/d/pages/0\", r#\"{\"byte\":9}\"#);\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/d/checkpoints/incremental\",\n        r#\"{\"pages\":[0]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 500);\n    assert_eq!(r.json[\"error\"][\"code\"].as_str(), Some(\"injected_fault\"));\n    // one-shot 自动解除，后续恢复正常。\n    let r = req(&s, \"GET\", \"/faults\", \"\");\n    assert!(data(&r).is_null(), \"故障触发后应自动解除: {}\", r.json);\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/d/checkpoints/incremental\",\n        r#\"{\"pages\":[0]}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, \"{}\", r.json);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_cycle_and_checksum_errors() {\n    let s = spawn_server(\"http-cycle\");\n    req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets\",\n        r#\"{\"name\":\"d\",\"page_size\":4,\"page_count\":2}\"#,\n    );\n    let f0 = data(&req(&s, \"POST\", \"/datasets/d/checkpoints/full\", \"{}\"))[\"id\"]\n        .as_str()\n        .unwrap()\n        .to_string();\n    req(&s, \"PUT\", \"/datasets/d/pages/0\", r#\"{\"byte\":1}\"#);\n    let i1 = data(&req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets/d/checkpoints/incremental\",\n        r#\"{\"pages\":[0]}\"#,\n    ))[\"id\"]\n        .as_str()\n        .unwrap()\n        .to_string();\n\n    // 造自环：i1.parent = i1\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        &format!(\"/datasets/d/checkpoints/{i1}/rewire\"),\n        &format!(r#\"{{\"parent\":\"{i1}\"}}\"#),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = req(&s, \"GET\", &format!(\"/datasets/d/checkpoints/{i1}/chain\"), \"\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n    assert_eq!(r.json[\"error\"][\"code\"].as_str(), Some(\"cycle_detected\"));\n\n    // CRC 损坏：f0 的页 0\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        &format!(\"/datasets/d/checkpoints/{f0}/corrupt\"),\n        r#\"{\"page\":0,\"byte\":200}\"#,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        &format!(\"/datasets/d/checkpoints/{f0}/restore\"),\n        \"{}\",\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n    assert_eq!(r.json[\"error\"][\"code\"].as_str(), Some(\"checksum_mismatch\"));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_bad_routes_and_payloads() {\n    let s = spawn_server(\"http-bad\");\n    req(\n        &s,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets\",\n        r#\"{\"name\":\"d\",\"page_size\":4,\"page_count\":2}\"#,\n    );\n\n    // 未知路由\n    assert_eq!(req(&s, \"GET\", \"/nope\", \"\").status, 404);\n    // 坏 JSON\n    let r = req(&s, \"POST\", \"/datasets\", \"{bad\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 400);\n    assert_eq!(r.json[\"error\"][\"code\"].as_str(), Some(\"bad_json\"));\n    // 页大小不符（hex \"aabb\" = 2 字节 != 4）\n    let r = req(&s, \"PUT\", \"/datasets/d/pages/0\", r#\"{\"hex\":\"aabb\"}\"#);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 400);\n    assert_eq!(r.json[\"error\"][\"code\"].as_str(), Some(\"bad_page_size\"));\n    // 页越界\n    let r = req(&s, \"PUT\", \"/datasets/d/pages/9\", r#\"{\"byte\":1}\"#);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 400);\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_d0b243f7e808838f89eb8492","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":771,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":170808,"output_tokens":6115,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"03099534-529f-485e-b7d8-6fd44fe25453","timestamp":"2026-09-22T17:16:50.561Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

增量检查点引擎 —— 本地 HTTP 验证入口。\n2\t//!\n3\t//! 用法：\n4\t//! ```text\n5\t//! cpengine --root ./data --addr 127.0.0.1:8088 [--no-faulty]\n6\t//! ```\n7\t\n8\tuse std::path::PathBuf;\n9\t\n10\tfn main() {\n11\t    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();\n12\t    let mut root = PathBuf::from(\"./cpengine-data\");\n13\t    let mut addr = \"127.0.0.1:8088\".to_string();\n14\t    let mut faulty = true;\n15\t    let mut help = false;\n16\t\n17\t    let mut i = 1;\n18\t    while i < args.len() {\n19\t        match args[i].as_str() {\n20\t            \"--root\" => {\n21\t                i += 1;\n22\t                root = PathBuf::from(args.get(i).unwrap_or_else(|| usage_die(\"--root 缺少参数\"));\n23\t            }\n24\t            \"--addr\" => {\n25\t                i += 1;\n26\t                addr = args.get(i).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| usage_die(\"--addr 缺少参数\"));\n27\t            }\n28\t            \"--no-faulty\" => faulty = false,\n29\t            \"-h\" | \"--help\" => help = true,\n30\t            other => {\n31\t                eprintln!(\"未知参数: {other}\");\n32\t                usage_die(\"参数错误\");\n33\t            }\n34\t        }\n35\t        i += 1;\n36\t    }\n37\t\n38\t    if help {\n39\t        print_help();\n40\t        return;\n41\t    }\n42\t\n43\t    let cfg = cpengine::server::ServerConfig { addr, faulty };\n44\t    if let Err(e) = cpengine::server::run(&root, cfg) {\n45\t        eprintln!(\"启动失败: {e}\");\n46\t        std::process::exit(1);\n47\t    }\n48\t}\n49\t\n50\tfn usage_die(msg: &str) -> ! 增量检查点引擎 —— 本地 HTTP 验证入口。\n//!\n//! 用法：\n//! ```text\n//! cpengine --root ./data --addr 127.0.0.1:8088 [--no-faulty]\n//! ```\n\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\n\nfn main() {\n    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();\n    let mut root = PathBuf::from(\"./cpengine-data\");\n    let mut addr = \"127.0.0.1:8088\".to_string();\n    let mut faulty = true;\n    let mut help = false;\n\n    let mut i = 1;\n    while i < args.len() {\n        match args[i].as_str() {\n            \"--root\" => {\n                i += 1;\n                root = PathBuf::from(args.get(i).unwrap_or_else(|| usage_die(\"--root 缺少参数\"));\n            }\n            \"--addr\" => {\n                i += 1;\n                addr = args.get(i).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| usage_die(\"--addr 缺少参数\"));\n            }\n            \"--no-faulty\" => faulty = false,\n            \"-h\" | \"--help\" => help = true,\n            other => {\n                eprintln!(\"未知参数: {other}\");\n                usage_die(\"参数错误\");\n            }\n        }\n        i += 1;\n    }\n\n    if help {\n        print_help();\n        return;\n    }\n\n    let cfg = cpengine::server::ServerConfig { addr, faulty };\n    if let Err(e) = cpengine::server::run(&root, cfg) {\n        eprintln!(\"启动失败: {e}\");\n        std::process::exit(1);\n    }\n}\n\nfn usage_die(msg: &str) -> ! {\n    eprintln!(\"{msg}\");\n    print_help();\n    std::process::exit(2)\n}\n\nfn print_help() {\n    println!(\n        \"增量检查点引擎 (incremental-checkpoint-engine)\\n\\\n\\n\\\n用法:\\n  cpengine [--root DIR] [--addr HOST:PORT] [--no-faulty]\\n\\\n\\n\\\n选项:\\n\\\n  --root DIR        存储库根目录（不存在则初始化），默认 ./cpengine-data\\n\\\n  --addr HOST:PORT  本地监听地址，默认 127.0.0.1:8088\\n\\\n  --no-faulty       禁用 /faults 故障注入控制面\\n\\\n  -h, --help        显示本帮助\\n\"\n    );\n}\n","numLines":69,"startLine":1,"totalLines":69}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"3d1ce0a6-0f59-4c57-ab8e-792c88029b0c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

This logic is designed to support partial page inclusion, with the post-incremental tip only containing updates for included pages.\n\nI've confirmed the error in naming the checkpoint snapshot: it should record the chain-restored digest instead of the current working-set digest. I also clarified the core design logic of the checkpoint system: use a separate committed model to track full and incremental page commits, with the parent of an incremental defaulting to the previous checkpoint's tip.\n\nI've finalized the implementation rules for the committed model: it will be synced with the full checkpoint snapshot, and updated to include only pages covered by the incremental after a successful commit. The snapshot will directly use the committed model's digest, and the live working set will be rebuilt after restoring to a checkpoint. I also noted a key version compatibility detail for subsequent incremental commits.\n\nI've verified the existing logic for handling page versions after restore is valid. I've confirmed the committed model implementation details, sorted out the struct design plan, and will rewrite the run_property function in the property test file to fix the existing snapshot error.\n\nI've finalized the implementation rules for the committed model: ReferenceModel will have a helper method to export committed data, the property test file will use a separate stored tuple to hold committed data and versions, a helper function will calculate the snapshot digest from committed content, the committed record will be updated only for pages included in incremental commits, and a parent chain root check for full committed records will be added before incremental updates.\n\nI've confirmed committed snapshots are immutable, adjusted the snapshot structure to store full committed data, and will now proceed with the rewrite.\n","type":"thinking"}],"id":"msg_e0b1ef8ef0adf7676d30ac40","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1581,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":182072,"output_tokens":4523,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"89b37ae8-c7da-48fb-a2ce-fdd78b8f85cd","timestamp":"2026-09-22T17:42:08.376Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}
{"parentUuid":"89b37ae8-c7da-48fb-a2ce-fdd78b8f85cd","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"更重要的发现：属性测试把\"当前工作集摘要\"错误地当作\"检查点快照\"——增量只固化部分页，恢复它时未包含的脏页应回到链上旧值。需要为每个检查点维护独立的\"已提交链状态\"。重写 property.rs：\n","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_e0b1ef8ef0adf7676d30ac40","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1581,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":182072,"output_tokens":4523,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"1695aa73-243a-469f-9968-d5791e49e135","timestamp":"2026-09-22T17:42:09.730Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}
{"parentUuid":"1695aa73-243a-469f-9968-d5791e49e135","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_y7iqw32nubqftmxvgwkx9g2j","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b/tests/property.rs","content":"//! 属性式测试：随机“写页 -> 偶尔打全量/增量 -> 随机恢复到历史检查点”。\n//!\n//! 关键：检查点代表的是**它那条父链的内容**，不等于创建时刻的工作集\n//! （增量只固化部分页，其余页沿链取旧值）。因此测试同时维护两份状态：\n//! - `live`：工作集镜像（每次写页同步更新；恢复后从引擎读回重建）；\n//! - `committed`：当前尖端检查点链所代表的页状态——\n//!   full = 当时全部工作页；incremental = 父链状态上仅覆盖本次包含的页。\n//! 每个检查点记录其 committed 快照；随机恢复后必须与该快照逐页一致。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse cpengine::engine::digest_equal;\n\n/// 确定性简易 LCG（不依赖 rand crate）。\nstruct Rng(u64);\nimpl Rng {\n    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        self.0 = self.0\n            .wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005)\n            .wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);\n        self.0\n    }\n    fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> u64 {\n        self.next_u64() % n\n    }\n}\n\n/// 检查点链状态（内容 + 版本）。\n#[derive(Clone)]\nstruct ChainState {\n    data: Vec<Vec<u8>>,\n    versions: Vec<u64>,\n    page_size: u32,\n}\n\nimpl ChainState {\n    fn zero(page_size: u32, page_count: u32) -> Self {\n        ChainState {\n            data: vec![vec![0u8; page_size as usize]; page_count as usize],\n            versions: vec![0; page_count as usize],\n            page_size,\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn lite_digest(&self) -> Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite> {\n        self.data\n            .iter()\n            .zip(&self.versions)\n            .enumerate()\n            .map(|(i, (bytes, v))| common_hack::PageDigestLite {\n                page: i as u32,\n                version: *v,\n                crc: format!(\"{:08x}\", cpengine::checksum::crc32(bytes)),\n            })\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\nfn run_property(seed: u64, page_size: u32, page_count: u32, steps: u32) {\n    let (e, root) = disk_engine(&format!(\"prop-{seed}\"));\n    let ds = \"p\";\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n\n    let mut rng = Rng(seed.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) ^ 0xdead_beef);\n\n    // 工作集镜像。\n    let mut live = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n    // 当前尖端检查点的链状态（无检查点时为 None）。\n    let mut committed: Option<ChainState> = None;\n    // 每个检查点 id -> 它所代表的链状态（历史不可变副本）。\n    let mut snapshots: Vec<(String, ChainState)> = Vec::new();\n\n    for step in 0..steps {\n        let action = rng.below(10);\n        match action {\n            0..=5 => {\n                // 写 1~2 个随机页。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(2);\n                for _ in 0..n {\n                    let page = rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32;\n                    let tag = rng.below(200) as u8;\n                    let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(page_size as usize, tag);\n                    e.write_page(ds, page, &data).expect(\"write\");\n                    live.write_page(page, data);\n                }\n                live.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n            }\n            6 => {\n                // 全量：链状态 = 全部工作页。\n                let meta = e.checkpoint_full(ds).expect(\"full\");\n                let cs = ChainState {\n                    data: live.data.clone(),\n                    versions: live.versions.clone(),\n                    page_size,\n                };\n                committed = Some(cs.clone());\n                snapshots.push((meta.id, cs));\n            }\n            7..=8 => {\n                // 增量：尝试随机页集合；引擎对“版本未高于父链/无父”严格拒绝。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(page_count as u64).min(3);\n                let pages: Vec<u32> =\n                    (0..n).map(|_| rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32).collect();\n                match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, None, &pages) {\n                    Ok(meta) => {\n                        // 成功 => 存在父链；新链状态 = 父链状态上覆盖被包含页。\n                        let mut cs = committed\n                            .clone()\n                            .expect(\"增量成功时必有祖先链状态\");\n                        for p in &pages {\n                            let idx = *p as usize;\n                            cs.data[idx] = live.data[idx].clone();\n                            cs.versions[idx] = live.versions[idx];\n                        }\n                        // 立即用引擎恢复结果交叉校验链状态构造无误。\n                        e.restore(ds, &meta.id).expect(\"交叉恢复\");\n                        let actual = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n                        assert_eq!(\n                            cs.lite_digest(),\n                            lite_all(&actual),\n                            \"seed={seed} step={step} 增量链状态构造错误\"\n                        );\n                        // 恢复改动了工作集：从引擎读回重建 live。\n                        live = model_from_engine(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n                        committed = Some(cs.clone());\n                        snapshots.push((meta.id, cs));\n                    }\n                    Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {\n                        // 合法拒绝（页不够新 / 无父 / 去重后为空）。\n                    }\n                    Err(other) => panic!(\"增量出现非预期错误: {other:?}\"),\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // 随机恢复到某个历史检查点。\n                if snapshots.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let idx = rng.below(snapshots.len() as u64) as usize;\n                let (id, cs) = &snapshots[idx];\n                let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore 历史检查点\");\n                assert_eq!(*report.chain.last().unwrap(), *id);\n                let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n                assert_eq!(\n                    cs.lite_digest(),\n                    lite_all(&after),\n                    \"seed={seed} step={step} 恢复到 {id} 后摘要与链状态不符\"\n                );\n                // 恢复后工作集与当前尖端都回到该检查点。\n                live = model_from_engine(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n                committed = Some(cs.clone());\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 最终：对每个快照再做一次全量恢复校验，并重启进程验证持久化。\n    for (id, cs) in &snapshots {\n        let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore\");\n        assert_eq!(report.chain.last().unwrap(), id);\n        let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(cs.lite_digest(), lite_all(&after), \"最终校验 {id}\");\n    }\n    if let Some((id, cs)) = snapshots.last() {\n        let e2 = reopen_disk(&root);\n        e2.restore(ds, id).unwrap();\n        let after = e2.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(cs.lite_digest(), lite_all(&after));\n    }\n}\n\nmod common_hack {\n    /// 可比较的摘要三元组（不依赖 Serialize）。\n    #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Clone)]\n    pub struct PageDigestLite {\n        pub page: u32,\n        pub version: u64,\n        pub crc: String,\n    }\n}\n\nfn lite_all(d: &[cpengine::engine::PageDigest]) -> Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite> {\n    d.iter()\n        .cloned()\n        .map(|p| common_hack::PageDigestLite {\n            page: p.page,\n            version: p.version,\n            crc: p.crc,\n        })\n        .collect()\n}\n\n/// 从引擎当前工作集读回全部页，重建参考模型（恢复后使用）。\nfn model_from_engine(\n    e: &Engine,\n    ds: &str,\n    page_size: u32,\n    page_count: u32,\n) -> ReferenceModel {\n    let st = e.state(ds).unwrap();\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n    for p in 0..page_count {\n        let (bytes, _info) = e.read_page(ds, p).unwrap();\n        model.data[p as usize] = bytes;\n        model.versions[p as usize] = st.page_versions[p as usize];\n    }\n    model\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_random_update_checkpoint_restore_seeds() {\n    for seed in 1..=12u64 {\n        run_property(seed, 8, 3, 60);\n    }\n    // 稍大的页与更长序列。\n    run_property(101, 64, 6, 120);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_merge_after_random_sequence_matches_model() {\n    // 随机更新 -> 形成单链 -> 合并 -> 逐页对照。\n    // 非压缩合并与压缩合并分别在两条同构链上验证（压缩会删除源、不可逆）。\n    let (ps, pc) = (16u32, 5u32);\n\n    // 构造一条 full->inc... 链，返回 (引擎, root, base, tip, 真值摘要)。\n    let build = |label: &str, ds: &str| {\n        let (e, root) = disk_engine(label);\n        make_dataset(&e, ds, ps, pc);\n        let mut rng = Rng(0x1234_5678);\n        let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(ps, pc);\n        let base = e.checkpoint_full(ds).unwrap();\n        let mut tip = base.id.clone();\n        for _ in 0..8 {\n            let page = rng.below(pc as u64) as u32;\n            let tag = rng.below(250) as u8;\n            let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(ps as usize, tag);\n            e.write_page(ds, page, &data).unwrap();\n            model.write_page(page, data);\n            match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, Some(tip.as_str()), &[page]) {\n                Ok(m) => tip = m.id,\n                Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {}\n                Err(o) => panic!(\"{o:?}\"),\n            }\n        }\n        // 每步增量都包含当次写入页，因此工作集即 tip 链状态。\n        let truth = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n        (e, root, base.id, tip, truth)\n    };\n\n    // 1) 非压缩合并：源全部保留，merged 逐页等于真值。\n    let (e, _r, base, tip, truth) = build(\"prop-merge\", \"m\");\n    let report = e.merge_checkpoints(\"m\", &base, &tip, false).unwrap();\n    e.restore(\"m\", &report.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after = e.digest(\"m\").unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth, &after));\n    assert_eq!(report.merged_page_count, pc as usize);\n    assert_eq!(report.sources.len(), report.page_counts.len() - 1);\n    for s in &report.sources {\n        assert!(e.repo().read_meta(\"m\", s).is_ok());\n    }\n\n    // 2) 压缩合并：merged 原子发布后删除中间源；merged 依然逐页等于真值。\n    let (e2, root2, base2, tip2, truth2) = build(\"prop-merge-compact\", \"c\");\n    let report2 = e2\n        .merge_checkpoints(\"c\", &base2, &tip2, true)\n        .expect(\"compact 合并失败\");\n    e2.restore(\"c\", &report2.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after2 = e2.digest(\"c\").unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth2, &after2));\n\n    // 现存节点只有 base(full) 与 merged。\n    let remaining = e2.repo().list_checkpoints(\"c\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(remaining.len(), 2, \"{remaining:?}\");\n    assert!(remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &report2.merged_id));\n    assert!(remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &base2));\n    assert!(!remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &tip2));\n\n    // 重启进程后 merged 仍然独立可恢复（不依赖任何已删源）。\n    let e3 = reopen_disk(&root2);\n    e3.restore(\"c\", &report2.merged_id).unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth2, &e3.digest(\"c\").unwrap()));\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_e0b1ef8ef0adf7676d30ac40","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1581,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":182072,"output_tokens":4523,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"b031cce4-e45d-4015-9570-6737993ef094","timestamp":"2026-09-22T17:42:55.626Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}

model.data[p as usize] = bytes;\n        model.versions[p as usize] = st.page_versions[p as usize];\n    }\n    model\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_random_update_checkpoint_restore_seeds() {\n    for seed in 1..=12u64 {\n        run_property(seed, 8, 3, 60);\n    }\n    // 稍大的页与更长序列。\n    run_property(101, 64, 6, 120);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_merge_after_random_sequence_matches_model() {\n    // 随机更新 -> 形成单链 -> 合并 -> 逐页对照。\n    // 非压缩合并与压缩合并分别在两条同构链上验证（压缩会删除源、不可逆）。\n    let (ps, pc) = (16u32, 5u32);\n\n    // 构造一条 full->inc... 链，返回 (引擎, root, base, tip, 真值摘要)。\n    let build = |label: &str, ds: &str| {\n        let (e, root) = disk_engine(label);\n        make_dataset(&e, ds, ps, pc);\n        let mut rng = Rng(0x1234_5678);\n        let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(ps, pc);\n        let base = e.checkpoint_full(ds).unwrap();\n        let mut tip = base.id.clone();\n        for _ in 0..8 {\n            let page = rng.below(pc as u64) as u32;\n            let tag = rng.below(250) as u8;\n            let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(ps as usize, tag);\n            e.write_page(ds, page, &data).unwrap();\n            model.write_page(page, data);\n Err(o) => panic!(\"{o:?}\"),\n            }\n        }\n        // 每步增量都包含当次写入页，因此工作集即 tip 链状态。\n        let truth = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n        (e, root, false).unwrap();\n    e.restore(\"m\", &report.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after = e.digest(\"m\").unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth, &after));\n    assert_eq!(report.merged_page_count, pc as usize);\n    assert_eq!(report.sources.len(), report.page_counts.len() - 1);\n    for s in &report.sources {\n        assert!(e.repo().read_meta(\"m\", s).is_ok());\n    }\n\n    // 2) 压缩合并：merged 原子发布后删除中间源；merged 依然逐页等于真值。\n    let (e2, root2, base2, tip2, truth2) = build(\"prop-merge-compact\", \"c\");\n    let report2 = e2\n        .merge_checkpoints(\"c\", &base2, &tip2, true)\n        .expect(\"compact 合并失败\");\n    e2.restore(\"c\", &report2.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after2 = e2.digest(\"c\").unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth2, &after2));\n\n    // 现存节点只有 base(full) 与 merged。\n    let remaining = e2.repo().list_checkpoints(\"c\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(remaining.len(), 2, \"{remaining:?}\");\n    assert!(remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &report2.merged_id));\n    assert!(remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &base2));\n    assert!(!remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &tip2));\n\n    // 重启进程后 merged 仍然独立可恢复（不依赖任何已删源）。\n    let e3 = reopen_disk(&root2);\n 在每个检查点后对照参考模型摘要，并随机恢复到链上任意检查点，\n//! 用重放同一序列的方式验证恢复结果严格正确。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse cpengine::engine::digest_equal;\n\n/// 确定性简易 LCG（不依赖 rand crate）。\nstruct Rng(u64);\nimpl Rng {\n    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        // MMIX 常数。\n        self.0 = self.0.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);\n        self.0\n    }\n    fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> u64 {\n        self.next_u64() % n\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在给定 seed 下执行随机序列并验证。\nfn run_property(seed: u64, page_size: u32, page_count: u32, steps: u32) {\n    let (e, root) = disk_engine(&format!(\"prop-{seed}\"));\n    let ds = \"p\";\n    make_dataset(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n\n    let mut rng = Rng(seed.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) ^ 0xdead_beef);\n\n    // 记录每个检查点创建时刻，参考模型应当具有的页内容。\n    // 我们不保存全部历史内容，而是：恢复到检查点 id 时，用记录的“逐页 (version,crc)”\n    // 与恢复后摘要直接比较。\n    let mut snapshots: Vec<(String, Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite>)> = Vec::new();\n\n    // 参考模型实时镜像当前工作集。\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n\n    for step in 0..steps {\n        let action = rng.below(10);\n        match action {\n            0..=5 => {\n                // 写 1~2 个随机页。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(2);\n                for _ in 0..n {\n                    let page = rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32;\n                    let tag = rng.below(200) as u8;\n                    let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(page_size as usize, tag);\n                    e.write_page(ds, page, &data).expect(\"write\");\n                    model.write_page(page, data);\n                }\n                model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n            }\n            6 => {\n                // 全量。\n                let meta = e.checkpoint_full(ds).expect(\"full\");\n                let snap = lite_all(&model.digest());\n                snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n            }\n            7..=8 => {\n                // 增量：收集随机数量的脏页（只选当前版本>0的页，或允许新页）。\n                // 为保证合法，我们只提交“自上次检查点后确实写过”的页：\n                // 简化做法——尝试随机页集合，引擎若以 BadRequest 拒绝则跳过，\n                // 但必须保证：成功时摘要不变、链可解析。\n                let n = 1 + rng.below(page_count as u64.min(3));\n                let pages: Vec<u32> = (0..n)\n                    .map(|_| rng.below(page_count as u64) as u32)\n                    .collect();\n                match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, None, &pages) {\n                    Ok(meta) => {\n                        // 成功前提：这些页版本都高于父链。记录快照。\n                        let snap = lite_all(&model.digest());\n                        snapshots.push((meta.id, snap));\n                    }\n                    Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {\n                        // 合法拒绝（页不够新/无父/空集去重后为空）。\n                    }\n                    Err(other) => panic!(\"增量出现非预期错误: {other:?}\"),\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // 随机恢复到某个历史检查点（如果有）。\n                if snapshots.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let idx = rng.below(snapshots.len() as u64) as usize;\n                let (id, snap) = &snapshots[idx];\n                let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore 历史检查点\");\n                assert_eq!(*report.chain.last().unwrap(), *id);\n                let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n                let lite_after = lite_all(&after);\n                assert_eq!(lite_after, *snap, \"seed={seed} step={step} 恢复到 {id} 后摘要与历史不符\");\n                // 恢复后参考模型也要回滚：从引擎工作集读回真实字节与版本重建。\n                model = model_from_engine(&e, ds, page_size, page_count);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 最终：对每个快照再做一次全量恢复校验，并重启进程验证持久化。\n    for (id, snap) in &snapshots {\n        let report = e.restore(ds, id).expect(\"restore\");\n        assert_eq!(report.chain.last().unwrap(), id);\n        let after = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after = lite_all(&after);\n        assert_eq!(lite_after, *snap);\n    }\n    if !snapshots.is_empty() {\n        let e2 = reopen_disk(&root);\n        let (id, snap) = snapshots.last().unwrap();\n        e2.restore(ds, id).unwrap();\n        let after = e2.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        let lite_after = lite_all(&after);\n        assert_eq!(lite_after, *snap);\n    }\n}\n\nmod common_hack {\n    /// 可比较的摘要三元组（不依赖 Serialize）。\n    #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Clone)]\n    pub struct PageDigestLite {\n        pub page: u32,\n        pub version: u64,\n        pub crc: String,\n    }\n    pub fn lite(d: cpengine::engine::PageDigest) -> PageDigestLite {\n        PageDigestLite {\n            page: d.page,\n            version: d.version,\n            crc: d.crc,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn lite_all(d: &[cpengine::engine::PageDigest]) -> Vec<common_hack::PageDigestLite> {\n    d.iter().cloned().map(common_hack::lite).collect()\n}\n\n/// 从引擎当前工作集读回全部页，重建参考模型（随机恢复后使用）。\nfn model_from_engine(\n    e: &Engine,\n    ds: &str,\n    page_size: u32,\n    page_count: u32,\n) -> ReferenceModel {\n    let st = e.state(ds).unwrap();\n    let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(page_size, page_count);\n    for p in 0..page_count {\n        let (bytes, info) = e.read_page(ds, p).unwrap();\n        model.data[p as usize] = bytes;\n        model.versions[p as usize] = st.page_versions[p as usize].max(info.version);\n    }\n    model\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_random_update_checkpoint_restore_seeds() {\n    for seed in 1..=12u64 {\n        run_property(seed, 8, 3, 60);\n    }\n    // 稍大的页与更长序列。\n    run_property(101, 64, 6, 120);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn property_merge_after_random_sequence_matches_model() {\n    // 独立确定性场景：随机更新 -> 形成单链 -> 合并 -> 逐页对照。\n    // 非压缩合并与压缩合并分别在两条同构链上验证（压缩会删除源、不可逆）。\n    let (ps, pc) = (16u32, 5u32);\n\n    // 构造一条 full->inc... 链，返回 (base, tip, 真值摘要)。\n    let build = |label: &str, ds: &str| {\n        let (e, root) = disk_engine(label);\n        make_dataset(&e, ds, ps, pc);\n        let mut rng = Rng(0x1234_5678);\n        let mut model = ReferenceModel::new(ps, pc);\n        let base = e.checkpoint_full(ds).unwrap();\n        let mut tip = base.id.clone();\n        for _ in 0..8 {\n            let page = rng.below(pc as u64) as u32;\n            let tag = rng.below(250) as u8;\n            let data = cpengine::engine::pattern_page(ps as usize, tag);\n            e.write_page(ds, page, &data).unwrap();\n            model.write_page(page, data);\n            match e.checkpoint_incremental(ds, Some(tip.as_str()), &[page]) {\n                Ok(m) => tip = m.id,\n                Err(cpengine::error::EngineError::BadRequest(_)) => {}\n                Err(o) => panic!(\"{o:?}\"),\n            }\n        }\n        let truth = e.digest(ds).unwrap();\n        model.assert_matches(&e, ds);\n        (e, root, base.id, tip, truth)\n    };\n\n    // 1) 非压缩合并：源全部保留，merged 逐页等于真值。\n    let (e, _r, base, tip, truth) = build(\"prop-merge\", \"m\");\n    let report = e\n        .merge_checkpoints(\"m\", &base, &tip, false)\n        .unwrap();\n    e.restore(\"m\", &report.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after = e.digest(\"m\").unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth, &after));\n    assert_eq!(report.merged_page_count, pc as usize);\n    assert_eq!(report.sources.len(), report.page_counts.len() - 1);\n    // 源节点仍然存在。\n    for s in &report.sources {\n        assert!(e.repo().read_meta(\"m\", s).is_ok());\n    }\n\n    // 2) 压缩合并：merged 原子发布后删除 i1..tip；merged 依然逐页等于真值。\n    let (e2, root2, base2, tip2, truth2) = build(\"prop-merge-compact\", \"c\");\n    let report2 = e2\n        .merge_checkpoints(\"c\", &base2, &tip2, true)\n        .expect(\"compact 合并失败\");\n    e2.restore(\"c\", &report2.merged_id).unwrap();\n    let after2 = e2.digest(\"c\").unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth2, &after2));\n\n    // 源增量已被删除：现存节点只有 base(full) 与 merged。\n    let remaining = e2.repo().list_checkpoints(\"c\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(remaining.len(), 2, \"{remaining:?}\");\n    assert!(remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &report2.merged_id));\n    assert!(remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &base2));\n    assert!(!remaining.iter().any(|id| id == &tip2));\n\n    // 重启进程后 merged 仍然独立可恢复（不依赖任何已删源）。\n    let e3 = reopen_disk(&root2);\n    e3.restore(\"c\", &report2.merged_id).unwrap();\n    assert!(digest_equal(&truth2, &e3.digest(\"c\").unwrap()));\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b031cce4-e45d-4015-9570-6737993ef094","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/b","sessionId":"943883b6-5d7d-4c7c-9156-2f1672edae69","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-b","slug":"golden-enchanting-hartmanis"}
